name: 空洞泰拉 TerraKnight 5.0.0 — 新版敌人 AI、护符背包与成就
body:
- **护符背包**：背包打开时，住房按钮左边的护符图标打开护符背包，列出圣巢的 40 个护符和凹槽。护符只能坐在长椅上装卸，和原版一样；凹槽不够时可以过载：第一次要试三次（两次裂开，第三次成功），过载时受到的伤害翻倍，增益栏里显示过载。国王之魂（5 槽；成为虚空之心后 0 槽，不能摘下）和格林之子（2 槽）也在护符背包里装，白色碎片装不上。快速聚集和快速劈砍是 2 槽，稳定之体是 4 槽（读档时原来的搭配放不下，会自动摘下并提示）。有护符技的护符戴着时，按护符技键（默认 C，在“泰拉瑞亚设置”的按键页里可以改）发动；同时只有一个护符技生效：在护符背包里按住收藏键（默认左 Alt）点一个已装备的护符，把它选为护符技。每个护符技的冷却在增益栏里显示成一个减益，冷却中按键时头顶飘出剩余秒数；游戏暂时接管人物时（受击、骨钉技艺）按下的键保留 0.4 秒。护符造成的伤害按当前阶段骨钉的基础伤害计算。创造模式的存档读档时拿到全部护符、11 个凹槽、三枚坚固的易碎护符，并且可以直接过载。设置 [Gameplay] CharmBag 可以关掉护符背包。
  - 蜂群集结（1 槽）：护符技：一层光晕从人物扩散到整个房间，捡起它碰到的掉落物（背包放得下才捡），冷却 5 秒；原版小虫搬吉欧照旧。
  - 任性的指南针（1 槽）：地图上指出最近的下一个还没打过的首领，小地图上用金色圆点画出过去的路线。
  - 幼虫之歌（1 槽）：三只光蝶绕着人物飞；生命不满时回复 10% 最大生命，冷却 10 秒。
  - 坚硬外壳（2 槽）：受伤后的无敌时间多 0.2 秒；护符技：张开 3 秒外壳，吸收期间受到的所有伤害，再按一次朝鼠标射出光波，把吸收的总伤害打给爆炸范围里的每个敌人（没放出去的留 10 秒），冷却 20 秒。
  - 巴德尔之壳（2 槽）：护符技（按住）：朝鼠标举盾最多 0.8 秒，举盾时移动速度 60%，正面挨打减伤 70%；刚举起的 0.15 秒内是精准格挡，完全挡下，挡下的弹幕反弹回去造成 2 倍伤害；冷却 5 秒（精准格挡后 3 秒）。
  - 亡者之怒（2 槽）：生命不高于 35% 时四个职业的伤害 +25%；护符技：舍去 30% 最大生命（最低留 1 点），身边爆出一圈火焰，之后 2 秒内造成的伤害翻倍，冷却 10 秒。
  - 快速聚集（2 槽）：药水病缩短 15%（和炼金石、神话护身符同戴时 30%）；受伤后 3 秒开始自然回血（平时 4 秒）。
  - 生命血之心（2 槽）：护符技：获得一层 25% 最大生命的生命血护盾，再用只补满；打碎护盾的那一击多出的伤害不落到生命上；冷却 60 秒。
  - 生命血核心（3 槽）：5 秒没掉血获得一层 10% 最大生命的护盾，最多 3 层；和生命血之心同戴时叠加。坐长椅给的生命血由这两枚护符的护盾代替。
  - 防御者纹章（1 槽）：尖刺、荆棘和酸水伤不到人物，可以站在尖刺上、在酸水里游；掉进深坑照常送回但不掉血，陨石的灼烧也伤不到；附近 300 像素内有敌人时每 4～8 秒在脚下冒出一团毒雾，持续 3 秒，雾里的敌人中毒 4 秒。原版的粪雾关闭。
  - 吸虫之巢（3 槽）：200 像素内有看得见的敌人时，每 2 秒飞出 3 只吸虫追击，每只是骨钉基础伤害的 35%（吃召唤伤害加成），每只命中回复 1% 最大生命。
  - 苦痛荆棘（1 槽）：被敌人打中时荆棘刺出，120 像素内的敌人受到骨钉 1.5 倍的伤害（吃近战加成）；人物不会被定住。
  - 骄傲印记（3 槽）：近战武器和骨钉的攻击范围 ×1.5（和修长之钉同戴 ×1.725）。
  - 稳定之体（4 槽）：没有移动惯性：松开立刻停，转身立刻转，速度不丢；护符技：3 秒内全身变成金色，每次冲刺都无敌，直接穿过敌人和它们的攻击，冷却 10 秒。
  - 沉重之击（2 槽）：骨钉技艺蓄满后继续按住，最多再蓄 1.5 秒，蓄满三段时技艺伤害 +60%、大小 +35%、击退翻倍。
  - 锋利之影（2 槽）：暗影冲刺的速度是 28（平时 20），穿过的敌人受到骨钉 1.5 倍的伤害。
  - 蘑菇孢子（1 槽）：护符技：遁入孢子雾 2 秒，人物看不见、免疫伤害、不能攻击，72 像素内的敌人每 0.25 秒受到骨钉基础伤害 33% 的毒伤，冷却 30 秒。
  - 修长之钉（2 槽）：近战武器和骨钉的攻击范围 ×1.15，并且能隔着墙打到敌人。
  - 萨满之石（3 槽）：魔法伤害 +15%，所有魔法弹幕和它们的判定变大 30%。
  - 灵魂捕手（2 槽）：吉欧掉落 +20%；近战和远程命中时吸取造成伤害的 3% 回复生命，每秒最多 4 点。
  - 噬魂者（4 槽）：吉欧掉落 +30%（和灵魂捕手同戴 +50%）；护符技：在两种模式间切换，冷却 3 秒：鞭子模式召唤物和哨兵伤害 ×0.6、鞭子伤害翻倍；召唤物模式召唤物和哨兵伤害 ×1.4，不能用武器。
  - 发光子宫（2 槽）：640 像素内有敌人时，每 4 秒消耗 20 魔力孵出一只幼崽（最多 4 只），扑向 400 像素内的敌人炸开，52 像素内的敌人受到手上武器 1.5 倍的伤害。
  - 易碎心脏 / 坚固心脏（2 槽）：面具碎片带来的青色心变为 3 倍。
  - 易碎贪婪 / 坚固贪婪（2 槽）：原版效果，敌人掉落的吉欧 +20%。
  - 易碎力量 / 坚固力量（3 槽）：近战伤害 +10%，骨钉伤害 +30%。
  - 骨钉大师的荣耀（1 槽）：骨钉技艺蓄力快 30%（1 秒 → 0.77 秒），骨钉挥砍的间隔缩短 30%。
  - 乔尼的祝福（4 槽）：移动速度减半，四个职业的伤害 +35%。
  - 乌恩之形（2 槽）：骑着坐骑时小怪和精英不主动攻击（被打过的照常攻击，首领照常）；护符技：化作一团绿光 5 秒，用 W A S D 自由飞行，照常能攻击，冷却 15 秒。
  - 蜂巢之血（4 槽）：受伤后下一瓶回血药水的效果翻倍，翻倍之后 60 秒内受伤不触发；3 秒没受伤时获得蜂蜜的回血效果，直到受伤。
  - 舞梦者（1 槽）：梦之钉在空中也能蓄力，蓄力和挥出时可以照常移动；原版效果保留。
  - 冲刺大师（2 槽）：冲刺键的冲刺冲向鼠标的方向；连按两下 W A S D 分别向上、左、下、右冲刺（按住冲刺键时是暗影冲刺）。
  - 快速劈砍（2 槽）：骨钉挥砍没有后摇；每次命中 0.07 秒后在同一个敌人身上再劈一刀，伤害是这一击的 30%，必定暴击；骨钉技艺也带银色的残影斩。
  - 法术扭曲者（2 槽）：魔力消耗 -10%，魔法武器施法快 30%，弹药 33% 的几率不消耗；远程命中时飞出一颗追踪法球，伤害是这一击的 25%（每秒最多 4 颗）。
  - 深度聚集（4 槽）：护符技：开关专心模式，没有冷却：场景变灰，敌人、敌人的攻击和地形里的危险标成红色，人物和自己的攻击标成蓝色。
  - 蜕变挽歌（3 槽）：骨钉每次挥砍朝挥砍方向射出一道穿透的银色剑气，伤害是骨钉的一半，0.5 秒后消失；骨钉技艺也射剑气（强力斩、冲刺斩射出 1.6 倍大的一道）。
  - 国王之魂 / 虚空之心（5 / 0 槽）：魔法武器的魔力消耗减半；能打开通往出生地的门。
  - 飞毛腿（1 槽）：穿着跑鞋在地面上奔跑时直接就是最高速度。
  - 梦之盾（3 槽）：两面梦之盾在人物两侧相对着转，挡下弹幕，碰到敌人造成骨钉 80% 的伤害（吃近战加成），碎开后再长回来。
  - 编织者之歌（2 槽）：三只编织者幼体算召唤物，每一口是骨钉基础伤害的 33%（吃召唤伤害加成和鞭子标记）。
  - 格林之子（2 槽）：算召唤物，火球伤害按等级是骨钉基础伤害的 0.8 / 1.1 / 1.4 倍；攻击间隔 0.9 秒，火球不散射、快 40%，追踪最近的敌人。
- 电弧涌动的阶段 5、基础 2% 掉落归入奥罗与马托的独立 Boss 奖励，保留难度掉率倍率与神居进度条件，阻止三种迷你左特从通用武器池抽到它。
- 对齐其他缺魔反馈：激光机枪保留正常预热速度，放慢缺魔发射、枪身动画和音效；美杜莎之首保留正常凝视倒计时，按原版整数间隔寻找目标；电弧涌动缺魔时电弧与手部闪光持续 48 帧（正常 16 帧），仍只在起始时判定伤害。终极棱镜保留正常聚合速度，缺魔共享命中间隔为 12 帧（正常 5 帧）。
- 补回原版缺魔视觉反馈：终极棱镜光束缩至正常宽度的 70%、亮度的 25%，补蓝后恢复；寒霜尖牙的蓄力闪光按缺魔速率淡出。绘制使用施法者的状态，远端投射物沿用现有快照字段传递。
- 修复灌满房间后换门进入的控制锁死、悬空行走和隔着方块瞬移到水面：倒出的液体按实际液体格子提供物理浮力，保留交互与重力，支持下潜，并受实体方块阻挡；原生水池继续使用原生游泳行为。
- 渔夫使用 36 条圣巢任务鱼及专属提示，普通聊天、交付和唤醒台词同步更新；原生角色、碑文及相关叙述统一将玩家视作来自泰拉的旅人。
- 联机个人宝藏袋跟随同步的 Boss 本体定位，避免客机本地尸体穿落到场景下方后把奖励带到无法拾取的位置；本机负责的死亡演出与掉落定位保持原流程。
- 修复联机共享物品无法微光转化的问题：主机统一结算转化与拆解，场景由客机模拟时提交请求，产物与微光状态同步；提前登记中的远端 Boss 控制器也不能操作未参与玩家。联机协议更新为 net14，双方须使用同版本插件。
- 全掉落与饰品制作审计：信息饰品阶段对齐旅商，冰雪镜补入冰主题地区宝箱，修正钓鱼宝箱提前给大师鱼饵的旁路；黑晶状体、骨之羽的低概率怪物来源提高到至少 1%，补回 45 条已支持的原版配方。保留四柱碎片独立归属规则；未闭合的装饰物来源另列审计报告。
- 武器与盔甲锻造阶段 0～5 上限统一缩减为 +2／+3／+4／+5／+6／+6，武器每级仍加 5% 基础伤害，满级最多加 30%；盔甲每级仍加 1 防御，战士盔甲加 2；骨钉与梦之钉按角色阶段使用同一上限。旧存档超限等级保留，不能继续锻造。
- 修复阶段 0 金匣没有合法装备候选的问题；区域秘匣两件装备排除重复，未收集装备以 2 倍权重抽取。每角色永久记录收集历史，渔夫识别已收集及合成过的饰品，每日任务最多积存 3 单，旧存档自动兼容。
- 反击蝇之王与灵魂战士的奖励统一为 Boss 规则；多本体等整场结束后只发一份奖励。神居阶段 4→5 生命试调为 1.8 倍增长，保留世界 Boss 血量锚点和基础防御。月总装备及月亮矿集中到终局来源，移除旧鱼匣和普通怪的绕过入口，已有装备保留。
- 各门的一部分材料/额外装备收益移至原生通关事件结算，每轮成功可再次领取，重复回调不重复发奖；满包奖励暂存并保存。旧宝藏袋保留旧材料加成，五门生命倍率保持。
- 生命力药水的 20% 加成计入面具碎片提供的青色生命，包含未集满一颗面具的碎片；基础生命上限先结算再加药效，避免高生命值被 700 截断。快速增益统一比较背包和药水箱，食物选最高档且同档选最长时长，幸运药水选最长时长，武器灌注只喝一种；已有增益和满增益栏不会导致重复消耗。修正死亡/无恢复需求时的喝药判定。鱼鳃、保暖和生物群系视觉药水注明当前世界的适用限制，无对应效果时不消耗。
- 玩家阶段按已取得的五种移动能力数量计算，顺序不限，每种只计一次。先拿螳螂爪也只进入阶段 1，不会因能力名称跳档；图鉴、商店锁定和向导提示同步按能力数量说明，开局饰品和临时移动效果不计入进度。
- 图鉴搜索和向导材料来源索引改为分帧处理，查询时显示检索状态；点击已有搜索框不再重复重建结果。缓存各阶段可分配掉落的怪物名单，批量计算图鉴掉率，并复用文字绘制内容以减少分配；掉落来源、数量和概率保持不变。
- 向导合成查询新增材料追踪：放入材料后，点击可合成物品就能看下位材料、已有/所需数量、制作站和其他配方；材料可继续逐层展开，怪物掉落材料会自动填入图鉴搜索，并可返回原来的追踪路径。既能制作又能掉落的材料另有图鉴入口，商店材料显示出售者及阶段/月相条件。查询不消耗材料，循环转换配方不会无限展开。
- 泰拉瑞亚设置 → 界面新增“武器特效不透明度”（0%～100%，默认 100%），拖动立即生效并自动保存。统一控制挥砍、鞭子、弹幕、光束、拖尾、爆炸、发光粒子、召唤物、骨钉技艺及能力特效，也作用于本机看到的联机弹幕和召唤物；不改变伤害、命中或人物与界面的显示。
- 举盾反弹按弹幕身份判断，不再根据贴图猜测：对照泰拉瑞亚 1.4.5.8 的规则，补上小鬼火球和黄蜂毒刺；闪电之击虽然共用霹雳法杖贴图，仍按自己的原版类型判定，不会被反弹。保留慢速红色光球、仅正面举盾触发的表现；玩家荆棘反伤不变。
- 掉落可靠性修正：背包满时暂存的首领奖励会随存档保存，退出再进入后继续发放，切换存档不会串奖励；联机中跳过非本机负责的世界掉落时，不再提前消耗远古操纵机的单次领取标记。
- 图鉴明确远古操纵机“必掉、每存档仅一次”，专家及以上从宝藏袋开出。同一单件装备参与多个独立抽取时，合并显示“至少掉一件”的实际概率，避免把概率直接相加而高估出货率；实际掉落率、数量和来源不变。
- 骨钉大师恢复授课：马托、席奥和奥罗不再说完就直接结束，初次拜访和拒绝后的再次询问都保留原版学习选项，费用照原版。学会后会给出当前按键下的泰拉操作提示。
- 暗影披风的冲刺也能接冲刺斩：拿着骨钉蓄满后，在暗影冲刺中松开即可。
- 弓、枪、发射器这类射手武器每锻造一级加 1 点盔甲穿透、0.5% 暴击率和 1% 暴击伤害（暴击从 2 倍起，新上限 +6 时 2.06 倍），射出的箭、子弹、火箭和它们的爆炸都带着；武器说明、锻造栏和紫晶属性观测仪里写着这些加成。
- 步枪瞄准镜、狙击镜和侦察镜在空洞骑士自己的镜头和泰拉瑞亚居中镜头下都能拉远视野：戴着瞄准镜按住右键，镜头朝光标方向推出去，最多半个屏幕；照 1.4.5，手里拿什么都行，狙击步枪自己就能推出三分之二个屏幕，再戴瞄准镜是 0.8 个。
- 着火、中毒这类减益挂不到够不着的首领身上：人在首领的战斗区域外，或首领还没醒（比如在格鲁兹之母的房间外射火焰箭），减益不生效，已经挂着的也不掉血、不会把它弄醒；钻进地里、缩进壳里这类全身无敌的时候也不掉血。
- **神居的掉落按阶段来**：神居里打的首领（诸神殿堂、万神殿、只在神居出现的首领）按你当前的阶段掉落，到阶段 5 才掉月亮碎片、夜明矿和终局装备；另外按难度给额外奖励：众神堂调谐、飞升、辐辉的材料多 25%、50%、100%，吉欧 1.5、2、3 倍，并有 10%、20%、35% 的几率多给一件当前阶段首领的武器或饰品；万神殿一门到五门依次是材料多 20%～100%、吉欧 1.5～3 倍、额外奖励 15%～40%。神居首领的吉欧直接放进背包，专家和大师的宝藏袋打开时也带着这份材料加成。
- 远古操纵机每个存档只掉一次：第一次打赢阶段 5 的首领（或第一次在阶段 5 的神居打赢首领）时必掉，之后首领不再掉。
- 召唤物和哨兵不吸引敌人：它们打中敌人只扣血，敌人的脚本听不到这一下，不会转身追着召唤物打、举盾或反击（苔藓骑士原来只追召唤物）；敌人被打后照样冲着玩家来。
- 原版的按键教程（跳跃、攻击、冲刺、超级冲刺、梦之钉的按键提醒，第一次拿到地图、护符、猎人日志时的弹窗）改成左下角聊天框里的一行泰拉瑞亚式提示，按键写的是你现在绑定的键；冲刺键没绑定时提示去“泰拉瑞亚设置”的按键里绑定。
- **骨钉技艺**：向骨钉大师学会后，拿着“骨钉”单击使用键砍一刀，按住直接蓄力（1 秒，骨钉大师的荣耀 0.75 秒），闪光后松开放出：站着或走动时是强力斩，按住上或下是旋风斩，冲刺（克苏鲁护盾的冲刺也算）时是冲刺斩，首领也打得到。伤害按骨钉当前的伤害（阶段、骨钉匠升级、锻造、词缀）算：强力斩和冲刺斩 2.5 倍，每个敌人一次；旋风斩转圈时每 0.2 秒对范围里的敌人打一下骨钉的伤害，站着不动的敌人也连续命中。骨钉的挥砍和技艺画在最前面，和泰拉瑞亚武器的特效一样。骨钉的说明里写着学会了哪些技艺和怎么放。
- 原版要用骨钉或梦之钉的地方有提示：走近战士的遗骸、守梦者和梦境首领的入口、低语之根、弹跳蘑菇、复仇者时，手里没拿对应的骨钉或梦之钉，左下角写着该拿什么、怎么用；还没拿到梦之钉时提示它在安息之地。每个房间每种只说一次。
- 创造模式存档的骨钉默认满配：纯粹骨钉（骨钉匠的四次升级）、三种骨钉技艺都已学会，“骨钉”物品锻造到当前上限。
- **训练假人**：泰拉瑞亚的训练假人是一件家具，商人从阶段 0 起就卖（6.31 吉欧）；放在平地上，用镐能挖回物品，可以放好几个。德特茅斯老虫子左边 10 个身位处一开始就立着一个（每个存档只放这一次，挖掉就没了）。所有武器、骨钉、弹幕、召唤物和减益都能打它，没有防御、不会被击退、打不坏；伤害数字照常显示，挨打时会晃一下，头上每秒显示一次最近三秒的每秒伤害，每一下都算进去，伤害小到扣不掉它一点血的也算。
- **久留一处更流畅**：空洞骑士游玩时关着垃圾回收，托管内存涨到约 1 GB 才一次回收完，整个游戏为此卡一下。mod 每帧产生的临时内存大幅减少：打开背包时（创造模式的合成栏列着全部物品，最明显）每帧约 11 KB，原先约 300 KB；平时每帧约 8 KB，原先约 60 KB。在德特茅斯造房子这类长时间待在一个房间的玩法，回收卡顿少得多，内存占用也低得多。
- 漂在酸水上（伊思玛的眼泪、鳍状肢等）挨打后，沉进酸里的骑士马上浮回水面，照常能跳出来（比如被乌姆的放电打进酸里）。
- **城镇居民的回购**：卖掉的东西按卖得的价钱原价买回。用矿锭做的武器盔甲这类不值钱的东西卖 0 吉欧，买回也是 0；锻造过的武器连锻造的加价一起，卖多少就花多少买回。照泰拉瑞亚的规矩，进存档以来在商店买的东西卖回去拿回买价，回到货架上，不占回购格。
- 联机时用首领召唤物：召唤者先进竞技场，这场战斗由召唤者的游戏负责，其他人等召唤者到了再被带过去（最多等 15 秒），召唤者不会进到别人那边已经开打的战斗里。
- 鞋带束头进了怪物的普通掉落：阶段 1 起，苍绿之径的酸液爬虫和真菌荒地的真菌飞虫各有 1.3% 掉，骷髅商人照常在月相 4 卖。
- **神居首领按你当前的阶段算**，和掉落一致：血量、伤害、防御都是这个阶段首领战的水平，各首领之间的强弱照旧。大师难度下调谐假骑士阶段 3 约 1.1 万血、一击 192，阶段 5 约 10 万血、一击 352（地图上的空洞骑士 11 万血、一击 352）。难度更接近原版：调谐和地图上的战斗一样；飞升血量 ×1.3、伤害 ×1.25；辐辉血量 ×1.3、伤害 ×2（原版辐辉一击死）；万神殿是连战，每个首领比众神堂轻，一门到五门血量 ×0.6、×0.65、×0.7、×0.8、×0.9，伤害 ×1.0 到 ×1.25。
- 首领的防御不低于同阶段小怪：阶段 0～5 的小怪是 2 / 4 / 8 / 10 / 20 / 30，原来 34 个地图首领里有 26 个比这低（灵魂大师 4、马科斯 4、叛徒领主 2、空洞骑士 13），现在至少和小怪一样，本来更高的不变；带甲的首领在这之上再硬一些：假骑士 8、巨型苔藓冲锋者 8、粪虫防御者 10、水晶守卫 10、梦境假骑士 12、守望者骑士 13、诺斯克 11、白色守卫和灰色王子 36。神居里也一样。
- **首领能被打断了**：原版能打出硬直的首领都照原版被打断，每挨一下攻击都给原版的眩晕计数加一（最多每 0.25 秒算一下，快劈骨钉的速度），打出硬直的频率和原版用骨钉时差不多；联机时别的玩家的攻击也算。霸体只留给空洞难度：空洞难度下所有首领全程霸体。
- 召唤物、哨兵和孢子囊动不了电梯：叫电梯的拉杆和电梯里的拉杆只有玩家自己的攻击才能打动，开门的拉杆照常。
- 掉出房间不会一直往下掉：掉到所有房间外面 1 秒就当作掉进深坑，回到最近站过的地面；原版的复活点在房间外，或者在电梯井口这种下面没有地面的地方时，也改回最近站过的地面（泪城的电梯井挖穿后，原来会掉个不停）。
- 开着地图躲不掉首领的吼叫：吼叫时地图开着就先关上，吼叫照常把你定住；地图开着时首领收走了操作，关地图也不会提前还给你。
- **前期的武器更有力**：所有武器的基础伤害都提高，越早的武器提高越多：阶段 0 的武器 ×1.3，阶段 1 ×1.25，阶段 2 ×1.2，阶段 3 ×1.15，阶段 4、5 ×1.1；“骨钉”按你的阶段同样提高。锻造偏后期：阶段 0 到 5 的武器分别最高锻造到 +2、+4、+8、+14、+22、+30，骨钉和梦之钉按你当前的阶段算；老存档里锻造过这个上限的武器保留原来的等级。
- 召唤物和哨兵自带 5 点盔甲穿透：仆从、哨兵、它们射出的弹幕和爆炸、孢子囊的孢子打中敌人时，在原有的穿透之上再无视 5 点防御，前期带甲的首领也打得动。
- **反击蝇之王和灵魂战士是首领**：它们掉圣物，生命、防御、伤害和硬直都按首领的规则算（反击蝇之王对应史莱姆王的七成，灵魂战士对应克苏鲁之脑的七成），在图鉴的首领栏里；神居里也一样。
- 吉欧石和生命血茧用泰拉瑞亚的武器打得掉：剑、鞭子、弹幕打中吉欧石就和骨钉一样敲下一份吉欧（最多每 0.25 秒一下），打中生命血茧就打破它。
- **图鉴的首领掉落按实战来**：首领的掉落页默认是世界里那场战斗的掉落；在神居打的列在“神居”地区按钮下，按你的阶段掉（阶段 5 掉月总的武器），页面上写着神居另按挑战难度给的额外奖励。格林、神之驯服者、奥波路波和梦魇之王的页面按帐篷和斗兽场的战斗显示：帐篷里的格林不掉终极棱镜，它是阶段 5 的神居才掉的；世界里打出的宝藏袋也按世界那场战斗开。小怪的掉落页列出击杀时额外的区域鱼饵（普通敌人 1/200、精英 1/100）和苔藓（1/50），这两样的几率和其他掉落一样随难度提高。全部敌人在每个阶段、每个地区的图鉴和实际掉落逐项核对过：列出的每样都按写的几率掉，不掉没写的东西。
- **能力盾**：克苏鲁之盾在工匠作坊里一样一样加上水晶之心、暗影披风和下砸（重锤符文；得到黑暗降临时另给一块暗渊符文），顺序随意，共 11 面：一样的晶心之盾、影帷之盾、荒芜之盾，两样的晶影之盾（水晶＋暗影，旧存档里的“圣巢之盾”就是它）、晶陨之盾、影陨之盾，三样都有的圣巢之盾；下砸换成暗渊符文的是暗渊之盾、晶渊之盾、影渊之盾和虚空圣巢之盾，带重锤符文的盾加一块暗渊符文就升上去。克苏鲁之盾的盾冲一直都在；带下砸的盾在空中按住下再按跳跃下砸，暗渊的是黑砸：猛击伤害翻倍，落地 0.4 秒无敌。
- **圣巢补购**：和哥布林工匠说话点“圣巢补购”，买回这个角色得到过的圣巢物品和能力奖励（钥匙、信物、遗物、骨钉、梦之钉、能力盾等，没得到过的不卖），每样至少 100 吉欧。圣巢物品能在商店和快捷出售里卖掉，卖价是补购价的五分之一；能放进箱子、猪猪存钱罐、保险箱、护卫熔炉和虚空保险库，联机的共享箱里别人也能拿；不能扔出去，也不能扔进垃圾桶。钥匙、腐臭蛋、苍白矿石这类有数量的东西，买卖和存取都跟原版的持有数同步；卖掉或存起来的骨钉和梦之钉不会自动补回来。
- 联机协议是 net8：联机的双方要用同一个版本。
- **首领的收益提高**：每场首领战另给一笔吉欧，按这场的血量和首领的阶段算（每点血：阶段 0 给 0.4，阶段 1 给 0.48，阶段 2 给 0.5，阶段 3 给 0.55，阶段 4 给 0.3，阶段 5 给 0.16 吉欧；原版的吉欧照给）。普通难度下各阶段首领平均约 820、1300、1700、4400、5400、8500 吉欧，大师难度约多一倍；神居里按你的阶段和那里的血量算，再乘挑战的吉欧倍率。图鉴的首领页写着这场能拿多少。矿石和材料各抽两种、数量多一半，每次击杀还有 30% 多给一件同期的武器或套装部位。按打掉的血量算，首领的收益是同阶段小怪的 1.6～2.7 倍（大师 3.9～6 倍）。
- **钓鱼的收益提高**：
  - 宝匣判定 15%（宝匣药水 30%；原版 10% / 25%）；
  - 地区匣在罕见以上的渔获里就出，渔力 50 时约 55 竿一个；
  - 地区匣的装备只从本地区最新阶段的装备（不足 8 件再加前一阶段）和对应原版宝匣的招牌物品里抽，本地少的地区补上相邻地区和金匣的，补到 8 件为止，最多 24 种；
  - 秘匣一次给两件不同的装备；
  - 地区匣每次都有吉欧，阶段越高越多（阶段 0 约 100～240，阶段 5 约 400～960）；
  - 木/铁/金匣的吉欧是原来的 3 倍，装备几率是 1/2、1/2、必出，优先出当前阶段和前一阶段的装备。

  合起来每竿的平均收益是原来的 2.2～5 倍，渔力越高越多。
- 蜂巢的水里钓得到蜂蜡匣：蜂蜜的截停规则排在宝匣前面，先判定蜂巢自己的匣子。
- **联机首领战由没打过它的人负责**：首领房间交给房间里还没打过这个首领的玩家，进房间时就定下，打到结束不换人。两个人进度不同时，打过的人那边这个首领已经不在了，这场战斗在没打过的人那边照常开打、打完记入图鉴；打过的人那边要是还有这个首领，也能一起打。巨型苔藓冲锋者、诺斯克这类首领在进度不同的两人之间都能正常打。
- 联机时诺斯克、格林、辐光这类走“特殊死亡”的首领被打倒，房间里的其他人也记入图鉴、照样算赢。
- **复仇之魂的四职业武器**：吸收复仇之魂后，背包里放进四把武器，放不下的掉在脚边，每个存档一次；已经有复仇之魂的存档，读档后补发。
  - 怨魂之锋（战士）：挥剑带骨白淡蓝的月牙弧光；砍中敌人时，从它身边飞出一只怨灵：先往外飞一小段，绕着这个敌人转一圈，再俯冲打它（剑的四成伤害），飞的途中不伤人；那个敌人没了就去打附近别的。
  - 怨魂脉冲枪（射手）：左键从枪口射出一整条怨魂光束，打到第一个敌人或墙就停（不穿透），每发 1 颗子弹，带枪口星芒和后坐。按住右键蓄力：枪口的光球越来越大，魂屑向它汇聚，枪身三格依次亮起，接近满时枪身微颤；满 2 秒自动射出一道大型白波（5 颗子弹，8 倍伤害），出膛时闪光、大后坐、轻微震屏；白波命中时炸开一圈魂光，周围小范围内的其他敌人受到六成伤害。未满 2 秒松开就取消，不耗子弹；一直按住不会连发；子弹不够时不发射。
  - 复仇之魂（法师）：施法处炸开一圈魂光；白波按 8 帧循环飞行，拖着残影和魂屑，碰到敌人就爆炸，周围的其他敌人受到七成伤害；爆炸之前按右键（再消耗一次同样的魔力），白波散成 15 只小怨灵，各自追踪敌人（每只两成伤害）；撞墙或飞到尽头散成几缕游魂。
  - 游魂唤杖（召唤）：召出一只小怨魂，跟在玩家肩后浮动；玩家附近有敌人时先后缩蓄势、魂屑聚拢，再带着残影扑过去，命中或扑空后减速恢复，接着找下一个；玩家走远时，它丢下敌人飞回玩家身边，离得太远或进了别的房间时直接回到玩家身边。
  - 数值按打完假骑士时的强度定（德特茅斯训练假人上实测每秒伤害）：剑连同怨灵 38，和草剑（33）相当；激光 51，和金弓（54）相当；法术 46，在红玉法杖（32）和魔刺（87）之间；召唤 21，略强于史莱姆法杖（17）。

- **赌场**：税收官出售 5000 吉欧的赌场套件，内有老虎机、弹珠机、红黑绿转盘（规则见 docs/CASINO.md）。打开机器时整台机器占满屏幕，全是像素画，字是白色，各有开场音效，每台都有“全额”按钮。老虎机由玩家自己拉下拉杆，同一条线三连中奖，中线前两个相同有安慰奖（两把剑保本），返还 95%。转盘从右边的筹码架点筹码放到左边，正中显示场上总额，球从中心甩出、落进颜色格子正中；赢来的筹码留在场上，可以取走或接着押。弹珠机是真实物理：按住拉杆蓄力击球，珠子冲上发射道，被顶端的弧形导板拐进场地（力气越大飞得越靠左），落在漏斗的斜轨上滚进中间的落口，被下面的风车甩到左右两个风车上（三个风车各自来回转，左右两个互为镜像），再穿过一块移动挡板、一块带杯子的移动挡板、六排钉子和底部上方的移动挡板，落进 11 个通道之一（两边 5 倍，中间 0.1 倍）。杯子每 6 秒在金杯和彩虹杯之间切换：掉进金杯得 3 倍，掉进彩虹杯从杯口弹出 2 颗同面值的新珠子（一颗最多分出 6 颗），一颗珠子连同分出的珠子全部落定后一起结算，自动发射约返还 95%；关掉窗口珠子照样飞完结算，退出游戏时还在飞的珠子读档后算完。中奖时机器两侧蹦出金色赢钱数字、喷吉欧、炸出彩色光芒；全额押注赢了满屏彩虹；输了冒烟、沉下黑色的输钱数字。联机时多人可以同时用同一台机器、各自结算，能看到别人的弹珠飞行和结果；世界里每一局结束都在机器上空蹦出结果：赢了是“中奖 +赢得的吉欧”（全额中奖是彩虹色的“全额中奖 +吉欧”），保本和输了是“保本”“失败”，并大声放出中奖或失败的音效；赢来的吉欧直接进背包（背包装不下的留在赌场余额里），没有领取奖金按钮。打开机器时勾爪照样钩着。

- **一键安装器**：发布页里的 `TerraKnight-vX.Y.Z-Setup.exe` 自带 BepInEx 5 框架，运行后从 Steam 的库列表里找到各个盘上的空洞骑士和泰拉瑞亚（两款游戏不在同一个盘也行，找不到可以自己选目录），把框架、空洞泰拉和启动器装进空洞骑士的游戏目录，把泰拉瑞亚的位置写进设置，可选在桌面建“空洞泰拉”快捷方式；游戏目录里只多出启动用的 `空洞泰拉.bat`，启动器的脚本放在 `BepInEx\TerraKnight`。同一页的压缩包也带着框架，解压到游戏目录就能玩。装在已经装过空洞泰拉的游戏上时，mod 和 BepInEx 自己的设置都保留（只更新泰拉瑞亚的位置），旧的启动脚本移进 `BepInEx\TerraKnight`，改名前的启动器 `泰拉圣巢.bat` 换成新版的内容，原来指向它的快捷方式照样能启动。
电圈 5 秒、榴弹 3 秒、集束碎片 1 秒、幻影凤凰 2 秒、飞龙音爆 1 秒、雨云和血雨云 5 分钟，感应雷最多 20 颗（多出的最旧一颗引爆）。

Charms are put on and taken off only while resting on a bench, as in the game; a charm past the notches left overcharms, which the first time takes three tries (two cracks, then the break) and doubles the damage taken while it holds (an overcharmed debuff shows it). The Kingsoul (5 notches; as the Void Heart 0, and it can't be taken off) and the Grimmchild (2) are worn there too; the White Fragment can't be worn. Quick Focus and Quick Slash cost 2 notches, Steady Body 4 (a set that no longer fits on loading comes off with a word). A worn charm with a skill uses it with the Charm Skill key (C by default, rebindable on the keys page of Terraria Settings); one skill works at a time: hold the Favourite key (Left Alt by default) and click a worn charm in the bag to choose it. Each skill's cooldown shows as a debuff in the buff bar, and the key pressed while it cools shows the seconds left over the player; pressed while the game holds the player (a hit, a Nail Art) it is kept for 0.4 s. The damage charms deal follows the current stage's base nail damage. A creative save gets every charm, 11 notches, the three fragile charms unbreakable and overcharming open on loading. - Arc Surge's Stage 5, base 2% drop is now reserved to Oro & Mato's separate boss roll, retaining difficulty multipliers and Godhome progression gates while excluding the three Zotelings' general weapon pools.
- Aligned further low-mana behavior: Laser Machinegun retains normal spin-up while slowing firing, animation and sound; Medusa Head keeps its countdown and uses the native integer target-check interval. Arc Surge's bolt and hand flash last 48 ticks without mana (16 normally), retaining first-tick-only damage. Last Prism keeps normal convergence and uses 12 ticks of shared hit immunity without mana (5 normally).
- Restored low-mana visual feedback: Last Prism beams draw at 70% width and 25% brightness, recovering when mana is available; Glacier Fang's charge pulse fades using the slow-magic rate. These visuals use the caster's state, carried by existing projectile snapshots.
- Fixed control loss after entering flooded rooms, walking in midair and snapping to water above solid blocks. Poured liquids now use cell-based physical buoyancy, retain control and gravity, allow diving, and respect solid collisions. Native pools retain their original swimming behavior.
- The Angler now uses 36 Hallownest quest fish with dedicated hints and updated dialogue. Native character dialogue and inscriptions address the player as a traveller from Terraria.
- Fixed shared multiplayer items failing to shimmer: the host resolves transformations and decrafting, including requests from scenes simulated by a guest. Remote boss controllers cannot move nonparticipants before scene ownership is registered. Multiplayer protocol is now net14; all players must use the same plugin version.
- Personal multiplayer treasure bags follow the synchronized boss body instead of a guest's unsynchronized local corpse, preventing rewards from falling below the scene. Death timing and positioning in the game running the fight retain their existing behavior.
- Audited loot stages and accessory crafting: aligned information accessories with the travelling merchant, added the Ice Mirror to ice-themed regional chests, gated early Fishing Chest bait, raised diluted Black Lens/Bone Feather sources to at least 1%, and restored 45 supported native recipes. Cross-pillar fragment conversion remains excluded; unresolved decorative sources are listed in the audit report.
- Weapon and armor forging caps for stages 0–5 are now +2/+3/+4/+5/+6/+6. Each weapon level still adds 5% base damage, for at most 30% on newly forged weapons. Armor keeps +1 defense per level (+2 for warrior armor). The Nail and Dream Nail follow the player's stage. Existing over-cap levels are preserved and cannot be raised further.
- Fixed the empty stage-0 Golden Crate equipment pool. Area coffers exclude duplicate equipment; uncollected items have twice the draw weight. Collection history is saved per character and recognized by the Angler, including combined accessories. Daily quest credits can accumulate to three, with legacy-save migration.
- Vengefly King and Soul Warrior now use complete boss reward rules, with one payout after all bodies fall. Godhome's stage 4-to-5 health growth is provisionally 1.8x; world health anchors and base defense remain. Moon Lord equipment and Luminite now come from terminal sources, closing old crate and ordinary-enemy bypasses while retaining owned items.
- Part of each pantheon's material/equipment bonus moves to native completion rewards, repeatable once per successful run. Overflow and completion rewards are saved; legacy bags retain their old material bonus. P5's health multiplier is unchanged.
- Lifeforce now boosts cyan life from Mask Shards, including partial masks, by 20%; the base-life cap applies before the potion bonus. Quick Buff compares inventory and Potion Box together, chooses the best food and longest luck duration, and consumes only one flask. Existing effects and a full buff bar no longer waste potions. Drinking is blocked when dead or when a restoration-only item has nothing to restore. Gills, Warmth and Biome Sight describe this world's applicability limits and are not consumed without a corresponding effect.
- Player progression now counts the five distinct native movement abilities in any order, once each. Obtaining Mantis Claw first advances to stage 1. Bestiary, shop locks and Guide hints describe ability counts; starter accessories and temporary movement effects do not advance progression.
- Bestiary search and Guide drop-source indexing now work across frames and show progress. Focusing an existing search no longer rebuilds results. Eligible source rosters are cached, bestiary probabilities are calculated in batches, and text drawing reuses content to reduce allocations; loot sources, amounts and rates are unchanged.
- Guide crafting queries now support material tracking: select a result to inspect ingredients, owned/required amounts, stations and alternate recipes, then follow materials recursively. Enemy-drop materials fill in bestiary search automatically, with a return to the original path; craftable drops have a separate source button. Shop leaves identify sellers and stage/moon-phase conditions. Queries consume nothing and conversion loops are bounded.
- Terraria Settings → Interface now has Weapon Effects Opacity (0–100%, default 100%), applied immediately and saved automatically. It covers slashes, whips, shots, beams, trails, explosions, glowing particles, summons, Nail Arts and ability effects, including remote shots and summons drawn locally. Damage, hit detection, player visibility and UI are unchanged.
- Shield reflection uses explicit projectile identities instead of guessing from textures, checked against Terraria 1.4.5.8. Imp fireballs and Hornet stingers can reflect; Lightning Strike cannot, despite sharing Thunder Staff artwork. Slow red reflected orbs and directional shield checks are retained. Player thorns are unchanged.
- Pending boss rewards now persist with the save when inventory is full and cannot leak between save slots. Skipping another player's world loot no longer prematurely consumes the Ancient Manipulator's once-per-save claim.
- The bestiary labels the Ancient Manipulator as guaranteed once per save (opened from treasure bags on Expert and above). Duplicate single-equipment entries show the probability of receiving at least one, accounting for independent rolls instead of adding their probabilities. Drop rates, quantities and sources are unchanged.
- Restored lessons from Mato, Sheo and Oro: first meetings and return visits after declining keep their native learning offers and costs. Learning an art gives the Terraria controls reminder with the current key binding.
- A charged Nail can now release a Dash Slash during the adapted Shade Cloak dash.
- A ranged weapon (a bow, a gun, a launcher...) gains a point of armor penetration, 0.5% crit chance and 1% crit damage for each forging level (a crit doubles at +0 and deals 2.06× at the new +6 cap), carried by the arrows, bullets and rockets it fires and their blasts; its tooltip, the forge slot and the Amethyst Stat Viewer show them.
- The Rifle Scope, Sniper Scope and Recon Scope zoom the view out on Hollow Knight's own camera as on the centred Terraria one: with a scope worn, holding the right button pushes the view toward the cursor, half a screen at most; as in 1.4.5, whatever is held, the Sniper Rifle alone pushing two thirds of a screen and 0.8 with a scope.
- Debuffs such as On Fire! and Poisoned don't take on a boss out of reach: from outside its arena or while it is still asleep (a burning arrow from outside the Gruz Mother's room), none takes, and any it carries neither hurts nor wakes it; nor do they hurt an enemy invincible all round (burrowed, shut in its shell).
- **Godhome's loot by stage**: bosses fought in Godhome (the Hall of Gods, the pantheons, and those met only there) drop by your current stage, the lunar fragments, Luminite and endgame equipment only from Stage 5; on top, its difficulty pays a bonus: the Hall of Gods' Attuned, Ascended and Radiant give 25%, 50% and 100% more materials, 1.5, 2 and 3 times the Geo, and a 10%, 20% and 35% chance of one more weapon or accessory of your stage's bosses; the five pantheons 20% to 100% more materials, 1.5 to 3 times the Geo and a 15% to 40% chance of that reward. A Godhome boss's Geo goes straight into your inventory, and an Expert or Master treasure bag keeps the materials bonus until opened.
- The Ancient Manipulator drops once a save: certainly from the first Stage 5 boss you beat (or the first boss beaten in Godhome at Stage 5), and from no boss after that.
- Minions and sentries draw no enemy's aggression: their hits only take health, the enemy's own script never hears them, so it doesn't turn on the minion, raise its shield or counter (the Moss Knight used to chase only the minion); struck, the enemy still comes for the player.
- The game's own key tutorials (the reminders for jumping, attacking, dashing, the Super Dash and the Dream Nail, and the first map's, charm's and Hunter's Journal's messages) give way to a line in the chat in the bottom-left corner, Terraria's way, naming the keys as you have them bound; with the Dash key unbound it says to bind it in "Terraria Settings"' keys.
- **Nail Arts**: learned from the Nailmasters, they come back on the Nail item: a click of the use key swings, holding it charges at once (1 second, 0.75 with Nailmaster's Glory), and let go after the flash: standing or walking a Great Slash, holding up or down a Cyclone Slash, during a dash (the Shield of Cthulhu's counts) a Dash Slash, bosses included. They hit by the Nail's own damage (its stage, the Nailsmith's upgrades, forging and prefix): the Great Slash and the Dash Slash 2.5 times, once on each enemy; the Cyclone Slash a slash's worth every 0.2 seconds on the enemies in its sweep, ones standing still too. The Nail's slashes and arts are drawn in front, as the Terraria weapons' effects are, and its tooltip lists the arts learned and how to do them.
- Where the game wants the nail or the Dream Nail, a hint: coming near a warrior's remains, a Dreamer's or dream boss's way in, a Whispering Root, a bounce shroom or Revek without the right one in hand, a line in the bottom-left corner says which to hold and how; before the Dream Nail is found, that it is in the Resting Grounds. Once a room for each.
- A Creative mode save's nail comes fully kitted: the Pure Nail (all four of the Nailsmith's upgrades), all three Nail Arts learned, and the Nail item forged to its cap now.
- **Target Dummy**: Terraria's Target Dummy is furniture, sold by the Merchant from stage 0 (6.31 Geo); set it on flat ground, knock it back into its item with a pickaxe, and set down as many as you like. Dirtmouth starts with one ten of the Knight's widths left of Elderbug (set there once a save; mined, it's gone). Every weapon, the nail, shots, minions and debuffs hit it, with no defense, no knockback and no breaking it; its damage numbers show as usual, it rocks when struck, and while it is being hit, once a second above it, the damage per second of the last three seconds, every hit counted, even one too small to take a point of its health.
- **Smoother long stays in one room**: Hollow Knight keeps its garbage collector off in play and collects everything at once when the managed heap nears 1 GB, stalling the game. The mod makes far less garbage each frame: with the inventory open (most of all in a creative game, whose crafting column lists every item) about 11 KB a frame against some 300 KB, otherwise about 8 KB against 60 KB. Building houses in Dirtmouth or any long stay in one room stalls far less and holds much less memory.
- Struck while floating on acid (Isma's Tear, the flippers and the like), the Knight comes back up to the surface at once and can jump out as usual (Uumuu's shocks knocking him under, for one).
- **Buying back from the townsfolk**: what was sold buys back for exactly what it fetched. Worthless things such as weapons and armour made from bars sell for 0 geo and buy back for 0; a forged weapon buys back for its sale price, the forging's share included. As in Terraria, what was bought at a shop since the save was entered sells back for what it cost and goes back on the shelf instead of a buy-back slot.
- A boss seal in a LAN game: the summoner goes into the arena first and their game runs the fight; the others are taken along once the summoner is there (up to 15 seconds), so the summoner never walks into a fight already under way in another game.
- The Aglet joins the enemies' common drops: from stage 1, Greenpath's acid walkers and the Fungal Wastes' Fungoons drop it at 1.3% each; the Skeleton Merchant still sells it at moon phase 4.
- **Godhome's bosses at your current stage**, as their loot is: life, damage and defense at that stage's boss fights' level, each boss keeping its weight among the others. On Master the Attuned False Knight has about 11,000 life and hits for 192 at Stage 3, about 100,000 and 352 at Stage 5 (the Hollow Knight in the world: 110,000 and 352). The challenges nearer the game's: Attuned as the world's fights; Ascended 1.3 times the life and 1.25 times the damage; Radiant 1.3 times the life and twice the damage (the game's Radiant kills in one hit); a pantheon is one fight after another, each boss lighter than in the Hall of Gods: from the first pantheon to the fifth 0.6, 0.65, 0.7, 0.8 and 0.9 times the life, 1.0 to 1.25 times the damage.
- A boss's defense is never under the common enemies' of its stage (2 / 4 / 8 / 10 / 20 / 30 at stages 0–5): 26 of the 34 world bosses were below it (the Soul Master 4, Markoth 4, the Traitor Lord 2, the Hollow Knight 13); those higher already keep theirs, and the armoured ones are harder than that: the False Knight 8, the Massive Moss Charger 8, the Dung Defender 10, the Crystal Guardian 10, the Failed Champion 12, the Watcher Knights 13, Nosk 11, the White Defender and the Grey Prince 36. Godhome's too.
- **Bosses can be staggered again**: every boss vanilla staggers is staggered as there, each hit adding one to vanilla's stun counter (at most once every 0.25 seconds, a quick nail's pace), so staggers come about as often as with the nail in vanilla; another player's hits count too in a LAN game. Super armour is the Hollow difficulty's alone: there every boss has it the whole time.
- Minions, sentries and the Spore Sac's spores no longer work lifts: a lift's call levers and the lever in it answer only the player's own blows; doors' levers still answer them.
- No endless fall out of a room: a second out under every room counts as a pit, back to the last ground stood on; the game's own respawn spot, when it lies outside the room or over nothing (a lift's shaft, in the City of Tears dug out), is moved to that ground too.
- The map can't slip a boss's roar: a roar with a map open shuts the map first and holds the Knight as it should; a boss taking control while a map is open keeps it when the map is shut.
- **Early weapons hit harder**: every weapon's base damage is up, the earlier ones the most: ×1.3 for a stage 0 weapon, ×1.25 at stage 1, ×1.2 at stage 2, ×1.15 at stage 3 and ×1.1 at stages 4 and 5; the Knight's nail rises the same by your stage. Forging is for later: stage 0 to 5 weapons forge up to +2, +4, +8, +14, +22 and +30, the nail and the Dream Nail by your current stage; a weapon in an old save forged past its cap keeps its level.
- Minions and sentries carry 5 armour penetration of their own: minions, sentries, their shots and explosions and the Spore Sac's spores ignore 5 more defense on top of any other penetration, so early armoured bosses give way to them too.
- **The Vengefly King and the Soul Warrior are bosses**: they drop relics, and their life, defense, damage and staggers follow the bosses' rules (the Vengefly King seven tenths of King Slime, the Soul Warrior seven tenths of the Brain of Cthulhu); the bestiary lists them among the bosses. Godhome's too.
- Geo rocks and lifeblood cocoons give way to Terraria's weapons: a sword, a whip or a shot striking a geo rock knocks out a share of geo as the nail does (at most once every 0.25 seconds), and one striking a lifeblood cocoon breaks it.
- **The bestiary's boss pages follow the real fights**: a boss's drops open on its fight in the world; its Godhome fight sits under a Godhome area button, paying your stage (the Moon Lord's weapons at stage 5), the page noting the bonus Godhome adds by its challenge. Grimm, the God Tamer, Oblobble and the Nightmare King show their tent and Colosseum fights: the tent's Grimm never drops the Last Prism, which only stage 5's Godhome pays; a treasure bag from a world fight opens as that fight's too. A common enemy's page lists the area's bait (1 in 200, an elite's 1 in 100) and moss (1 in 50) every kill can bring besides, both raised by the difficulty as every drop is. Every enemy's page, at every stage and in every area, was checked against its kills: everything listed drops at the chance shown, and nothing unlisted drops.
- **Ability shields**: at the Tinkerer's Workshop the Shield of Cthulhu takes the Crystal Heart, the Shade Cloak and a slam (the Ram Rune; getting Descending Dark gives an Abyssal Rune besides) one at a time, in any order, eleven shields in all: with one, the Crystal Heart Shield, the Shade Cloak Shield and the Desolate Shield; with two, the Crystal Shade Shield (crystal and shade: an old save's "Hallownest Shield" is this one), the Crystal Dive Shield and the Shade Dive Shield; with all three, the Hallownest Shield; with the Abyssal Rune in the slam's place, the Descending Dark Shield, the Crystal Abyss Shield, the Shade Abyss Shield and the Void Hallownest Shield, a Ram Rune shield taking an Abyssal Rune to become one. The Shield of Cthulhu's dash is always there; a slam shield slams with down held and jump pressed in the air, an Abyssal one with Descending Dark's: twice the slam damage and 0.4 seconds of invincibility on landing.
- **Hallownest Recovery**: talk to the Goblin Tinkerer and press "Hallownest Recovery" to buy back the Hallownest items and ability rewards this character has had (keys, keepsakes, relics, the nail, the Dream Nail, the ability shields and the like; nothing never had), each 100 geo at the least. Hallownest items sell at a shop and through Quick Sell for a fifth of their buy-back price, and go into chests, the Piggy Bank, the Safe, the Defender's Forge and the Void Vault, where in a LAN game's shared chest others can take them too; they still can't be thrown or put in the trash. Counted things such as keys, Rancid Eggs and Pale Ore keep the game's own count through every sale, purchase and move; a nail or Dream Nail sold or stored does not come back by itself.
- The LAN protocol is net8: both sides need the same version.
- **Bosses pay more**: each boss fight gives geo of its own besides, by the fight's life and the boss's stage (per point of life: 0.4 geo at stage 0, 0.48 at stage 1, 0.5 at stage 2, 0.55 at stage 3, 0.3 at stage 4, 0.16 at stage 5; the game's own geo as well). On Normal the bosses of each stage give about 820, 1,300, 1,700, 4,400, 5,400 and 8,500 geo on average, about twice that on Master; in Godhome by your stage and the life there, times the challenge's geo. A boss's bestiary page shows what the fight pays. Ore and materials come two kinds each at half as much again, and a kill gives another weapon or armour piece of its stage 30% of the time. For the life taken off, a boss pays 1.6 to 2.7 times what its stage's common enemies do (3.9 to 6 times on Master).
- **Fishing pays more**:
  - the crate roll is 15% (30% with the Crate potion; Terraria's 10% and 25%);
  - an area crate comes on an uncommon catch or better, about one in 55 casts at fishing power 50;
  - an area crate's piece is picked from at most 24: the area's latest stage's pieces (the stage before's too while fewer than 8) and its Terraria crate's, an area with few joined by its neighbours' and the Golden crate's up to 8;
  - a coffer gives two different pieces;
  - an area crate always holds geo, more each stage (about 100 to 240 at stage 0, 400 to 960 at stage 5);
  - Wooden, Iron and Golden crates hold three times their geo and a piece one time in 2, one time in 2 and always, the stage reached's and the one before's first.

  A cast pays 2.2 to 5 times what it did on average, the more the higher the fishing power.
- The Hive's waters give its Beeswax Crate: honey's stopper came before the crates; the Hive's own crate is asked for first.
- **A LAN boss fight is run by someone who hasn't beaten that boss**: a boss room goes to a player in it whose save hasn't beaten its boss, decided as they walk in and kept to the fight's end. Between two players at different points, the boss is gone from the beaten one's game, and the fight goes on in the other's as it should, counted in their bestiary at the end; the beaten one joins in where their game still has the boss. The Massive Moss Charger, Nosk and the like fight as they should between players at different points.
- In a LAN game a boss whose death is a special one (Nosk, Grimm, the Radiance) beaten counts for everyone in the room too: their bestiary, their win.
- **The Vengeful Spirit's four weapons**: absorbing the Vengeful Spirit puts four weapons into the bag (those that don't fit at your feet), once a save; a save that has the spell already gets them at its next load.
  - Revenant Edge (melee): each swing sweeps a bone-white and pale-blue crescent; a blow on an enemy calls a wraith out beside it, which flies out a little, circles the enemy once and then dives at it (four tenths of the sword's damage), harmless on the way; with that enemy gone it goes for another near one.
  - Revenant Pulse Rifle (ranged): left click fires a whole revenant beam from the muzzle that stops at the first enemy or wall in its way (no piercing), a bullet each, with a muzzle star and a kick. Hold right click to charge: the orb at the muzzle swells, souls are drawn into it, the three cells on the rifle light one by one and it shivers near the end; at 2 seconds it fires a great soul wave by itself (5 bullets, eight times the damage) with a flash, a heavy kick and a short shake of the view; where the wave strikes, a ring of soul light bursts and the other enemies close by take six tenths of its damage. Let go before 2 seconds to cancel at no cost; holding on never fires twice; short of bullets, no wave.
  - Vengeful Spirit (magic): a ring of soul light bursts where it is cast; the wave flies in its eight frames trailing afterimages and souls and bursts on the first enemy it touches, the others around it taking seven tenths of its damage; right click before it bursts (for the same mana again) and it breaks into 15 little wraiths that each hunt an enemy (a fifth of its damage each); at a wall or at the end of its flight it comes apart in wisps.
  - Wandering Soul Staff (summon): a little soul that floats behind your shoulder; with an enemy near you it draws back and gathers itself, souls closing on it, then pounces with afterimages, slows to recover on a hit or a miss and goes after the next; when you walk far off it leaves the enemy and flies back to you, and it comes straight to you when you are very far or in another room.
  - Their numbers fit the time they come, just after the False Knight (damage a second measured on Dirtmouth's training dummy): the sword with its wraiths 38, about the Blade of Grass (33); the laser 51, about the Gold Bow (54); the spell 46, between the Ruby Staff (32) and the Vilethorn (87); the summon 21, a little over the Slime Staff (17).
  - Their sounds are mixed at load from your own Terraria sounds, two or three of Terraria's each, pitched, cut and layered: the swing is Terraria's swing with the Death Sickle's whoosh, the laser the Space Gun with the Pulse Bow, the charge the Last Prism's hum rising three times, the cast the Spectre Staff with the Shadowflame Hex Doll, the summon the summoning staves' sound, the bursts a raised bomb; as loud and as mellow as Terraria's own weapons. The little soul's pounce has a sound of its own.

- **The inventory as Terraria's**: the minimap stays up with the inventory open, the equipment moving down under it and the information icons; the information accessories' lines become a row of icons while the inventory is open, a click hiding a line (its icon greyed) and another showing it again, kept in the save.

No pickaxe takes an altar; a weaker hammer doesn't either, and each blow costs its swinger half their life (Terraria's rule, defense counted). In a LAN game the host's world counts.

- **The Howling Wraiths' four weapons**: absorbing the Howling Wraiths puts four weapons into the bag (those that don't fit at your feet), once a save; a save that has the spell already gets them at its next load.
  - Wailing Deathbell (melee): a small bell thrown toward the cursor while the left button is held, tumbling like a boomerang, and bounces off enemies and the ground, a wail of souls bursting out at each strike (the other enemies close by take six tenths of its damage); after three bounces it flies back to your hand, and at once when you let go of the button. Meet it on its way and you catch it and can throw again at once; up to two bells can be out together.
  - Ghost Pipe Organ (ranged): a use roars ahead three times, for 1, 2 and 3 bullets; the white sound waves fly on up to about 80 tiles (bounces included), fading out at the end, and turn back off walls (gone after four walls or out of the room), striking each enemy once a roar; the first two break on the enemies they meet; the third, after a short charge in the three pipes, is the strongest and goes through everything; short of bullets, the roars stop where they run out.

Let go of the button and the next cut is the chop at once. The swings leave only a black smear behind the tip, with a silver rim; the sword is as big as the Revenant Edge.

The cup turns gold and rainbow by turns every 6 s: a marble into the gold cup pays three times its worth, into the rainbow cup two more marbles of its worth come up out of it (at most 6 from one marble), and a marble settles with all that came of it, about 95% back with auto-fire; marbles fly on and settle with the window closed, and marbles still flying when the game quit settle on the next load. A win bursts gold numbers out beside the machine, sprays geo and lights in every colour; an all-in win turns the whole screen to rainbow; a loss puffs smoke and sinks a black number. In multiplayer several players can play one machine at once, each settled on their own, seeing each other's marbles fly and their results; in the world every round ends with its result bursting over the machine, a win with what it paid ("Win +12,500 geo", an all-in win in rainbow), otherwise "Break even" or "Lost", and the win or loss sound played out loud; winnings go straight into the bag (what it can't hold stays as casino credit), with no collect button. A grappling hook keeps holding while a machine is open.
- The Tax Collector collects as in Terraria: while he lives in town, wherever you are, every 60 seconds each townsperson with a home (not the pets or the Traveling Merchant) pays 50 copper, up to 25 gold waiting; uncollected taxes are saved with the character.
- **One-click installer**: `TerraKnight-vX.Y.Z-Setup.exe` on the releases page carries the BepInEx 5 framework; it finds Hollow Knight and Terraria in Steam's libraries on every drive (the two games may be on different drives, and a folder can be picked by hand), installs the framework, TerraKnight and the launcher into Hollow Knight's game folder, writes Terraria's location into the settings, and can put a "空洞泰拉" shortcut on the desktop; the game folder gains only the `空洞泰拉.bat` launcher, whose script sits in `BepInEx\TerraKnight`. The archive on the same page carries the framework too: unzip it into the game folder and play. Installed over an earlier TerraKnight, it keeps the mod's and BepInEx's own settings (only Terraria's location is updated), moves the old launcher script into `BepInEx\TerraKnight`, and gives the launcher's pre-rename name `泰拉圣巢.bat` the new launcher's content, so a shortcut still pointing at it starts the game.
 electrospheres 5 s, grenades 3 s, cluster fragments 1 s, the Phantom Phoenix 2 s, the Daybreak sonic boom 1 s, Nimbus and Crimson Rod clouds 5 minutes, at most 20 proximity mines (the oldest goes off).
- Creative mode's bestiary spawns behave as the world's own: copied from a clean template (no health, death record, battle count or mod state carried over), woken when their spawner would (Aspid Hatchling, Zotelings, Shrumal Ogre, Ooma, Pale Lurker...) and cleared on death; the teleport points, teleport areas and arena bounds they use in their own room are brought to where they are spawned (the Pale Lurker, Soul Twisters, Volt Twisters and Mantis Traitors do not end up in the rock or across the room); the Colosseum's enemies can be spawned too.
- The title screen and the start menu run smoothly: with no hero about, the game's whole-scene search for one runs at most twice a second (the mod set it off dozens of times a frame, about 1 ms each on the start menu).
- With the new AI, a ground enemy starts no move while it is knocked back and no longer floats off weightless after a hit; a Crawler that is hit, from any distance, charges the player along the ground (up to 2.5 s, 2.5 s cooldown).
- Hollow Knight's own kneel and wait-for-a-key after picking up a charm or an item end by themselves instead of getting stuck. Sitting at a bench plays no map-reading pose and shows none of the game's map-updated or charm prompts; the map still updates.
- The full map opens on the layer the player is in (the right click that opens it on a pylon or by smart interact is no longer read as a layer switch).
- Fury of the Fallen's charm skill: 10 s cooldown, gives up 30% of max life (leaving at least 1), bursts a ring of fire round the player, then doubles the damage dealt for 2 s.
- Geo deposits and breakable pots, jars and crates break and drop geo when hit by projectiles, whips, the Zenith's blades and explosions too, as a melee swing does (at most once per 0.25 s each); minions and sentries leave them alone.
- Character creation: hair styles and the character rows of the save list can be clicked; the difficulty column's first entry is "Creative Mode"; the body and hair pictures load in the background a little each frame from the moment the screen opens, so paging through them doesn't stall. In game the character is drawn in the hair, clothing style and colours chosen at creation (the blank pieces of some clothing styles no longer stop the drawing).
- **Starting a game is Terraria's**: Hollow Knight's title screen stays; "Start Game" leads to Terraria's character list, character creation with the whole appearance editor and the world list (no pages); a world is made with five difficulties and the enemy AI.
- Every class slot of a common enemy's rare roll is something it really drops: about 10% of kills give a weapon or armour piece. Enemies drop hearts by vanilla's rule. The Pale Lurker's first defeat gives one of its own rewards for sure. Godhome's clear rewards have candidates again.
- **The Arms Dealer comes from the start**, selling Musket Balls and the Flintlock Pistol from then on; the Minishark and the rest keep their stages.
- **Brighter regional torches, the smart cursor's choice the area's own**: a regional torch is 1.25 times as bright as the plain torch and reaches further, 1.3 times brighter again in its own area; with the smart cursor on, a torch put down is the current area's regional torch while you carry it, and Shift's Auto Select takes it first too.
- **More and better area chests**: 10 in the largest area, the rest in proportion, at least 2 in each, an earlier save made up to that on loading; each holds one piece: in turn a weapon of the area's enemies, an accessory of theirs and one of vanilla's chest pieces for the area (sold in town or not, the Wand of Sparking say), the area's latest piece once you have had them all; then, as vanilla's chests, bars, arrows, bullets, throwing weapons and explosives, potions, Recall Potions, torches and more Geo.

name: 空洞泰拉 TerraKnight 4.4.1 — 渔夫与吉欧
body:
- 蓝湖左岸沉睡的渔夫画在湖的背景和雾气前面，走过去就能看到，右键叫醒后照常搬进城镇。
- 怪物掉的吉欧是原版的 1.5 倍，再乘难度加成（普通 1.5 倍、困难 1.875 倍、专家 2.25 倍、大师和空洞 3 倍），按总额换算成大中小吉欧；本来不掉钱的召唤小怪照样不掉。

---

- The Angler asleep on the Blue Lake's left shore is drawn in front of the lake's background and mist, so you can see him on the way past; woken with a right click, he moves into town as before.
- Enemies drop one and a half times the game's Geo, times the difficulty's bonus on top (Normal 1.5×, Hard 1.875×, Expert 2.25×, Master and Hollow 3×), the total paid out in large, medium and small Geo; summoned small fry that dropped none still drop none.

name: 空洞泰拉 TerraKnight 4.4.0 — 微光、旅商、掉落阶段复核与尖刺
body:
- **圣物**：其余 45 件大师圣物也换成新画的金色雕像，放在原版比例的底座上，48 件全是新图；名称和存档不变，已经摆好的圣物重新进游戏后显示新图。
- **微光**：遗忘十字路的温泉变成泰拉瑞亚的微光：池水是原版微光液体的淡紫色，整个房间的背景换成以太地区那片闪烁的星空，水面带微光闪点，泡温泉回血照旧。物品丢进去照原版规则转化：原版转化表里的变成另一种物品（天顶剑变真铜短剑、生命水晶变活力水晶、照明弹变微光照明弹等 160 种），其余能合成的拆回配方材料；转化出来的东西浮在水面上。和谐传送杖要到阶段 5，含骨头的配方阶段 1 起才能拆；联机时暂不转化。真铜短剑和微光照明弹从这里得到。
- 掉落物落在原版自己的升降平台、会动的平台、传送带、单向平台和工作站顶上，不会穿过去；落在会动的平台上跟着平台走，落在传送带上跟着传送带走。
- 旅商照泰拉瑞亚的规矩时不时来访：每天上午按原版的几率决定来不来、几点到（大约每四五天来一次，镇上要有至少两位城镇 NPC），到达和离开在哪里都会播报；傍晚等你不在他身边了才走，每次来都换一个名字。
- 用召唤物或创造模式图鉴重打已经打赢过的首领时，原版不再重复给梦境精华（战士之梦这类首领的精华只在第一次打赢时给）；重打战士之梦后，已经吸收过的尸体不会再出现一次。
- 快捷栏里的枪、弓等用弹药的武器像原版一样在格子左下角显示背包里（含弹药栏）对应弹药的总数，钓竿显示鱼饵总数。
- 第一次走进遗忘十字路的微光温泉时有一段小剧情：主角说两句话，再提示怎样用微光转化物品。
- 掉落物掉进水里会浮到水面上：一小半泡在水里，轻轻上下晃，水的阻力让它慢慢停住；从高处掉进去会先往下一沉再浮上来。圣巢的水池、酸水、温泉、倒出来的水和微光都一样，水面以下的部分画在水后面。
- 遗忘十字路的微光温泉所在的房间不能挖掘：房间原有的岩石挖不动、炸不掉，自己放下的方块照样能挖回来。
- **掉落阶段复核**：全部物品的获取阶段按实际最早能拿到的来源重新核对，692 件物品的阶段有调整，每个阶段能做的配方都找得到材料和工位；原版配方的材料、数量、工位和掉率参数都没有改。精金矿、钛金矿和对应的熔炉，光明之魂、暗影之魂、飞翔之魂，水晶碎块、妖精尘、独角兽角、诅咒焰、灵液从阶段 4 提前到阶段 3（机械首领之前就能拿到），毒刺提前到阶段 0。
- 小怪不再掉做出来的成品（原来有 104 种出现在小怪的掉落表里），移出去的那份几率空着，不分给别的物品；暴雪瓶、星力手环这类原版在世界里本来就找得到的照常掉，首领的奖励不变。
- 升到下一阶段后，小怪原来掉的材料照常能刷到（新旧材料按七三分），不会因为升阶段断了材料来源；有名字的精英也一样。
- 干火箭回到机器侠的商店；蜂巢的水里能钓到蜂蜜鱼；金蠕虫、金蝴蝶的阶段和它们在深巢的来源对齐；渔夫耳环这类渔夫任务奖励和对应的合成链从阶段 2 起。
- 活力水晶、神盾果这类每个角色只能用一次的永久强化，已经用过时物品说明里写着“这个角色已经用过了”。
- **尖刺和荆棘**按空洞骑士的比例扣血：每扎一下扣掉 1 个面具对应的生命（5 个面具时是生命上限的五分之一），不看防御，死人毛衣照样减半。苍绿之径、王后花园的荆棘还会像泰拉瑞亚的毒镖一样让人中毒 10 秒：中毒时每秒掉 2 点生命、不回血，牛黄和药用绷带免疫。
- 炸弹、炸药这类爆炸会炸掉范围内的尖刺和荆棘，连同被炸掉的地面托着的那些；挖掉或炸掉一格后，旁边只剩尖刺贴图的空格一起抠掉，不留半截尖刺，较早版本挖过的地方进房间时也补上。地图上的尖刺只画在真正会扎人的格子上，挖掉、炸掉的格子马上从地图上消失。
- 圣巢自己的商店（斯莱、伊塞尔达、萨鲁巴、食腿者）卖的东西是原版价格的 5 倍；莱姆收购遗物的价格照原版。
- 召唤物和哨兵等你先出手：进入一个房间后，在你攻击（挥动或发射武器、骨钉、法术打中、用法杖右键指定目标、鞭子抽中）之前它们只跟着你，不攻击任何怪物，碰到也不伤害；你出手后它们在这个房间里照常战斗，换房间后重新等你出手。
- 结局动画（空洞骑士、辐光和神居的结局视频）和之后的制作人员名单可以长按空格键 1 秒跳过，屏幕右下角有提示和进度条。
- 锻造过的装备卖给商人时，总回款最多是把它锻造到这个等级的最低花费（每级按一次成功、带优惠卡的价格算），锻造之后再卖掉赚不到钱；原来有 17 种装备锻造 +1 后卖出比锻造花费还多。
- 骨钉横砍、上挑打中敌人（包括敌人的盾）时主角留在原地，不往后弹；打到尖刺、盔甲、水晶这类会“叮”一声的东西，以及吉欧石、拉杆、弹跳蘑菇时照原版弹开，下劈照样能踩着敌人弹起来。

---

- **Relics**: the other 45 Master relics are newly drawn golden statues on Terraria's own pedestal too, so all 48 are new; names and saves are unchanged, and relics already placed show the new pictures once the game is loaded again.
- **Shimmer**: the Forgotten Crossroads' hot spring is Terraria's shimmer: its water the shimmer liquid's lavender, the whole room's background the Aether's twinkling stars, sparkles rising off its surface, and it still heals you as a hot spring. Items left in it change by Terraria's rules: those in Terraria's table turn into another item (the Zenith into the True Copper Shortsword, a Life Crystal into a Vital Crystal, Flares into Shimmer Flares and 157 more), any other craftable item comes apart into its recipe's ingredients, and what comes out floats on the surface. The Rod of Harmony waits for Stage 5 and recipes with Bones come apart from Stage 1; nothing changes in a LAN game yet. The True Copper Shortsword and Shimmer Flares come from it.
- Dropped items land on the game's own lifts, moving platforms, conveyor belts, one-way platforms and station tops instead of falling through; on a moving platform they ride it, on a conveyor belt they run along it.
- The Traveling Merchant visits now and then as in Terraria: each morning Terraria's odds say whether and when he comes (about one day in four or five, with at least two townsfolk in town), his arrival and leaving are told wherever you are, he waits till you aren't by him to leave in the late afternoon, and each visit he has a new name.
- A boss beaten before and fought again with a seal or the Creative book gives no Dream Essence again (a warrior dream's essence comes with the first win only), and a warrior whose essence was already absorbed doesn't leave a body to absorb again after a rematch.
- In the hotbar, a gun, bow or any weapon that uses ammo shows how much of its ammo the inventory (ammo slots included) holds in the slot's bottom-left corner, as in Terraria, and a fishing pole shows the bait.
- A story moment the first time you walk into the Forgotten Crossroads' shimmer spring: two lines from your character, and a tip on how the shimmer changes items.
- Dropped items float on water: they ride at the surface a little under half in it, bobbing gently, and the water's drag settles them; one dropped in from high up dips under first and comes back up. Hallownest's pools, acid, hot springs, poured water and the shimmer alike, the part under the surface drawn behind the water.
- The Forgotten Crossroads' shimmer room can't be dug: its own rock can't be mined or blown away, while blocks you put there can still be dug back up.
- **A stage review of drops**: every item's stage was checked against the earliest place it can really be got, 692 items had theirs changed, and every stage's recipes have their materials and stations within reach; Terraria's recipes (materials, amounts, stations) and the drop rates are unchanged. Adamantite and Titanium Ore with their forges, the Souls of Light, Night and Flight, Crystal Shards, Pixie Dust, Unicorn Horns, Cursed Flames and Ichor come at Stage 3 instead of 4 (before the mechanical bosses), and Stingers at Stage 0.
- Ordinary enemies no longer drop crafted items (104 kinds were in their tables); the share they had stays empty rather than going to the rest, items Terraria has lying about the world anyway (the Blizzard in a Bottle, the Band of Starpower) still drop, and boss rewards are unchanged.
- After the next stage begins, ordinary enemies still drop the materials they did (new and old split seventy to thirty), so no material's source runs dry with a stage, named elites included.
- Dry Rockets are back in the Cyborg's shop; Honeyfin can be fished in the Hive's water; the Gold Worm and Gold Butterfly have the stage of their source in Deepnest; the Angler's quest rewards such as the Angler Earring, and what is crafted from them, come from Stage 2.
- A permanent booster each character can use only once (the Vital Crystal, the Aegis Fruit and the like) says "This character has already used one" in its tooltip once used.
- **Spikes and thorns** hurt by Hollow Knight's share: each prick takes one mask's worth of your life (a fifth of it with five masks), whatever your defense, still halved by the Dead Man's Sweater. Greenpath's and the Queen's Gardens' thorns also poison you for 10 seconds as Terraria's poison darts do: two life a second lost and no regeneration while it lasts; the Bezoar and the Medicated Bandage keep it off.
- Explosions (bombs, dynamite and the like) blow away the spikes and thorns in their reach, and those the blasted ground held up; once a cell is dug or blown out, the open cells beside it left holding only spike art go with it, so no stub of a spike is left, and places dug in an older version are tidied when you enter the room. The map draws spikes only on the cells that really prick, and those dug or blown away leave the map at once.
- Hallownest's own shops (Sly, Iselda, Salubra, the Leg Eater) ask five times the game's prices; what Lemm pays for relics is unchanged.
- Minions and sentries wait for you to strike first: in each room, until you attack (swinging or firing a weapon, the nail, a spell landing, picking a target with a staff's right click, a whip's lash), they follow you and attack nothing, nor hurt what they brush past; once you do, they fight as usual in that room, and wait again in the next.
- The ending videos (the Hollow Knight's, the Radiance's and Godhome's) and the credits after them can be skipped by holding Space for a second; a prompt with a bar shows in the bottom-right corner.
- A forged weapon or armor sells for at most the least it could have cost to forge it to its level (each level a first-try success at the Discount Card's price), so forging and selling never pays; 17 items used to sell for more than their +1 cost.
- A side or up slash of the nail landing on an enemy (or its shield) leaves you where you are instead of throwing you back; what clinks (spikes, armour, crystal), Geo deposits, levers and bounce shrooms still push you back as in the game, and the down slash still bounces off enemies.

name: TerraKnight v4.3.1
body:
- 泪水之城喷泉雕像前大黄蜂的过场视频（以及别处同样在游戏画面里播放的过场视频）刚开始就跳过时，黑幕照常撤下、恢复操作，场景接着往下走：视频还没被看到开播就停掉时，补上原版视频结束时的收尾。
- 瓶装水照原版用玻璃瓶徒手制作，需要附近有水（圣巢的水池、倒出来的水或水槽旁）；商人也照常卖。

---

- Hornet's cutscene video before the City of Tears fountain statue (and any other video played in the game's own view) skipped just as it starts lifts its black screen and gives control back, and the scene carries on: a video stopped before it was seen playing gets the ending a video's own end gives it.
- Bottled Water is made from a Bottle by hand near water (a Hallownest pool, poured water or a Sink), as in Terraria; the Merchant still sells it.

name: TerraKnight v4.3.0
body:
- **小剧情**：第一次倒下、第一次坐长椅、走进漆黑的房间、生命跌到三成以下、拿到面具碎片或苍白矿石、十字路被感染、格林剧团进镇、拿到格林之子、三位守梦者都倒下时，主角会说一两句话，再给一条怎么做的提示，每件事每个存档只说一次，被打开背包或地图打断后接着说完。它们和神的指引分开，在“泰拉瑞亚设置 → 神的指引”里单独开关，创造模式存档默认关闭。
- **界面缩放**：像泰拉瑞亚那样放大缩小界面：“泰拉瑞亚设置”的“界面”页里的“界面缩放”滑条，50%～200%，mod 的全部界面一起缩放，松开鼠标后生效，屏幕放不下时按能容纳的最大值显示。
- **晶塔可以挪**：所有晶塔都能用镐敲下来，掉落对应的晶塔物品（森林、丛林、神圣、洞穴、海洋、沙漠、雪原、蘑菇、万能晶塔），放到别处有空地的地面上就是一座新的晶塔，照常上地图、照常传送；首领的战斗区域、梦境和神居里不能放。敲下来的长椅晶塔不会因为再坐那把椅子而重新出现。传送到挪过的晶塔时从那个房间最近的长椅进入，没有长椅就从房间的入口进入，再从晶塔旁的传送门走出来。
- **Wiki 按钮**：背包右下角“泰拉瑞亚设置”上方的“Wiki”按钮在浏览器里打开空洞泰拉 Wiki（haoawake.xyz/terraknight-wiki）。
- **时装栏**：装备栏左边一列是泰拉瑞亚的时装栏：三格盔甲，饰品格和装备栏的一样多。盔甲和饰品可以穿在这里，人物和地图上的头像显示时装栏里的样子（翅膀按装备栏里的画），它们不给防御、属性、套装奖励和能力；右键时装格和它旁边的装备格互换（一边空着也行），同一件东西不能同时穿在两列里。时装栏跟着配装一起切换，存档会记住。
- **怪物图鉴**：首领的生命、攻击、防御按它在世界里自己的战斗场地计算，在神居重赛里见过的首领也一样（重赛和世界里的战斗共用一条图鉴）；攻击按见过的最大伤害计算，开场演出里看到的首领也有攻击数值；只在神居出现的首领按神居显示。图鉴的阶段选择同时作用于普通敌人的生命、攻击和防御（按实际的进度追赶公式，存档的进度不变）；缺少原始数据的旧记录重新计算；大黄蜂的初战按它自己的场地显示（大师难度 4000 血、4 防御，二战 42000 血、9 防御）。
- **圣物**：螳螂领主、战斗姐妹和加利安的大师圣物换成新画的金色雕像，放在原版比例的底座上；名称和存档不变，已经摆好的圣物重新进游戏后显示新图。
- **变身坐骑**：狼、老鼠、蝙蝠、精灵坐骑按原版把人物整个藏起来，迅猛龙只露出头盔和面饰；联机时别的玩家看到的也一样；变身时不画翅膀（滑板保留翅膀），下坐骑后人物的各层照常显示。
- 新存档开局快捷栏的 4 号格是骨钉，5 号格是 10 支火把。
- 制作窗口在制作按钮的右边展开，点开窗口的那一下不会做出东西。
- 存档界面的翻页箭头只负责翻页：鼠标停在翻页条上时，下面的存档格不接收点击，翻页后不会直接进入存档。
- 鼠标指着够得着的箱子时，有名字的在光标旁显示名字，没起名的显示它的箱子图标，和原版一样。
- 骨钉下劈打中敌人、地刺或弹跳蘑菇弹起来时，云朵瓶这类二段跳和原版一样全部恢复，弹起后可以接着跳。
- 勾爪挂在墙上时打开地图，钩子照常挂着，关上地图后还在原处。
- 在人物身上或旁边放平台，人不会被顶到平台上；从平台落下后，人还在平台里时平台不会把人弹回去（平台下方有锯木机、织布机等制作站时也一样）。
- 吸虫幼雏打死后照常刷新，但不翻倍（一只对一只，拿着水蜡烛时按蜡烛的倍率）：皇家水道的房间里本来就成群。
- 遗忘十字路被感染后，复制出来、重新刷出来的敌人和原版一样是感染后的那一组，感染前只有感染前的那一组（原版每个房间放着感染前后两组敌人，按存档只显示其中一组）。
- 王后花园通往深巢那个房间（Fungus3_39）的苔藓游荡者和苔藓蝶照常成双出现、打死后照常刷新；房间里的螳螂战斗照原版。
- 白色宫殿的敌人（翅膀傀儡等）打死后在原地重新刷新，数量和原版一样一只对一只，拿着水蜡烛时按蜡烛的倍率；苦痛之路的敌人不刷新。
- 联机时先知的梦境（拿梦之钉）、勇者之梦、神龛这些不是首领战的梦境和神居房间，由自己负责时脚本照常控制自己的主角：拿梦之钉的白光过后照常醒来。
- 拾取面具碎片、灵魂容器碎片等物品的演出期间打不开地图，也就不能借地图上的晶塔传送走；队友的首领召唤物也等演出结束才把你拉过去。演出被打断、四片面具碎片没换成面具的存档，进游戏能自由操作几秒后自动补上面具（三片容器碎片补上灵魂容器）。
- 等待刷新的敌人在你站在出生点旁（4 格以内）时不显示半透明虚影，你走开后虚影出现一秒再刷出来。
- 敌人被连续击退后稳住的 1 秒（霸体）外观保持原样，这 1 秒里不会被击退。
- 紫晶属性观测仪的每一行按内容自动换行、加高，较长的数值和效果说明完整显示；分页标签和页脚文字放不下时自动缩小字号。
- 联机时制作也会用附近箱子里的材料（其他玩家正打开着的箱子除外），材料从主机的箱子里扣除；主机发现材料已被别人用掉或箱子被打开时，这次制作撤回，做出的物品收回。

---

- **Story moments**: at your first fall, first bench, a pitch-dark room, life below 30%, a mask shard or Pale Ore, the Crossroads infected, the Grimm Troupe in town, the Grimmchild and all three Dreamers fallen, your character says a line or two and a tip says what to do, once per save, finishing after an interruption (the inventory, the map). They are apart from the guidance, with their own switch in Terraria settings → Guidance, and off in Creative saves to begin with.
- **Interface scale**: the interface scales as Terraria's does: the UI Scale bar on the Interface page of Terraria settings, 50% to 200%, the mod's whole interface together, applied when you let go, at most what the screen holds.
- **Movable pylons**: every pylon can be knocked out with a pickaxe and drops as its pylon item (Forest, Jungle, Hallow, Cavern, Ocean, Desert, Snow, Mushroom, Universal); set down on open floor elsewhere it is a new pylon, on the map and travelled to as usual, but not inside a boss's fight, a dream or Godhome. A bench's pylon knocked out doesn't come back by sitting on that bench again. Travelling to a moved pylon goes in by its room's nearest bench, or without one by the room's entrance, then out of the portal beside it.
- **Wiki button**: a "Wiki" button above "Terraria Settings" in the inventory's bottom-right corner opens the TerraKnight wiki (haoawake.xyz/terraknight-wiki) in your browser.
- **Social slots**: left of the equipment column is Terraria's social column: three armor slots and as many accessory slots as the equipment has. Armor and accessories can be worn there, and the player and the map head show them (wings are drawn from the equipment column); they give no defense, stats, set bonus or ability. A right click on a social slot trades it with the equipment slot beside it (either may be empty), and one item can't be in both columns. The social column changes with the loadout and is saved.
- **Bestiary**: a boss's life, attack and defense are worked out as fought in its own arena in the world, for one met in a Godhome rematch too (the rematch shares the world fight's entry); its attack is the strongest seen, so one first seen in its intro shows its attack as well; Godhome's own bosses show Godhome's numbers. The book's stage choice sets ordinary enemies' life, attack and defense too (by the actual catch-up formula; the save's progress stays as it is); old entries without their raw inputs are worked out again; Hornet's first fight shows as fought in its own arena (4000 life and 4 defense on Master, the second fight 42000 and 9).
- **Relics**: the Mantis Lords', Sisters of Battle's and Galien's Master relics are new gold statues on a pedestal of the original proportions; names and saves stay as they were, and relics already placed show the new picture once the game is loaded again.
- **Transforming mounts**: the wolf, rat, bat and pixie hide the whole rider as in Terraria, the raptor shows only the helmet and face accessories; other players in a LAN game see the same; no wings are drawn while transformed (the skateboard keeps them), and the rider's layers come back on dismounting.
- A new save starts with the Nail in hotbar slot 4 and 10 Torches in slot 5.
- The crafting window opens to the right of its button, and the click that opens it makes nothing.
- The save screen's page arrows only turn the page: while the mouse is on the pager the save slot under it takes no click, so turning a page never starts a save.
- A chest in reach under the cursor shows its name beside the cursor when it has one, and its chest icon when it hasn't, as in Terraria.
- A nail pogo off an enemy, spikes or a bounce shroom gives the Cloud in a Bottle and the other extra jumps back, as the game gives its double jump back, so the bounce can be jumped on from.
- A grappling hook on a wall keeps holding while the map is open, and is still there when it closes.
- A platform put down on or beside the player doesn't push the player up on to it, and a platform dropped through lets the player by while still inside it, with no bounce back up (with a Sawmill, a Loom or another station under it too).
- The Flukefey respawn but aren't doubled (one for one; with the Water Candle, as many as it sets): the Royal Waterways' rooms swarm with them already.
- Once the Forgotten Crossroads is infected, the enemies copied and respawned there are the infected ones, as in the game, and before that the uninfected ones (each of its rooms holds both groups and shows the one the save calls for).
- The Mossy Vagabonds and Mossflies of the Queen's Gardens room by the way to Deepnest (Fungus3_39) come in twos and respawn like other enemies; the room's mantis battle stays as in the game.
- The White Palace's enemies (Wingmoulds and the like) respawn where they stood, one for one as in the game (with the Water Candle, as many as it sets); the Path of Pain's don't respawn.
- In multiplayer, the dreams and Godhome rooms that are no boss fight (the Seer's dream where the Dream Nail is got, the warriors' graves, the shrines) run their scripts on your own Knight when they are yours: after the Dream Nail's white flash you wake as usual.
- While an item's pick-up sequence plays (a mask shard, a vessel fragment...), the map can't be opened, so no pylon on it takes you away mid-way; a teammate's boss summon also waits for it to end before pulling you over. A save where that was cut short and four mask shards never became a mask gets the mask after a few seconds of free play (three vessel fragments their soul vessel).
- An enemy waiting to respawn shows no see-through ghost while you stand by its spawn point (within 4 tiles); once you step away its ghost shows for a second, then it comes.
- An enemy steadied after repeated knockbacks keeps its look for that second (super armor) and takes no knockback meanwhile.
- The amethyst stat observer's rows wrap and grow to fit, so long values and effect texts show in full; tabs and the footer shrink their text when it doesn't fit.
- In multiplayer, crafting uses the materials in nearby chests too (except a chest another player has open), taken from the host's chests; if the host finds them used up or the chest opened meanwhile, the craft is undone and the crafted item taken back.

name: TerraKnight v4.2.0
body:
## 4.2.0 — 地区家具、坐骑与神的指引

- **地区家具**：24 个地区各有一套 19 件家具，共 456 件——桌、椅、工作台、门、平台、床、梳妆台、书架、沙发、浴缸、马桶、水槽、时钟、钢琴、蜡烛、烛台、吊灯、灯笼、落地灯，用各地区自己的家具贴图（物品名是“地区名 + 家具”，如“苍绿之径桌”）。只用这个地区的方块合成，灯具另加普通火把，没有阶段门槛：工作台 10 块、平台 1 块出 2 个，都徒手做；其余在工作台旁做——桌 8、椅 4、门 6、床 15、梳妆台 16、书架 20、沙发 5、浴缸 14、马桶 6、水槽 6、时钟 10、钢琴 15，蜡烛 4 块 + 1 火把、烛台 6 + 3、吊灯 4 + 4、灯笼 6 + 1、落地灯 3 + 1。
- **神的指引**：新建存档选完难度后会问是否听从神的指引（之后可在“泰拉瑞亚设置 → 神的指引”里按存档开关，更新前的旧存档默认关闭）。听从时，把玩家卷进圣巢的「门外之声」在开局说一段开场对白，之后 48 场 Boss 战各在第一次打赢时说一句：先评价这场胜利，再用地标和特征（不点名）指向下一场。指向先找同一阶段里还没打过的，同阶段打完才指向下一阶段，后面都打完再指回身后剩下的；跳关先打了后面的 Boss 照常播报，之后回头补打前面阶段的 Boss 时换成越级台词。等首领的死亡演出、战利品和它自己的对话都结束、玩家拿回控制权后才开口，过程中游戏自己的对话或过场开始就先停下；台词显示在屏幕上方并写进聊天框，结局动画前没说完的下次读档补说。48 场全部打完后有收束对白。台词表见 docs/神的指引-对话审阅稿.md。
- **坐骑**：加入泰拉瑞亚的 38 种普通坐骑，装进坐骑格后默认按 R 上下坐骑，速度、跳跃和飞行时间按原版；踩踏、冲撞和自动射击的坐骑按原版伤害乘召唤伤害攻击敌人。坐骑按阶段由首领和普通怪掉落，骑乘要达到对应阶段；物品提示有英文。获取来源和掉率见《坐骑获取与阶段安排》。
- **Boss 首杀成长**：每种独立 Boss 第一次打完整场，永久增加 0.5 个百分点免伤和近战、远程、魔法、召唤各 0.5 个百分点增伤；48 场（含暴怒守卫、战斗姐妹、有翼诺斯克、无上辐光）全部首杀共 +24 个百分点。重复击杀和普通神居重赛不再加，所有难度都生效；旧存档按已有的 Boss 击杀记录补计（四种共用图鉴的强化形态从更新后的首次击杀算起）。
- **紫晶属性观测仪**：背包里快捷按钮旁的观测仪图标打开属性面板，分「综合属性」「手持武器」「生效装备」「更多属性与效果」四页：生命、护盾、魔力、含锻造的防御和抵消量、各种免伤、四职业增伤、首杀奖励、召唤栏和哨兵、再生与药水病，手持武器按将要使用的弹药算伤害，还有攻速、暴击、移动、飞行、挖掘、钓鱼、当前增益和每件生效装备的完整效果。日耀和甲虫的减伤只读预览，查看不消耗护盾和层数。
- **Boss 血量曲线**（大师难度、单人、整场总血量）：前期平缓、后期陡升，一战大黄蜂 4000、普通辐光 200000，例如假骑士约 3000、螳螂领主 8400、灵魂大师 7800、水晶守卫 7440、守望者骑士 16800、残破容器 15600、二战大黄蜂 42000、格林 65000、空洞骑士 110000、梦魇之王 140000。拦住移动能力和关键路线的守门战（大黄蜂、螳螂领主、灵魂大师、水晶守卫、守望者骑士、残破容器、二战大黄蜂）多 20%。失败冠军 8500、灵魂暴君 17000、失落近亲 40000、灰色王子 75000。普通／困难／专家的比例不变，空洞难度沿用大师；多阶段和多本体在整场总量里分配，原版的阶段机制和转阶段血量比例保留。全表见 docs/Boss血量全表-大师辐光20万.md。
- 阿比盖尔的花和沙漠虎重复召唤的增伤按原版：阿比盖尔每多占一栏 +55%（阶段 4 起 +130%），沙漠虎普通攻击每多占一栏 +40%、扑击 1.5 倍起每栏 +40%；满栏重召不再叠层，也不会把阿比盖尔或沙漠虎本体换掉、重置攻击状态。
- 暗影披风、水晶之心和圣巢之盾不能丢弃、扔出、出售或放进垃圾桶；圣巢背包可以放骨钉、梦之钉和圣巢之盾（共 31 格，旧存档的格子照常读入），背包全满时这些物品留在鼠标上，不会掉到地上。
- 灵魂大师的召唤物从上层走廊的门进场（Ruins1_24 的 right1），直接站在第一阶段的战斗区，不会先落到下层的第二阶段区域。
- 地区家具的用法：门要有地面和天花板，右键开关，走近自动开，居民会推门，开着关着挖回来都是同一扇门；床右键设置或取消重生点，床被挖走时它的重生点一起取消；椅子、沙发、马桶可以在房屋菜单里给居民当座位；梳妆台是 40 格储物（跟着存档保存，联机时有锁），里面有东西或开着时挖不走，顶上能站、能按下穿过、能放小家具；工作台和书架算作对应的制作站，水槽在附近合成时可以代替水，时钟右键显示当前时间；吊灯和灯笼挂在天花板上，其余灯具放在地面或桌面，都带和地区贴图相配的火焰、逐帧闪烁和光，一直亮着；平台是真正的平台格，能连接、斜着铺成楼梯、做半砖，能站、按下穿过，挖回来是各自地区的平台。房屋判定按原版的家具类别认这些家具；家具和门的开关状态跟着世界存档保存、联机同步。钢琴和浴缸是摆设，也算房屋家具。
- 联机打怪：客机上的首领各部件照常显示（出场动画打开的父物体、子精灵都同步过去）；对不上号的远端对象不再拿来隐藏本地首领。敌人照泰拉瑞亚服务器的 TargetClosest 选目标，首领也一样：在同一个房间（首领是它的竞技场）里活着的玩家中，取横竖距离之和减去该玩家仇恨值最小的那个；血肉指虎、腐香囊、海龟 / 甲虫 / 耀斑盔甲、英雄护盾、狂战士手套、侦察镜、潜行者箭袋、奥术花、隐身药水和潜行套装照原版改变仇恨值，警戒范围和视线按选中的玩家算。敌人放出的独立攻击（弹幕、冲击波这类）在每个玩家那边都有伤害，各自走正常的受伤流程（无敌帧、减伤照常）。联机协议升到 net5，双方都要用 4.2.0。
- 联机画面同步：首领战里生成的东西（首领扔出的弹幕、地刺、冲击波、开战战吼和攻击特效、召唤出来的小怪）在其他玩家那边照样出现、跟着动、按原版动画播放；首领房叠加的首领场景里的物体和带战斗铁门的物体（落下的铁门、升起的机关）的开关、位置、动画和碰撞跟负责首领的那台游戏一致。敌人挨打时，每个玩家那边都有原版的受击闪光、血花和声音。敌人死在别的玩家那边时，这边照原版死亡流程留下尸体和死亡特效；首领自己的死亡演出（假骑士倒下、大黄蜂离开、螳螂领主鞠躬这类）照着负责的那台游戏播放。
- 联机队友：队友打出的伤害数字、受伤和治疗数字，队友跑跳、饰品、武器和受击时的泰拉瑞亚粒子（如云朵瓶的云团、火箭靴的火焰），以及队友空洞骑士法术等技能生成的特效，同场景的其他玩家都看得到。
- 联机拾取：红心和星星跟单人模式一样，碰到就回 20 点生命或 100 点魔力，不进背包（客机向主机领取后当场生效）。
- 联机“快速堆叠至附近的箱子”：自己开着的箱子和存钱罐当场放；附近其他箱子由主机放进去，放不下的退回原来的格子；别的玩家正开着的箱子不放。
- 联机首领战：首领房叠加的首领场景（“_boss”）和房间本身由同一个玩家的游戏负责。其他玩家看到的敌人生命、生命上限和防御用负责它的那台游戏的数值：各自存档的难度、进度不同时，血条、悬停数字和伤害计算两边一致。联机协议升到 net6，双方都要用这一版。
- 联机时，手持骨钉打另一个玩家负责的敌人，也按骨钉物品的泰拉瑞亚伤害结算（暴击、击退、数字照常），不会按原版骨钉伤害扣掉敌人固定比例的血。
- 联机主机的世界同步按类别增量进行：地上的物品每 0.1 秒、箱子工作站和生命水晶在有人操作时和每 2 秒、方块墙壁和火把在场景被挖改时和轮流核对时，内容没变就不重新打包，主机的开销不随存档里挖改的方块增多而增加。每条连接待发的数据有上限（192 KB）：网速跟不上时，先略过会被下一份取代的画面数据（玩家状态、敌人和场景快照、弹幕、召唤物、粒子和数字），世界、聊天、死亡、命中和方块改动照常送达，主机不再为慢的连接越积越多内存。
- 关闭对话播报时，对话被传送、换房间等打断后，翻页箭头和结束标记跟着对话框一起收起，不留在屏幕中间。
- 站在首领房两道战斗门之间就算在场内：格林走到帐篷两端、战斗门外侧时照样能打到，不弹“先进入首领的战斗区域”。

- 鼠标指针可以自定义：“泰拉瑞亚设置 → 光标”里选泰拉瑞亚或空洞骑士自己的指针，调大小、颜色（色相 / 饱和度 / 亮度）、发光强度和呼吸闪烁，带实时预览。
- 击退推力超过前期阔剑水平（3.5 像素/帧）的部分按 45% 增长、最多 6.5，暴击的 1.4 倍算在压缩之前：附魔回旋镖、长矛打不稳定苔藓这类轻小敌人，击飞距离在 3–5 个单位以内；落地刹车时再挨打的地面敌人仍按地面敌人击飞，保持重力。

- 荆棘丛（苍绿之径、王后花园等）的贴图从最前景到玩法平面后面共有几十层，挖掉的格子里各层荆棘贴图一起抠掉。碰到荆棘时逐格判断：碰到还能挖的荆棘格受伤；挖掉的格子、实心地面和只被荆棘边缘擦过的格子不受伤。
- 钓竿照原版挥动：抛竿和收竿各挥一下，带挥动音效。
- 按住下键穿过平台，松开下键就落在下一层平台上；穿平台只对玩家自己生效，站在平台上的敌人照常站着。
- 加入泰拉瑞亚的液体：水和酸水（对应原版的熔岩）按原版规则流动——先往下流，再和左右最多三格取平均，静下来就停止计算；酸水像熔岩一样流得慢。水和酸水相遇变成黑曜石。往液体里放方块，那一格的液体消失；挖开方块，周围的液体流进来，水位下降。
- 加入桶和海绵：空桶对着液体舀起一桶（周围 3×3 合计要超过 100；空洞骑士原有的水池和酸池也能舀，池子保持原样），变成水桶或酸水桶；水桶、酸水桶倒出一整格液体并还回空桶；无底水桶、无底酸水桶一直能倒；超级吸水棉吸水、酸水吸收棉吸酸水，吸多少都不会满。无底水桶在水边、无底酸水桶在酸水边用一个空桶徒手制作；无底水桶和超级吸水棉也是渔夫的任务奖励（第 25 个任务必给无底水桶，完成 10 个任务以后每次各有几率），无底酸水桶和酸水吸收棉也能在酸水里钓到（传说级，1/3）。
- 自己倒的液体照泰拉瑞亚原版的水画：水用原版的水，酸水用丛林的绿水，按四周开口取顶面、边缘和内部的帧，液面不满时只画到液面，16 帧水波动画；比泰拉瑞亚更透明，贴近空洞骑士清澈的水。3 格以上深的水面能像原版水池一样游泳，酸水照原版伤人。能钓鱼：水量达到原版要求才能钓（少于 75 格钓不了，少于 300 格渔力打折），钓到所在地区的地区匣（概率同原版生物群系匣），梦境等没有原版水的地区也能这样钓到地区匣；原版水池不限大小。制作时需要靠近水或酸水的配方也认自己倒的液体。
- 黑曜石方块：水碰酸水生成，挖掉掉黑曜石（需要 55% 镐力），黑曜石也能放置。
- 全屏地图和角落小地图上，主角所在的房间画在最上面：旁边房间叠进来的通道被它盖住，主角周围的地图和房间本身一致。
- 世界地图重新排布：房间画到别的房间通道上、岩石上的地方少了约三成，相连的门对上的数目不变、总偏差更小（遗忘十字路西边的 Crossroads_11_alt 和苍绿之径的 Fungus1_08 叠进 Crossroads_12、Crossroads_35 的部分少了一半以上）。原版世界里绕成环的门在平面地图上仍有约 76 对接不上，地图照旧用箭头标出。

验证：Release 构建通过；地区家具的专用测试（2426 项家具检查、1032 项合成界面检查、925 项原版配方检查）和联机战斗的双端用例在测试副本里通过；本版未发布，没有完整实机游玩。安装时退出游戏，把 TerraKnight.dll / .pdb 覆盖到 BepInEx\plugins\TerraKnight，再用“空洞泰拉.bat”启动。
