## 4.2.0 — Regional furniture, mounts and the Voice's guidance

- **Regional furniture**: each of the 24 areas has its own set of 19 pieces, 456 in all — table, chair, work bench, door, platform, bed, dresser, bookcase, sofa, bathtub, toilet, sink, clock, piano, candle, candelabra, chandelier, lantern and lamp — drawn with that area's own furniture art (named area + piece, such as the Greenpath table). They are made from that area's block only, lights also take plain Torches, and none waits for a stage: the work bench (10 blocks) and platforms (1 block makes 2) by hand; the rest at a work bench — table 8, chair 4, door 6, bed 15, dresser 16, bookcase 20, sofa 5, bathtub 14, toilet 6, sink 6, clock 10, piano 15, candle 4 + 1 Torch, candelabra 6 + 3, chandelier 4 + 4, lantern 6 + 1, lamp 3 + 1.
- **The Voice's guidance**: a new save asks, after its difficulty, whether to follow the guidance (switched per save later in Terraria settings → Guidance; saves from before it start with it off). Followed, the Voice Beyond the Door, who pulled the player into Hallownest, speaks an opening at the start of a new save, then a line at the first win of each of the 48 boss fights: a word on the win, then the way to the next fight by landmarks and traits (never by name). It points first to the fights of the same stage not yet won, then to the next stage, and once nothing is left ahead, back to what is left behind; a boss beaten ahead of its stage is spoken of as usual, and an earlier stage's boss beaten afterwards gets a line of its own for the player coming back for it. It speaks once the boss's death, loot and own talk are over and the player has control again, and stops while one of the game's own talks or cutscenes plays; the lines show at the top of the screen and go into the chat, and a line still unsaid before an ending's cinematic is said after the next load. Closing words follow the last of the 48. The lines are listed in docs/神的指引-对话审阅稿.md.
- **Mounts**: Terraria's 38 ordinary mounts, worn in the mount slot and ridden with R by default, at their vanilla speeds, jumps and flight times; the stomping, charging and shooting ones hit enemies at their vanilla damage times the summon damage. They drop from bosses and ordinary enemies by stage, and riding one needs its stage; their tooltips are in English too. Sources and chances are in 坐骑获取与阶段安排.md.
- **First-kill growth**: each distinct boss's first full fight won adds 0.5 percentage points of damage reduction and 0.5 points each of melee, ranged, magic and summon damage, for good; all 48 fights (the Enraged Guardian, the Sisters of Battle, Winged Nosk and Absolute Radiance among them) give +24 points. Repeat kills and ordinary Godhome rematches add nothing more; every difficulty counts. Old saves are credited from their boss kills (the four forms that share a journal entry count from their first kill after the update).
- **Amethyst stat observer**: the observer icon beside the inventory's quick buttons opens a stats panel in four pages (Overview, Held weapon, Equipment in effect, More stats and effects): life, shield, mana, defense with forging and what it stops, damage reductions, the four classes' damage, the first-kill bonus, minion slots and sentries, regeneration and potion sickness; the held weapon's damage with the ammo it will use; speed, crit, movement, flight, mining, fishing, the buffs on you and every worn item's full effects. The solar and beetle reductions are a read-only preview: looking costs no shield or stacks.
- **Boss health curve** (Master, single player, whole fight): gentle early, steep late, first Hornet 4000 and the Radiance 200000; for example the False Knight about 3000, the Mantis Lords 8400, the Soul Master 7800, the Crystal Guardian 7440, the Watcher Knights 16800, the Broken Vessel 15600, the second Hornet 42000, Grimm 65000, the Hollow Knight 110000, the Nightmare King 140000. The gatekeeper fights before movement upgrades and key routes (Hornet, the Mantis Lords, the Soul Master, the Crystal Guardian, the Watcher Knights, the Broken Vessel, the second Hornet) have 20% more. The Failed Champion 8500, the Soul Tyrant 17000, the Lost Kin 40000, the Grey Prince 75000. Normal/Hard/Expert keep their ratios and Hollow uses Master's; phases and bodies share the whole fight's total, the vanilla phase mechanics and phase thresholds kept. The full table is docs/Boss血量全表-大师辐光20万.md.
- Abigail's Flower and the Desert Tiger grow with extra summons as in vanilla: Abigail +55% per extra slot (+130% from stage 4), the Desert Tiger's ordinary attack +40% per extra slot and its pounce from ×1.5 +40% per slot; summoning again with full slots no longer stacks, nor replaces Abigail or the tiger itself and resets its attack.
- The Shade Cloak, the Crystal Heart and the Hallownest Shield can't be dropped, thrown, sold or trashed; the Hallownest bag holds the Nail, the Dream Nail and the Hallownest Shield (31 slots, old saves' slots read as before), and with everything full they stay on the cursor rather than falling to the ground.
- The Soul Master's summon brings the player in by the upper corridor's door (Ruins1_24's right1), straight onto the first phase's floor, not down into the second phase's area first.
- Using the regional furniture: a door needs floor and ceiling, opens and shuts with a right click and by itself as you come near, residents push it open, and open or shut it mines back as the same door; a bed sets or clears your spawn point with a right click, and mining the bed clears its spawn point; chairs, sofas and toilets serve as residents' seats in the housing menu; a dresser holds 40 slots (kept in the save, locked while someone uses it in multiplayer), can't be mined while it holds anything or is open, and can be stood on, dropped through and set with small furniture; work benches and bookcases count as their crafting stations, a sink stands in for water when crafting near it, and a clock shows the time on a right click; chandeliers and lanterns hang from the ceiling and the other lights stand on the floor or a table, each with a flame matched to its area's art, flickering frame by frame and giving light, always lit; platforms are real platform cells that join, run diagonally as stairs, take half blocks, hold you up and let you drop through, and mine back as their own area's platform. Housing counts each piece as its vanilla furniture class; the furniture and the doors' open or shut state are kept in the world save and synced in multiplayer. Pianos and bathtubs are for show and count as housing furniture.
- Multiplayer fights: a boss's parts show on the joining players' screens (the parent objects and child sprites its entrance turns on are synced too), and remote objects that fail to match no longer hide the local boss. Enemies pick their target as Terraria's server does (NPC.TargetClosest), bosses included: among the living players in their room (a boss's arena), the one with the least horizontal plus vertical distance less that player's aggro; Flesh Knuckles, Putrid Scent, the Turtle, Beetle and Solar Flare armours, Hero Shield, Berserker's Glove, Recon Scope, Stalker's Quiver, Arcane Flower, the Invisibility potion and the stealth sets change aggro as in vanilla, and alert range and line of sight are checked for the chosen player. Attacks enemies release (projectiles, shockwaves and the like) hurt every player on their own side, through the usual hurt path (invincibility frames and damage reduction as normal). The protocol is now net5, so everyone needs 4.2.0.
- Multiplayer visuals: what a boss fight spawns (the boss's projectiles, floor spikes, shockwaves, battle roars and attack effects, the minions it summons) appears for the other players too, moving and animating as the original does; the objects of a boss room's overlaid boss scene and those holding its battle gates (the falling iron gates, the mechanisms that rise) are switched on and off, moved, animated and solid as in the game running the boss. An enemy that is hit shows the game's own hit flash, blood and sound for every player. An enemy that dies in another player's game leaves its corpse and death effects here the vanilla way; a boss's own death scene (the False Knight's fall, Hornet leaving, the Mantis Lords' bow and the like) plays as in the game running it.
- Multiplayer teammates: a teammate's damage numbers, their hurt and heal numbers, the Terraria dust and gores of their movement, accessories, weapons and hits (the Cloud in a Bottle's puffs, the rocket boots' flames), and the effects their Hollow Knight abilities such as spells spawn are seen by the other players in the scene.
- Multiplayer pickups: hearts and stars work as in single player, giving 20 life or 100 mana on touch and never going into the bag (a joining player claims them from the host and gets the effect at once).
- Multiplayer "Quick Stack to Nearby Chests": a chest you have open and the Piggy Bank are filled on the spot; the other chests nearby are filled by the host, and whatever doesn't fit goes back to its slot; a chest another player has open is left alone.
- Multiplayer boss fights: a boss room's overlaid boss scene ("_boss") is run by the same player's game as the room itself. The other players see an enemy's life, maximum life and defense as the game running it has them: with saves on different difficulties or progress, health bars, hover numbers and damage agree on both sides. The protocol is now net6, so everyone needs this build.
- In multiplayer, the Nail in hand hits an enemy run by another player's game with the Nail item's Terraria damage too (crits, knockback and numbers as usual), not the vanilla nail damage that took a fixed share of the enemy's life.
- The multiplayer host syncs the world by kind and only what changed: lying items every 0.1 seconds, chests, stations and Life Crystals after an action on them and every 2 seconds, terrain, walls and torches when a scene is edited and in turn; unchanged records aren't packed again, so the host's cost doesn't grow with how much of the save has been dug. Each connection's outgoing data is capped (192 KB): on a slow link the data a later copy replaces (player state, enemy and scene snapshots, projectiles, minions, dust and numbers) is skipped first, while the world, chat, deaths, hits and tile changes always go, so the host no longer piles up memory for a slow connection.
- With dialogue broadcast off, a talk cut short by a teleport or a room change takes its page arrow and end mark down with the box, instead of leaving them in the middle of the screen.
- Standing between a boss room's two battle gates counts as inside the arena: Grimm can be hit when he goes to the tent's ends, past its gates, without "Enter the boss arena first".
- The Bestiary shows drops area by area: the same enemy drops different weapons, accessories, ores and materials in different areas, so an entry's "Drop area" row lists every area it lives in (areas not yet visited in grey), and the one chosen shows the drops of a kill there, worked out as a real kill is. A search by item lists the enemies that drop it in any of their areas and switches straight to an area that does (a visited one first), rimming those areas' buttons in gold; searching an Ancient Basin material, for example, shows the Husk Hornhead's Ancient Basin drops rather than its Forgotten Crossroads ones.
- A piece of armour's name ends with its forge level and its highest, unforged ones too, e.g. "Wood Helmet(Lv.1/Lv.3)"; weapons keep "+level" after the name.
- The player's base pickup range is 80 pixels (Terraria's own is 42), for items and geo alike, with the Treasure Magnet, Gold Ring, Heartreach potion and Mana Magnet still adding theirs: what sinks to the floor of a shallow pool can be picked up while floating on it.
- In the seamless world a room's grade markers (such as the pink tint round the Grimm Troupe's tent in Dirtmouth, about 39 units across) act only while the player is in that room; in the room next door the screen has that room's own colours, and walking back the marker's tint picks up again.
- Geo drawn in by the Gold Ring and the Treasure Magnet flies through the terrain to the player as Terraria's coins do, and passes over acid without dissolving; geo already against the player is picked up as soon as it can be.
- The Discount Card (and the Greedy Ring) takes a fifth off shops, the basic items bought with geo, and the Goblin Tinkerer's forging and reforging; a forged weapon's levels sell for their full-price share.
- The Warding reforge gives an accessory +6 defense (Terraria's +4).
- A warrior's helmet, chest and legs gain 2 defense per forge level, other armor 1. A warrior's armor is the warrior path's iron, gold, shadow, molten, titanium and beetle sets, and pieces whose own and set bonuses lean to melee (the melee helmets of cobalt, mythril, adamantite, palladium, orichalcum, hallowed and chlorophyte, the frost, turtle, solar flare, gi, squire and monk sets and so on); a piece for every class alike (the ninja set, the hardmode families' shared chests and legs) counts as other armor.
- Six accessory slots from the start (Terraria's five), one more in Master Mode and one more once the Demon Heart is eaten (after the Wall of Flesh's stage), up to eight.
- Deepnest's Dirtcarvers keep the life they have left when they burrow (in the vanilla game burrowing sets it back to their starting health).
- The Watcher Knights: the knight crushed by the chandelier counts as beaten, so the fight is won when the other five are down, with its treasure bag and loot; the same in a save where the chandelier fell before.
- A boss summon that would set the player down above acid puts them on the nearest floor or platform out of it instead (such as Uumuu's room).
- The Featherfall potion (and the Djinn's Curse) works as in Terraria: no fall damage at any time in the air, down held or not; falling, a third of the gravity and at most a third of the top fall speed, a tenth of each with up held, and the usual fall with down held.
- The Obsidian Skin potion (and the Ash Wood set with the Lava Rose) makes the player immune to acid as Terraria's makes them immune to lava, swimming in it; the Lava Charm, the Molten Charm and the Lava Skull guard for 7 seconds at a time in acid, filling again out of it, and once spent the acid hurts as usual.
- While a chest, a shop or the Goblin Tinkerer's forging / reforging is open, the four buttons beside the ammo slots (drop blacklist, Bestiary, Hallownest bag, quick shop) are hidden: they covered the chest's Loot All, and a click on the quick shop closed the chest.
- A boss's loot falls in the room at the latest 2.5 seconds after the boss bursts, or 12 seconds after it dies; the False Knight's armour idles in a looping wait, so his loot never fell and only went into the bag on leaving the room — that is fixed.
- An enemy knocked back 5 times within 3 seconds is steady for 1 second and is drawn half see-through for that second, back to normal afterwards.
- The category chosen in the crafting window filters only the window; the crafting column beside the inventory and the Guide's recipe list always list everything that can be made (bars at a Furnace, recipes for the Guide's material).
- Mining spikes cuts the spikes' own art (Forgotten Crossroads, Deepnest, the White Palace and elsewhere) along with the mined cells; mining a thorn or spike cuts only that cell, and the art and damage around it stay as they are. Vines, grass and other plants fall only with dug terrain, and only the ones whose picture crosses the dug cell.
- With the camera lock off (the game's own camera), a room's camera lock area that would put the character off the screen does not apply until the character stands where it shows them (such as the one beside the Hunter's room before the Hunter's Mark).
- The mouse cursor can be customized: "Terraria Settings → Cursor" picks Terraria's or Hollow Knight's own cursor and sets its size, color (hue / saturation / lightness), glow and pulse, with a live preview.
- Knockback pushes grow at 45% of the rate above an early broadsword's (3.5 px per tick) and stop at 6.5, the crit's ×1.4 counted before the squeeze: the Enchanted Boomerang and the Spear throw light enemies such as Volatile Mosskins 3–5 units; a ground enemy hit again while braking from a launch is launched as a ground enemy and keeps its weight.
- On Master (and Hollow) the death's shade keeps half of the inventory's Geo and the other half is lost; striking the shade gives it back, and dying again before that loses the old shade's Geo.
- The Smart Cursor picks chests as Terraria's Smart Interact does: chests within reach get a grey outline, the one nearest the cursor a gold one, and a right click opens it (areas' supply chests and your own chests included).
- Tiktiks' ground rays pass through one-way colliders such as station tops and platforms, so they crawl only on real terrain and solid blocks; a tiktik going round a 1.5-unit loop for 4 seconds is set on a long enough stretch of ground nearby and crawls on from there.
- An enemy driven into the ground and held there for over a second (a Squit dashing into Greenpath's wooden bridge) is moved to the nearest open place; burrowers, wall dwellers and bosses are left alone.
- The F8 spot report lists the enemies nearby: their body's place, how much of it is in solid cells, and their body's velocity.
- A thorn bush (Greenpath, the Queen's Gardens and elsewhere) is dozens of sprites from the far foreground to behind the gameplay plane, and every one of them is cut in the mined cells. Touching thorns is judged cell by cell: a thorn cell that can still be mined hurts; mined cells, solid ground and cells the thorns' edge only grazes don't.
- Fishing poles swing as in Terraria: one swing to cast and one to reel in, each with the swing sound.
- Holding Down drops through platforms, and letting go lands you on the next platform below; only you pass through, and enemies standing on the platforms stay put.
- Terraria's liquid: water and acid (in the place of lava) flow by Terraria's rules — down first, then levelling with up to three cells either side, resting once still; acid flows slowly, as lava does. Water meeting acid turns to obsidian. A block placed in liquid deletes that cell's liquid; dig the block out and the liquid around flows in and its level drops.
- Buckets and sponges: the Empty Bucket scoops a bucketful from liquid (more than 100 in the 3×3 around; Hollow Knight's own water and acid pools fill it too, staying as they are) and becomes a Water or Acid Bucket; those pour a full cell and give the Empty Bucket back; the Bottomless Water and Acid Buckets pour forever; the Super Absorbant Sponge soaks up water and the Acid Absorbant Sponge acid, endlessly. The Bottomless Water Bucket is made by hand from an Empty Bucket by water, the Bottomless Acid Bucket by acid; the Bottomless Water Bucket and the Super Absorbant Sponge are also Angler rewards (the Bottomless Water Bucket for sure at the 25th quest, and a chance for each from 10 quests on), and the Bottomless Acid Bucket and the Acid Absorbant Sponge are also fished in acid (legendary, 1/3).
- Poured liquid is drawn as Terraria draws water: water as its own water, acid as the jungle's green water, each cell's frame picked by its open sides (surface, edges, inside), a cell partly full drawn to its level, the 16 frames of the wave animation; clearer than Terraria's, closer to Hallownest's clear water. A surface 3 cells deep or more is swum in like Hollow Knight's pools, and acid hurts as theirs does. It fishes: with Terraria's amount of water (under 75 tiles nothing bites, under 300 the power is cut), catching the area's own crate at the vanilla biome crate chance, so the Dream and the other areas without water of their own give their crates this way; Hollow Knight's pools fish at any size. Recipes that need water or acid nearby count poured liquid too.
- Obsidian: made where water meets acid; mined (a 55% pickaxe) it drops Obsidian, which places as a block.
- On the full map and the corner map, the room the Knight is in is drawn over the rest: a neighbouring room's passages lying over its rock are covered by it, so the map round the Knight is the room as it is.
- The world map laid out again: about a third fewer places where one room is drawn over another's passages or rock, as many gates meeting and less misfit in all (Crossroads_11_alt and Greenpath's Fungus1_08 lie less than half as much over Crossroads_12 and Crossroads_35). About 76 gate pairs of the game's loops still can't meet on a flat map, and the map marks them with arrows as before.

Validation: the Release build succeeds; the regional furniture suite (2,426 furniture checks, 1,032 crafting-window checks, 925 vanilla recipe checks) and the two-player combat cases pass in test copies. This version is not published and has not had a full play-through. To install, close the game, copy TerraKnight.dll / .pdb over BepInEx\plugins\TerraKnight and start it with the 空洞泰拉.bat launcher.

name: TerraKnight v4.1.0
body:
## 4.1.0 — 修复与平衡补丁

- 下调残破容器血量：普通／困难／专家／大师（空洞）分别为 40000／51000／56000／71400，失落近亲保持独立数值。
- 核查全部 79 件魔法武器蓝耗，移除阶段平衡对蓝耗的覆盖，修复其中 74 件偏低问题；水矢恢复 10、月曜 9、终极棱镜每次扣费 12。修复持续施法不读取重铸减蓝词缀的问题，保留连发周期与持续光束各自的扣费时机。
- Wiki 合成配方改为每页 40 条、按需加载；图鉴首次显示 60 条，全文搜索内容在输入关键词后再加载。
- 新增“空洞”难度：暂时沿用大师的数值、掉落、减伤和饰品栏规则，仅此难度恢复原版面具数量增伤；大师及以下不再叠加面具数量。已有存档难度保持不变。
- 盔甲锻造上限随装备阶段变为 +3、+6、+9、+12、+15、+18，每级 +1 防御；单件敲满总价仍约 5000–30000 吉欧，不含失败消耗，成功率仍为 50%。旧装备超出新上限的等级保留。
- 稀有特殊装备增加第二种普通怪物获取来源，优先分散到另一地区；每次仍只掉一件。基础掉率至少普通怪 1%、精英 2.5%，已有较高概率再提高约 25%。
- 所有普通饰品统一提高掉率：普通怪共享饰品池 2%→3%，精英 5%→7.5%，候选较多时增加有限的池预算；首领重复击杀饰品池 20%→25%。闪亮红气球等探索饰品同样生效。
- 修复幸运币在召唤物、部分哨兵及其他命中入口不触发的问题；钱币戒指和贪婪戒指同步生效，铜币零钱增加可见入账提示，避免同一击重复抽选。
- 宝藏磁铁（游戏内名“宝藏磁石”）现在也能吸引吉欧。额外范围为 150 像素，与金戒指同时装备时使用较大范围，不重复相加。
- 掉落物黑名单、怪物图鉴、圣巢背包和快捷商店四个按钮移到弹药栏右侧，尺寸保持不变。
- 梦魇之王格林在死亡演出完成后、离开梦境前直接发放战利品，不再等待场景卸载。
- 修复箱子重命名和图鉴搜索的中文输入：显式启用输入法、显示组合文字、定位候选框，处理候选词 Enter/Esc/退格与保存/退出冲突，恢复焦点及键盘设备切换后的输入。

验证：Release 构建与对应离线逻辑回归；本次未进行实机游玩和完整联机测试。安装时退出游戏，将压缩包解压覆盖到游戏目录，再通过原来的“空洞泰拉.bat”启动。

---

## 4.1.0 — Fixes and balance patch

- Reduced Broken Vessel health to 40000/51000/56000/71400 on Normal/Hard/Expert/Master (Hollow). Lost Kin retains its separate budget.
- Audited all 79 magic weapons and restored Terraria mana defaults, fixing 74 reduced costs. Water Bolt costs 10, Lunar Flare 9 and Last Prism 12 per payment. Held spells now honor mana prefix modifiers, preserving burst and channel payment timing.
- Wiki recipes now load on demand in pages of 40. Catalogs initially render 60 entries, with full search data loaded only when a query is entered.
- Added Hollow difficulty: currently inherits Master's stats, loot, defense rules and accessory slots, but restores original mask-count damage multipliers. Master and lower difficulties keep normalized single-hit damage. Existing saves retain their difficulty.
- Armor forging caps now scale by equipment stage: +3, +6, +9, +12, +15 and +18, with +1 defense per level. Full-upgrade prices remain about 5,000–30,000 Geo per piece, excluding failures. The 50% success rate and legacy over-cap levels remain.
- Specialty equipment gains a second ordinary-monster source, preferably in another eligible region. It still drops one item at a time, with modest independent chance increases.
- Increased general accessory pool rates: ordinary enemies 2% to 3%, elites 5% to 7.5%, and repeat-boss pools 20% to 25%, with bounded compensation for large pools. Includes exploration items such as the Shiny Red Balloon.
- Fixed Lucky Coin effects missing from minion, sentry and other hit paths; Coin Ring and Greedy Ring inherit the fix. Copper change now has a visible payout notice, without duplicate rolls.
- Treasure Magnet now attracts Geo too, adding 150 pixels of range. Combined with Gold Ring, the larger range applies instead of adding both bonuses.
- Moved the blacklist, Bestiary, Hallownest bag and quick-shop buttons beside the ammo column without changing their size.
- Nightmare King Grimm now pays loot after his death sequence, before leaving the dream.
- Fixed Chinese IME support in chest renaming and Bestiary search, including composition, candidate positioning, Enter/Esc/Backspace conflicts, focus recovery and keyboard replacement.

Validation: Release build and relevant offline logic checks. No gameplay or full multiplayer testing was performed for this patch. Exit the game, extract the archive over the game folder, then launch through the existing TerraKnight BAT.

name: 空洞泰拉 TerraKnight v4.0.0
body:
**神居上地图；地区方块、火把、储物箱和钓鱼宝匣；泰拉瑞亚的房屋系统；旗帜、药水箱和掉落物黑名单；首领的血量、掉落和战斗流程整体调整。**

下载 `TerraKnight-v4.0.0.zip`，解压到空洞骑士游戏目录，双击 `空洞泰拉.bat` 开始玩；安装步骤见 [docs/INSTALL.md](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md)。联机时所有玩家都要用 4.0.0。

## 更新内容

- **首领战**
  - 首领的场地只认站在场地里的玩家：在隔壁房间碰到开战机关（比如在假骑士下面的房间飞到顶）不会开打，也不会把人关在门外；走进场地时还碰着机关就照常开打。
  - 首领在初次醒来、吼叫等出场动画期间不受伤害（泰拉武器、原版骨钉、持续伤害、召唤物和联机伤害都一样），正式开战后的吼叫照常能打。
  - 召唤物、哨兵和它们的弹幕、星尘守卫的拳击打首领和精英时只扣血：不累积硬直，首领收不到受击，招式不会被打断，也不会引得它们闪避、反击或瞬移。玩家自己的攻击（包括鞭子）照常。
  - 首领的战利品等死亡演出放完才掉，落在身体最后所在的位置（假骑士盔甲里的虫子爆开、格鲁兹之母和灵魂大师爆开之后）；身体一直留着的（如螳螂领主鞠躬）最多等 6 秒；演出结束前离开房间，战利品直接进背包。普通掉落、圣物和首杀生命水晶一起结算。
  - 多身体首领（螳螂领主、灵魂大师、守望者骑士、骨钉大师兄弟、奥波路波、反击蝇之王）在最后一具身体倒下时才记一次击杀并掉落，还没登场或暂时隐藏的身体也算在内；诺斯克、加利安在死亡演出结束时当场结算。
  - 首领召唤物：每个首领都有确认过的落脚点，召唤物、创造模式图鉴挑战和联机跟随者落在同一处，直接站在战斗那一层（假骑士在上层开战地板，乌姆在战斗区底层，灵魂大师在第一阶段战斗层，收藏家在上层战斗区）。螳螂领主、辐光和七位战士之梦走原版的挑战提示；纯粹容器、奥罗与马托、席奥、斯莱、奥波路波、神之驯服者走原版的神居入场点。
  - 召唤梦魇之王格林后跳过镜头平移、眼睛、剪影和标题，直接开战；用召唤物直接去王国边缘打二见大黄蜂时，只留下战斗本体，她的剧情出场对象在挑战结束后恢复。
  - 用召唤物重打已击败的地图首领时，重新载入原版战斗子场景、复位战斗控制，再开场关门；叛徒领主、收藏家、水晶守卫（守卫晶镜）都能重打。
  - **愚人斗兽场门票**：取代双生酸囊和驯神兽笛，在砧上用 12 钴矿 + 4 火焰花合成；在任意地点使用都传送到愚人斗兽场门口，在那里报名试炼，到达时才消耗；在梦境、神居、斗兽场里或阶段 4 之前不能用，也不消耗。旧存档里的这两种召唤物换成门票。
  - 大黄蜂压制空洞骑士期间保留原版的梦之钉入梦，泰拉的附加伤害、召唤物和持续伤害暂停；辐光战前空洞骑士倒地等梦之钉时，泰拉梦之钉、持续伤害、召唤物和哨兵都打不中它。
  - 坐在长椅上使用召唤物时先离开坐姿，坐姿不会被带进战斗和之后的梦醒。神居或梦境挑战失败后从普通门回到没有梦醒门的房间时（例如奥波路波的挑战回到王国边缘），补完梦醒收尾：清掉白屏，恢复操作、重力和生命。

- **首领血量**
  - 地图上初战的首领血量按阶段提高：阶段 0 +10%、1 +16%、2 +25%、3 +35%、4 +45%、5 +60%。
  - 后期首领和梦境首领各有一份整场血量（普通难度单人；专家、大师按各自对应的泰拉首领放大，多阶段、多身体按份额分摊；图鉴显示整场血量，血条显示当前身体或阶段）：蜂巢骑士 50,000，失败冠军 100,000，灵魂暴君 120,000，失落近亲 110,000，奥波路波 90,000（两只各一半），神之驯服者 85,000，左特 12,000，王国边缘的大黄蜂 80,000，马科斯 75,000，残破容器 65,000，格林 100,000，白色防御者 120,000，灰色王子左特 100,000，梦魇之王 160,000，空洞骑士 140,000，奥罗与马托 140,000，席奥 150,000，斯莱 160,000，纯粹容器 200,000，辐光 220,000。
  - 假骑士的铠甲和头按 10:3 分血，头继承首领身份和神居倍率。
  - 神居里重打的首领各有整场血量（普通难度、挑战档位之前）：假骑士 100,000，格鲁兹之母 70,000，躁郁的毛里克 85,000，大黄蜂 95,000，大型苔藓冲锋者 80,000，戈布 75,000，无眼 85,000，粪虫防御者 105,000，叛徒领主 115,000，螳螂领主 130,000，灵魂大师 115,000，乌姆 95,000，吸虫之母 85,000，水晶守卫 95,000，胡长老 80,000，马尔穆 85,000，守望者骑士 145,000，收藏家 110,000，诺斯克 115,000，加利安 90,000，泽若 85,000；神居专属房间：大黄蜂 125,000，狂暴水晶守卫 120,000，战斗姐妹 170,000，翼诺斯克 140,000，无上辐光 300,000。
  - 神居挑战档位单独调整首领的生命 / 防御 / 伤害，和地图进度、装备无关：众神堂调谐 ×1.30 / ×1.25+5 / ×1.25，飞升 ×1.70 / ×1.50+8 / ×1.45，辐辉 ×2.10 / ×1.80+10 / ×1.70；万神殿第一至第五门生命 ×1.4 / 1.7 / 2.0 / 2.4 / 2.9，防御 ×1.25+5 至 ×1.9+10，伤害 ×1.2 至 ×1.75。

- **首领掉落与奖励**
  - 每个首领第一次被击败时，每个角色得到 1 个生命水晶：多阶段首领整场一次，两次大黄蜂分开算，重打和宝藏袋不给，更新前已击败的首领不补发；联机时每人按自己的存档各领一份。图鉴只在还能领时显示这份奖励。
  - 每个首领必掉一件招牌物品（和四职业奖励、饰品抽取分开）：假骑士 皇家凝胶，格鲁兹之母 史莱姆鞭子，躁郁的毛里克 血腥砍刀，反击蝇之王 史莱姆法杖，大黄蜂 克苏鲁护盾，大型苔藓冲锋者 毒刺项链，戈布 甜心项链，无眼 泰拉魔刃，螳螂领主 骨头手套，灵魂战士 天界手铐，灵魂大师 魔力花，水晶守卫 岩浆骷髅头，粪虫防御者 蠕虫围巾，吸虫之母 混乱之脑，乌姆 黑曜石护盾，胡长老 蜂巢球，马尔穆 星星面纱，叛徒领主 孢子囊，失败冠军 骸骨头盔，守望者骑士 战士徽章，收藏家 魔力斗篷，诺斯克 星星斗篷，加利安 冰冻海龟壳，泽若 强力手套，灵魂暴君 巫士徽章，蜂巢骑士 蜂巢背包，王国边缘的大黄蜂 黑腰带，残破容器 召唤师徽章，失落近亲 挥发明胶，马科斯 潜行者箭袋，奥波路波 游侠徽章，神之驯服者 闪亮石，左特 解压球，苍白潜伏者 十字章护盾，格林 烈火手套，梦魇之王 翱翔徽章，白色防御者 冰冻护盾，灰色王子左特 甲虫莎草纸，空洞骑士 毁灭者徽章，奥罗与马托 英雄护盾，席奥 天界徽章，斯莱 忍者大师装备，纯粹容器 天界贝壳，辐光 重力球。
  - 克苏鲁护盾、皇家凝胶、蠕虫围巾、混乱之脑、骨头手套、骸骨头盔、蜂巢背包、孢子囊、闪亮石、翱翔徽章、重力球只从各自的首领获得。

- **怪物与掉落**
  - 小怪和精英的生命按阶段提高：阶段 0–5 分别 ×1.05 / 1.10 / 1.18 / 1.25 / 1.65 / 2.8。
  - 敌人每格面具的伤害（大师基准）阶段 0–5 为 32 / 48 / 68 / 96 / 132 / 176；尖刺等环境伤害为 20 / 30 / 42 / 58 / 76 / 100。

  - 地区普通敌人掉的装备和矿石最高到该地区的档位 +1（国王山道、遗忘十字路 0 档，神居 5 档）。20 种可冶炼矿、七种宝石、黑曜石和坚固化石都有同期来源；钨、金、铂在阶段 0 就能拿到，王国边缘和斗兽场直接掉秘银、山铜、精金、钛金。
  - 普通怪 10%、精英 24% 掉一件稀有装备，其中七成是武器（普通怪约 7%、精英约 16.8%），其余是盔甲和饰品。
  - 升阶后保留旧阶段的掉落：同一次抽取里当期物品合占 70%、旧阶段合占 30%；同一资源池里当期材料的权重 ×1.15、旧期 ×0.85。
  - 每种材料按稀有度决定数量（普通怪 / 精英 / 首领）：常规矿 2–4 / 3–6 / 6–12，高级矿 1–3 / 2–5 / 4–8；稀有度 0 的材料 2–5 / 3–7 / 5–12，稀有度 1 的 1–3 / 2–4 / 3–8，稀有度 2–4 的 1–2 / 1–3 / 2–6，稀有度 5 以上 1 / 1–2 / 2–4；黑晶状体、海龟壳等特殊材料 1 个（首领 1–2 个）。狱石：普通怪 65% 掉 2–4，精英必掉 3–6；黑曜石：普通怪 60% 掉 1–3，精英必掉 2–4。

  - 图鉴里分组掉落的概率和实际抽取一致（同一组用同一个概率）。
  - 刷怪倍率多刷出的爬虫（提克提克等）只放在摸得到地面的地方，贴着地形爬，不在空中打转。

- **战斗与数值**
  - 防御按泰拉瑞亚原版结算：每点防御在普通和困难难度抵 0.5 伤害，专家 0.75，大师 1；先按难度缩放敌人伤害，再扣防御，再算百分比减伤、套装效果和护盾，最少 1 点。
  - 魔力病：每喝一瓶魔力药水加 5 秒（最多 10 秒），每剩 1 秒魔法伤害 −5%（最多 −50%）；快捷回蓝和魔力花也算，魔力星和自然回蓝不算。
  - 击退：敌人还在被击飞或滑行时，后续命中不会把它推得更远（天顶剑、狂星之怒这类连击不会把怪托着飞过整个房间），这几下照样计入连续击退的次数；普通敌人和精英 3 秒内被击退 5 次后稳住 1 秒。刻尘者被击退时不离开它贴着走的地形。
  - 只有单向举盾的敌人（躯壳哨兵、躯壳战士等）会把弹幕反弹回来，反弹的弹幕是一颗慢速的红色能量球（伤害为原弹幕的 1/4，存在 6 秒，碰到地形消失）；钻地、躲草丛、蜷起来的巴德尔长者这类全方位无敌的敌人只吸收弹幕。
  - 旗帜放在背包、存钱罐或旗帜盒里就生效：打这种怪的伤害普通 ×1.5、困难 ×1.75、专家及以上 ×2，受到它（包括它的弹幕）的伤害 ×0.75 / ×0.625 / ×0.5。
  - 星尘守卫只在真正打中时消耗命中冷却，每个守卫单独计，拳击会被盾挡住。被盾挡下或原版拒绝的命中不消耗之前累积的伤害余数。
  - 武器：罗马短剑 18、标尺 15、叶绿军刀 40（按每个使用间隔刺一次计算）；灰烬木剑 29、灰烬木弓 30、珍珠木剑 33、珍珠木弓 36（排在同阶段金属武器之下）；金、铂金、钨的阔剑、短剑和弓在阶段 0，灰冲击枪阶段 1，代码2球和左轮手枪阶段 4，脉冲弓阶段 5。
  - 骷髅头法书的骷髅存在 3 秒或累计飞行 640 像素，最多命中 3 次，同一目标 20 帧冷却，240 像素内索敌、超过 480 像素放弃追踪；雨云魔杖和猩红魔杖的云持续 30 秒。
  - 日曜套装的护盾平时按角色朝向环绕，使用物品时跟着使用方向。
  - 水矢、月曜、火花等由粒子组成的弹幕在粒子池满时轮流复用旧粒子，持续施法时不会看不见。

- **能力与移动**
  - 暗影冲刺是空洞骑士原版的直线冲刺（原版速度和时长），冷却和原版一样 1.5 秒；水晶之心和圣巢之盾的超级冲刺和原版一样没有冷却。
  - 超级冲刺和暗影冲刺撞到的敌人按克苏鲁护盾冲撞的伤害挨打（30 伤害、击退 9、4% 暴击），每次冲刺每只敌人一下，人不会被弹回；超级冲刺途中撞上敌人身体不受伤（它的弹幕照样伤人）。
  - 新选项“骨钉朝鼠标劈砍”（默认关）：骨钉和梦之钉朝鼠标方向 360° 挥砍，后坐力和下劈弹跳仍按原版的四个方向。
  - 从下方或侧面穿过单向平台不算撞头，跳跃不会被截断；平台所在区块重建后重新生成碰撞，看得见的平台都踩得住。
  - 获得的圣巢能力物品存进圣巢背包；旧版本没送到的水晶之心、暗影披风补发一次。
  - 视野缩放（泰拉瑞亚的缩放）：按住 = 放大、- 缩小，范围 1–2（2 是空洞骑士原本的视野，1 能看到两倍范围），可在键位设置里改键；小地图缩放用地图缩放键（默认小键盘 +/-）。
  - 镜头锁开启时，首领战视角始终以玩家为中心，首领阶段的镜头定格和平移不移动视角，屏幕震动幅度为 0（关掉镜头锁后恢复原设置）。

- **背包、制作与锻造**
  - 背包右下角有 4 个按钮：掉落物黑名单、怪物图鉴、圣巢背包、快捷商店（快捷出售与买回），同一时间只开一个面板。
  - **掉落物黑名单**（每个存档一份）：拿着物品点格子加入（物品不消耗），空手点或右键移除；名单上的物品捡到时、首领奖励发放时按商店售价自动卖掉，不占背包；收藏物品、圣巢关键物品、货币、心、星和任务鱼不会被卖，购买、合成和从箱子里取出的也不卖。
  - 圣巢背包 29 格：20 个普通格、1 个梦之钉格和 8 个能力奖励专用格（克苏鲁护盾、攀爬爪、云朵瓶、赫尔墨斯靴、脚蹼、重锤符文、暗影披风、水晶之心）；背包满了也能领能力奖励，Shift+点击把能力物品放回专用格。
  - 圣巢关键物品放在圣巢背包、背包、快捷栏或宠物栏里就生效，不用拿在手上：城门认徽章，黑暗房间靠光蝇灯笼照亮，电车认车票，深渊之门认国王之魂，兄弟姐妹和辐光认虚空之心；之前拒绝过的机关，带上物品后重新检查。光蝇灯笼可以当照明宠物（发蓝白光）；格林之子放进宠物栏或使用即召出原版的格林之子，并算作佩戴了这个护符。
  - 制作窗口（点制作列旁的锤子打开）：11 个分类标签和“全部”按钮，写明每次做几个，每行 10 格可滚动，按住连续制作，Shift 一次做 10 个。关闭背包时制作窗口、圣巢背包和黑名单一起关上；悬停提示画在所有面板之上。
  - 配方只看材料、附近的工作站和环境，没有阶段门槛，进度决定材料从哪里来；用吉欧买的基础物品按阶段解锁。地区宝匣和秘匣只能钓到，地区储物箱用 30 个当地方块在工作台制作，长椅和德特茅斯都不卖；基础制作栏里只有真正的物品（不会出现不要钱的空物品）。
  - **锻造**：武器的上限看武器自己的阶段（阶段 0 +5，每高一阶段多 5 级，阶段 5 +30），骨钉和梦之钉看玩家阶段；锻满时显示“武器已满级，无法再锻造”，老存档里超过上限的武器保留原等级。
  - **盔甲锻造**：哥布林工匠的锻造格写着“将武器或盔甲放到此处锻造”；盔甲每件最多 +5，每级 +1 防御（头、身、腿合计最多 +15），每级 500 吉欧 ×（盔甲阶段 + 1）×（1 + 等级 / 2），一件从 +0 到 +5 共 5,000 吉欧（阶段 0）到 30,000 吉欧（阶段 5）；界面显示“防御 X → Y”，提示写“锻造 +N：防御 +M”。
  - 卖出锻造过的装备额外得到锻造花费的 1/5。锻造成功时新名字在角色头上弹出，锻满时彩色循环，带音效和彩虹火花。
  - 重铸有最低价：1 吉欧 ×（稀有度 + 1）×（阶段 + 1）；每次重铸单独弹出结果，抽到最佳前缀时文字彩虹变色、播放专属音效，锤子锁定 1 秒（这期间点击不扣钱）。
  - 钱币栏 4 格，吉欧和梦境精华放哪格都行；梦境精华是钱币栏里的物品（背包和个人储物里的都算数，梦之门先扣背包里的，死亡不丢）。吉欧放在存钱罐、保险箱、护卫熔炉、虚空保险库里买东西时都能用；捡起吉欧时头上弹出数额（包括中吉欧）。吉欧和梦境精华不能卖给商店，快捷出售也不卖货币。

- **新物品与收纳**
  - **旗帜**：每个图鉴条目一面（约 130 面）。**旗帜盒**（4 页 × 40 格，织布机：箱子 + 10 丝绸）：带在身上时捡到的旗帜自动收进去。
  - **药水箱**（3 页 × 40 格，玻璃瓶旁：箱子 + 10 玻璃瓶）：带在身上时自动收药水；快速治疗、快速魔力、快速增益也用箱里的（有更强的先用更强的）。同一种增益药水攒满 20 瓶后 Alt+左键收藏，收藏后这种增益一直生效、不消耗药水。
  - **自动出售袋**（织布机：10 丝绸 + 存钱罐）：放进去的物品加入名单并当场按商店价卖掉；带在身上时捡到名单上的物品自动卖掉。

**Godhome on the map; area blocks, torches, chests and fishing crates; Terraria's housing; banners, the Potion Box and the loot blacklist; boss life, loot and fight flow reworked.**

Download `TerraKnight-v4.0.0.zip`, unzip it into the Hollow Knight game folder and double-click `空洞泰拉.bat`; see [docs/INSTALL.en.md](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.en.md). Everyone in a multiplayer game needs 4.0.0.

## Changes

- **Boss fights**
  - A boss's arena answers only to a player standing in it: touching its fight trigger from the next room (say, flying to the ceiling of the room under the False Knight) starts no fight and shuts no one out; walking into the arena while still touching the trigger starts it as usual.
  - Bosses take no damage while they first wake, roar or play their entrance (Terraria weapons, the vanilla nail, damage over time, minions and multiplayer hits alike); roars in the fight proper can be hit as usual.
  - Minions, sentries, their shots and the Stardust Guardian's punches only take life from bosses and elites: no stagger builds up and the boss never hears the hit, so its attacks are not interrupted and it does not dodge, counter or teleport because of them. The player's own attacks (whips included) work as usual.
  - Boss loot waits for the death sequence and falls where the body last was (after the maggot bursts out of the False Knight's armour, after the Gruz Mother and the Soul Master burst); bodies that stay (such as the bowing Mantis Lords) wait at most 6 seconds; leave the room before the end and the loot goes straight to your bag. Regular loot, relics and the first-kill Life Crystal are settled together.
  - Multi-body bosses (Mantis Lords, Soul Master, Watcher Knights, the Nailmaster brothers, Oblobbles, Vengefly Kings) count one kill and drop their loot when the last body falls, bodies not yet out or hidden for now included; Nosk and Galien settle as their death sequence ends.
  - Boss seals: every boss has a checked landing spot. Seals, creative bestiary challenges and multiplayer followers arrive at the same place, standing on the fight's own floor (the False Knight's upper fight floor, the bottom of Uumuu's fight area, the Soul Master's first-phase floor, the Collector's upper fight area). The Mantis Lords, the Radiance and the seven Warrior's Dreams use the game's own challenge prompts; the Pure Vessel, Oro & Mato, Sheo, Sly, the Oblobbles and the God Tamer use the game's Godhome entrances.
  - Summoning the Nightmare King Grimm skips the camera pan, the eyes, the silhouette and the title and starts the fight at once. Going straight to Hornet Sentinel at Kingdom's Edge with a seal leaves only her fight body; her story entrance comes back after the challenge.
  - Rematching a beaten map boss with a seal reloads the game's own fight sub-scene and resets its battle control before the intro and the gates; the Traitor Lord, the Collector and the Crystal Guardian (Guardian's Mirror) can all be fought again.
  - **Colosseum Ticket**: replaces the Twin Acid Sacs and the God Tamer's whistle; crafted at an anvil from 12 Cobalt Ore + 4 Fireblossom. Used anywhere, it takes you to the door of the Colosseum of Fools, where you sign up for a trial; it is spent on arrival. It cannot be used (and is not spent) in dreams, Godhome, the Colosseum or before stage 4. Old saves' two seals become tickets.
  - While Hornet pins the Hollow Knight down, the game's own Dream Nail entry stays and Terraria's extra damage, minions and damage over time pause; while the Hollow Knight lies waiting for the Dream Nail before the Radiance, the Terraria Dream Nail, damage over time, minions and sentries cannot hit it.
  - Using a seal on a bench stands you up first, so sitting is never carried into the fight or a later waking. After losing a Godhome or dream challenge and coming back through an ordinary door to a room with no dream gate (such as from the Oblobbles' challenge back to Kingdom's Edge), the waking is finished: the white screen clears and control, gravity and life come back.

- **Boss life**
  - Map bosses on their first fight have more life by stage: +10% at stage 0, +16% at 1, +25% at 2, +35% at 3, +45% at 4, +60% at 5.

Hellstone: common enemies 65% for 2–4, elites always 3–6; Obsidian: common enemies 60% for 1–3, elites always 2–4.

  - The extra crawlers (Tiktiks and others) of the spawn multiplier are placed only where they can feel the ground and crawl along the terrain, never circling in the air.

- **Combat and numbers**
  - Defense works as in Terraria: each point takes off 0.5 damage on Normal and Hard, 0.75 on Expert and 1 on Master; enemy damage is scaled by difficulty first, then defense comes off, then percentage reductions, set bonuses and shields, at least 1.
  - Mana Sickness: each mana potion adds 5 seconds (10 at most), and each second left takes 5% off magic damage (50% at most); quick mana and the Mana Flower count, mana stars and natural regeneration do not.
  - Knockback: an enemy still flying or sliding from a hit is pushed no further by the hits that follow (the Zenith and Star Wrath do not carry an enemy across the room), and those hits still count toward the knockback streak; common enemies and elites knocked back 5 times in 3 seconds stay steady for 1 second. A knocked-back Crawlid keeps to the terrain it crawls on.
  - Only enemies with a shield on one side (Husk Sentries, Husk Warriors and the like) reflect projectiles; a reflected shot is a slow red energy ball (a quarter of the shot's damage, lasting 6 seconds, gone on hitting terrain). Enemies invulnerable all round (burrowed, hiding in grass, a curled-up Elder Baldur) just absorb shots.
  - Banners work when carried in the bag, the Piggy Bank or the Banner Box: damage to that enemy ×1.5 on Normal, ×1.75 on Hard and ×2 on Expert and up; damage from it (its shots included) ×0.75 / ×0.625 / ×0.5.
  - The Stardust Guardian spends its hit cooldown only on a real hit, each guardian on its own, and shields block its punches. Hits blocked by a shield or refused by the game keep the damage remainder saved up so far.
  - Weapons: Gladius 18, Ruler 15, Chlorophyte Saber 40 (counted as one stab per use); Ash Wood Sword 29, Ash Wood Bow 30, Pearlwood Sword 33, Pearlwood Bow 36 (below their stage's metal weapons); the Gold, Platinum and Tungsten broadswords, shortswords and bows at stage 0; the Gray Zapinator at stage 1, Code 2 and the Revolver at stage 4, the Pulse Bow at stage 5.
  - The Book of Skulls' skulls last 3 seconds or 640 pixels of flight, hit at most 3 times with a 20-tick cooldown per target, seek within 240 pixels and give up past 480; the Nimbus Rod's and Crimson Rod's clouds last 30 seconds.
  - The Solar armour's shields circle by the character's facing, and by the direction of use while using an item.
  - Projectiles made of particles (Water Bolt, the Lunar Flare, sparks and the like) reuse the oldest particles when the pool is full, so they stay visible while casting continuously.

- **Abilities and movement**
  - The shadow dash is Hollow Knight's own straight dash (its speed and length) with the game's 1.5 s cooldown; the Crystal Heart's and Hallownest Shield's super dash has no cooldown, as in the game.
  - Enemies hit by the super dash or the shadow dash take the Shield of Cthulhu's ram damage (30 damage, knockback 9, 4% crit), once per enemy per dash, without bouncing you back; enemy bodies do not hurt you during a super dash (their projectiles still do).
  - New option "Nail aims at the mouse" (off by default): the nail and the Dream Nail swing towards the mouse through 360°, with recoil and the pogo bounce still in the game's four directions.
  - Passing through a one-way platform from below or the side is no head bump and does not cut a jump short; platforms get their collision back after their chunk is rebuilt, so every platform you see can be stood on.
  - Hallownest abilities' items go to the Hallownest bag; a Crystal Heart or Shade Cloak an older version failed to give is handed over once.
  - View zoom (Terraria's zoom): hold = to zoom in and - to zoom out, between 1 and 2 (2 is Hollow Knight's own view, 1 shows twice as much), rebindable in the key settings; the minimap zooms with the map zoom keys (numpad +/- by default).
  - With the camera lock on, boss fights stay centred on the player, boss phases' camera holds and pans do not move the view, and screen shake is zero (your settings come back when the lock is off).

- **Inventory, crafting and forging**
  - Four buttons at the inventory's lower right: Loot Blacklist, Bestiary, Hallownest bag, Quick Shop (quick selling and buyback); one panel open at a time.
  - **Loot Blacklist** (one per save): click a slot with an item to add it (the item stays yours), click empty-handed or right-click to remove; listed items are sold at shop price as they are picked up or handed out as boss rewards, taking no bag space. Favourites, Hallownest key items, money, hearts, stars and quest fish are never sold, nor anything bought, crafted or taken from a chest.
  - The Hallownest bag has 29 slots: 20 ordinary ones, a Dream Nail slot and 8 slots kept for ability rewards (Shield of Cthulhu, Climbing Claws, Cloud in a Bottle, Hermes Boots, Flipper, Ram Rune, Shade Cloak, Crystal Heart); ability rewards arrive even with a full bag, and Shift+click puts an ability item back in its slot.
  - Hallownest key items work from the Hallownest bag, the bag, the hotbar or a pet slot, without being held: city gates check the crest, dark rooms light up with the Lumafly Lantern, the tram checks the pass, the Abyss door checks the Kingsoul, the Siblings and the Radiance check the Void Heart; mechanisms that turned you away ask again once you carry the item. The Lumafly Lantern works as a light pet (a bluish-white glow); the Grimmchild in a pet slot or used calls up the game's own Grimmchild and counts as wearing the charm.
  - The crafting window (the hammer next to the crafting column): 11 category tabs and an "All" button, how many each craft makes, rows of 10 that scroll, hold to keep crafting, Shift to make 10 at once. Closing the inventory closes the crafting window, the Hallownest bag and the blacklist with it; hover text draws over every panel.
  - Recipes go by ingredients, nearby stations and surroundings only, with no stage gate, and progress decides where the materials come from; the basic items bought for Geo unlock by stage. Area crates and coffers are only fished up, and area chests are made from 30 of the area's blocks at a Work Bench; neither is sold at benches or in Dirtmouth, and the basics list holds real items only (no empty item at no price).
  - **Forging**: a weapon's cap follows its own stage (+5 at stage 0, 5 more each stage, +30 at stage 5), the Nail's and Dream Nail's the player's stage; at the cap it says "武器已满级，无法再锻造", and old saves' weapons over the cap keep their level.
  - **Armour forging**: the Goblin Tinkerer's forge slot reads "将武器或盔甲放到此处锻造" (put a weapon or armour here); each armour piece goes up to +5 at +1 defense a level (+15 for head, body and legs together), each level costing 500 Geo × (armour stage + 1) × (1 + level / 2), so +0 to +5 costs 5,000 Geo (stage 0) to 30,000 Geo (stage 5); the panel shows "防御 X → Y" and the tooltip "锻造 +N：防御 +M".
  - Forged gear sells for a fifth of its forging cost more. A successful forge pops the new name over the character, cycling colours at the cap, with a sound and rainbow sparks.
  - Reforging has a floor price of 1 Geo × (rarity + 1) × (stage + 1); each reforge pops its own result, and the best prefix turns the text rainbow, plays its own sound and locks the hammer for 1 second (clicks then cost nothing).
  - Four coin slots, Geo and Dream Essence in any of them; Dream Essence is an item in the coin slots (the bag and personal storage count, Dream Gates take from the bag first, death does not lose it). Geo in the Piggy Bank, Safe, Defender's Forge or Void Vault pays for purchases; picking up Geo pops the amount over your head (medium Geo too). Geo and Dream Essence cannot be sold, and Quick Shop sells no money.

- **Town and housing**
  - The townsfolk panel (Terraria's housing menu): Terraria's own NPC heads, bright for those in town; pick a resident, then click a Wooden Chair to seat them by it, elsewhere in Dirtmouth to stand them by the bench, or a room to move them in; right-click a head to send them away (they stay away until placed again). It works while sitting on a bench too.
  - Residents who move in by themselves: those with shops, the Traveling Merchant, the Guide, the Nurse, the Angler; the others (Santa Claus and the Princess included) wait for you to place them.
  - **Terraria housing**: build a house in any scene outside Dirtmouth, or in a space you closed off in Dirtmouth; checks, scores and messages follow Terraria 1.4.5 (a chair, a table, a light, a door or platform, player-placed walls); "?" checks a room and says why at the bottom left; residents live in their rooms with shop and chat as usual; rooms are checked again about every 2 minutes, and a resident whose room fails moves back and says why; with the housing menu open each house shows a banner with its resident's head. The Traveling Merchant, Skeleton Merchant and Old Man take no house, and the Truffle only a mushroom one.
  - Residents open doors and close them two cells behind them, stand on floors and roofs you build, and walk 16 units either way along the street (homed at the bench) or within 4 units of their chair.

  - Smart cursor: walls only fill in the room you are in, at the visible cell nearest the mouse; torches go to the nearest dark spot with no torch within 8 cells; it stays out of the way while the mouse is on a torch, door, bed, chest or other interactive thing; digging can aim at spikes and thorns.
  - Furniture, chests and Life Crystals draw behind minions, pets, projectiles, residents and the player; residents draw in front of furniture and behind the player.
  - Pressing the mouse on the interface, dragging out of a panel, placing a resident or checking a house does not also use the held item or swing the nail.

- **World, digging and building**
  - **24 area blocks and background walls**: digging the original terrain drops the area's block (Stone Blocks outside the areas); a Work Bench turns 1 block into 4 walls and 4 walls back into 1 block; area walls count as player-placed walls for houses.
  - **48 area torches**, each with its own sprite, flames and light colour. Breaking pots, lamps, pillars and other breakables in a scene drops local torches or Geo (each breakable once; not in creative mode).
  - **Area chests**: a new save places chests in every area by its open space (5 in the largest, the rest in proportion, at least 1, none in Godhome), on level ground away from spikes, acid, benches, doors and boss arenas, and they show on the map once walked past; one holds a local weapon (with a random prefix), one a local accessory, the rest local materials, potions, torches and Geo, with a 1/40 chance of a pet. Each of the 24 area chests is made from 30 of the area's blocks at a Work Bench, holds 40 slots, is the size of a vanilla chest and sits on the ground, keeps its base width when opening, takes a platform right on top, and can be mined back when empty.
  - Two hole styles, switched in the settings (looks only): Blended (default: smooth openings, ink outlines, shading inside, dimmed area walls) and Terraria (square openings).
  - Digging out a cell takes whole vines, grass, bushes, moss, leaves and flowers growing on it, hanging under it or standing in front of it (such as the vines along Greenpath's ceilings), after loading too.
  - Each Geo rock gives 150 Geo in all, spread over every hit and the break. The Lumafly Lantern held gives Terraria's brightest light.
  - Dropped items and gravestones stop where they land, without bouncing; items sunk in blocks rise to the nearest free spot, and items dropped on a boss room's own ground land on that ground.

- **Fishing**
  - Each of the 24 fishing areas has its own crate (King's Pass Crate, Greenpath Crate, City Crate, Crystal Crate, Ash Crate, Godhome Crate, Nightmare Crate and so on), turning into the area's coffer from stage 4; they come where Terraria's biome crates come, and Crate Potions, fishing power and luck all count. The 9 Terraria biome crates carry the areas' names and pictures, and old saves' ones still open.
  - An area crate always holds one piece of gear (the area's enemies' gear for the stage and its Terraria crate's own gear); areas with a rod of their own give it 1/5 of the time; plus the area's blocks, torches, materials, bait and moss, and the Geo, ores, bars and potions every Terraria crate has. Crates hold no boss signature items and no shop weapons.
  - Crates roll once more for a Life Crystal: Wooden 5%, Iron 10%, Golden 15%, area and biome crates 10%.
  - **Fishing Chest**: a catch has a 1/25 chance to become one (1/12 with a Crate Potion), never replacing a quest fish; right-click to open: Apprentice / Journeyman / Master Bait and bait critters, sometimes fishing potions, fishing accessories, fish weapons or rods.

- **Map**
  - The world map has a new layout: rooms overlap as little as possible, more entrances meet, and areas sit close to where Hollow Knight's own map has them. Entrances whose two sides do not meet show small Terraria-style arrows in the destination area's colour; hovering one says "通往：..." (leads to) with a dashed line to the other end, and clicking jumps there; the minimap and the overlay map show them too.
  - Residents' heads show on the full map, the minimap and the overlay map, with their names on hover. With the Grimmchild worn, the Grimm flames not yet collected at its current level (Brumm's included) show on the map.
  - The character reveals 18 cells left and right and 23 up and down; single-cell changes (digging, filling, removing spikes) are on the full map and minimap the next frame.

  - Layers: the Howling Cliffs' cave rooms (the Stag Station, Joni's Repose, the Troupe lantern cave), the Colosseum, the Godhome shortcut, the Mask Maker and the Cast-Off Shell are on the inner layer; the player's layer follows where they actually stand in the scene.
