- **Godhome**
  - Godhome's 72 rooms with terrain are on the map (the Atrium, the Roof, the Hall of Gods, the Land of Storms, the hot spring, every boss arena), with Chinese room names, 451 scenes in the world atlas in all; the Junk Pit, its pipeway and the Pale Lurker's room join the main map. Once you have seen Godhome, a "神居" button on the full map jumps straight there.
  - Godhome fights give endgame rewards: lunar weapons (Meowmere, S.D.M.G., Last Prism, Lunar Portal Staff) and lunar armour, plus 70–90 Luminite for each boss beaten; Godhome's common enemies drop 1–3 Luminite 40% of the time and elites 80%; Godhome treasure bags on Expert and Master still give Godhome rewards when opened back in town.
  - Godhome has its own blocks and walls (Godhome gold brick), torches, chests and fishing crates. Boss life and challenge tiers are under "Boss life" above.

- **Pets**
  - About 85 Terraria pets move, animate, turn and give off particles by Terraria's own AI: ground pets follow, jump and fly back when too far as in Terraria; flying pets follow at Terraria's positions and speeds; idle animations are Terraria's (the Red Panda scratching, the Werewolf pup howling, the pet spider climbing walls...); the Magic Lantern makes nearby treasure sparkle; Chester works as a Piggy Bank you take along (right-click him); the Royal Delight calls the Slime Prince and Princess together; pets drop through platforms when you are below them.

- **Bestiary, dialogue and messages**
  - Bestiary search box: search by enemy name or by the name of an unlocked drop, Chinese IME supported (up to 32 characters); while searching, the left side keeps only areas or stages with results, the grid only the enemies found, the first of them picked, and matching drops get a gold frame.
  - The bestiary's "drop stage" picker (current or 0–5) shows the drops at any stage; grouped by stage, each enemy sits in its own stage (stage 0 enemies in stage 0); the title reads "当前阶段 X / 5" with the next ability to get. Its lists and text are cached, so it opens more smoothly.
  - **Dialogue broadcast** (on by default): Hollow Knight's character dialogue, inscriptions and the Seer's dream lines go to the chat at the bottom left, one line a second, with no black dialogue box and no paging, and you can walk while they talk; dialogues with a choice still open as usual; until the broadcast ends you cannot leave the room it is in.
  - Chat works in single player too (Enter), with /me, /roll, /playing, /death, /pvpdeath, /p and /help.
  - NPCs that fell asleep under an area's title card are woken (the City of Tears' machine that takes the Simple Key works as usual).
  - The Lumafly Lantern's and Grimmchild's buff icons use Hollow Knight's item art; storage panels are titled with the furniture or item that opened them.
  - Item icons and Chinese glyphs are preloaded over the first frames in game, so the first inventory opening does not stutter.

- **Creative mode**
  - All Hallownest items from the start: 4 Simple Keys, 21 Rancid Eggs, 6 Pale Ore, the four relics (14 / 17 / 8 / 4), the Void Heart, the Grimmchild (level 1), the whole Delicate Flower and the awoken Dream Nail, refilled when used; the Shade Cloak, Crystal Heart and other ability accessories too, and the Void Heart flag the Black Egg Temple checks.
  - Right-clicking a stack shown as ∞ takes items without lowering it. Bestiary challenges set you in place and start the fight on arrival.

- **Multiplayer** (new protocol: everyone needs 4.0.0)
  - The first-kill Life Crystal is recorded by whoever holds the arena, checked and broadcast by the host, and each player online gets their own by their own save.
  - A boss room's battle gates open when they are shut and no living player has been in the room for 3 seconds.
  - Wormhole Potion: click a teammate's head on the full map to go to them.
  - Area torches, area chests' looks, furniture facing, bench sitting and area blocks are synced; the host handles doors clients open and shut; items on the blacklist or an Auto-Sell list are sold for clients too. The entrance protection blocks multiplayer hits as well.

- **Performance**
  - The Angler's sleeping spot is checked only in the Blue Lake scene (once a second), saving a scan of every state machine each frame, most noticeable in the busy Royal Waterways.

- **Old saves** load as usual. They get no area chests; the old Colosseum seals become tickets; bosses already beaten count as having given their Life Crystal; Dream Essence becomes an item the first time in game.

name: 空洞泰拉 TerraKnight v3.2.0
body:
**模组更名为“空洞泰拉”**（英文名 TerraKnight 不变）。下载 `TerraKnight-v3.2.0.zip`，解压到空洞骑士游戏目录，双击 `空洞泰拉.bat` 开始玩；安装步骤见 [docs/INSTALL.md](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md)。

## 更新内容

- **更名为空洞泰拉**：中文名为“空洞泰拉”：主菜单大标题（简繁相同）、游戏内版本号、游戏目录里的启动器 `空洞泰拉.bat`。英文名 TerraKnight、存档和设置照旧，旧的 `泰拉圣巢.bat` 也能继续用。

- **联机**
  - 首领战由负责首领的玩家的游戏一直跑到战斗结束：只要他还在首领房间里、战斗还在进行，就不移交；其他人那边的首领只照他那边的位置和动画动，自己的脚本静止。假骑士等首领联机能完整打完，同一时刻只有一个头。
  - 首领被打倒时（包括假骑士这类由自身死亡流程结束的首领），同房间的队友也记入图鉴、拿到宝藏袋、在自己的存档里记下已击败；用召唤物重打后，队友那边的战斗门同样打开。
  - 敌人掉落物按泰拉瑞亚的方式共享，由负责敌人的玩家的游戏掉出一份，所有人可见、谁捡归谁；首领宝藏袋和吉欧每人一份；地上、箱子里和捡起的物品保留前缀与锻造等级。
  - 昼夜和天数都跟主机一致，月相、渔夫任务、旅商来访按主机的天数。

- **首领**
  - 首领召唤物：使用后直接传送进首领房间并立刻开战，到达时消耗 1 个；辐光跳过开场演出，约 1 秒后出场；开场卡住时自动交还操作权。打完梦境首领（如失败的冠军）后回到使用召唤物的地方正常醒来。
  - 用召唤物重打首领后，战斗竖起的墙随战斗门一起撤掉（守护者大黄蜂、哨兵大黄蜂两侧门边）；诺斯克战后再次关上的门会重新打开。
  - 神居众神殿里各首领的挑战房间保留原版地形，首领的冲刺、跳跃落在原版的地面和墙上。
  - 首领掉落物在所有首领房间都显示，包括螳螂领主等保留原版地形的房间；召唤物开战时玩家站在竞技场地面上，不会被放到画面外的高处（蜂巢骑士、收藏家）。
  - 假骑士发怒时攻击照样造成伤害，盔甲留最后一点血，下一次眩晕照常出现；辐光最后一击按攻击键或使用键都能打出。
  - 守护丝结的说明写的是苍绿之径。

- **战斗**
  - 带盾的敌人用盾挡住朝向它那一侧的近战、弹幕、鞭子和召唤物攻击，泰拉瑞亚的魔法当作小骑士的法术处理；蜷起来的巴德尔只有张嘴时能打到。被挡下的弹幕中，泰拉瑞亚能反弹的那些会以一半速度反弹回来，变成敌人的弹幕。
  - 敌人 3 秒内被击退、击飞 5 次后，3 秒内不再受击退。
  - 召唤物会攻击所有敌人，包括巴德尔长者这类趴着不动的敌人。
  - 敌人死亡时按原版概率掉落星星，拾取恢复 100 点魔力（魔力磁铁类饰品扩大拾取范围）；血瓶、红心、星星都从敌人身上掉出。
  - 充能爆破炮满蓄力的大光球按原版留下敌人的无敌时间，同一个敌人每 10 帧最多被它打中一次；狐火之息的同类冷却为原版的 15 帧。
  - 武器按原版的单发伤害、攻击周期和弹幕数量重新分配到六个阶段；护甲、套装和饰品恢复原版属性（包括死灵套、熔岩套、暗影套的套装效果，星星斗篷与蜂窝的原版伤害）；小鬼法杖、蜘蛛套等的制作材料在对应阶段就能拿到。
  - 锻造每级伤害 +5%。
  - 下落的钟乳石陷阱按原版巨石的伤害计算。

- **世界与界面**
  - 镜头锁开启时，镜头跟着画面上的人物每帧平滑移动，前景不抖。
  - 陨石整个存档只落一次；落地后地图上立刻显示，陨石坑上方的前景景物被一并炸开，坑里的陨石块完整可见。
  - 人物点亮地图的范围上下各多 5 格；开局时地图是暗的，买了地图后才显示德特茅斯。
  - 泰拉瑞亚设置里有原版的“自动暂停”开关：打开后，打开背包时游戏暂停（联机时不暂停）。
  - 泰拉瑞亚的时间随游玩一直走。
  - 点一下水蜡烛只切换一次；说明写明使用后在 1～3 倍之间切换刷怪倍率。
  - 过场中需要攻击的地方（被深巢的蛛网缠住、辐光的最后一击）用攻击键或使用键都能挣脱、出手。
  - 扒在墙上时挥动回旋镖等武器朝向墙的另一侧，与泰拉瑞亚贴墙时朝鼠标方向挥动一致。
  - 面具与生命水晶分开计算：每块面具碎片在生命值末尾加半颗青蓝色心（10 点生命），生命水晶照常使用，算上首领最多 15 颗；吃过的生命果显示为金色心。旧存档里面具换来的生命水晶收回一次。
  - 生命血提供 2 颗银色心的临时护盾（打掉为止）和 2 颗持续到死亡的临时魔力星。
  - 水晶之心：图标显示为水晶之心；在空中也能长按冲刺键蓄力超级冲刺，蓄力时停在原处；飞行中再按冲刺键可以停下。
  - 向导：任意模式下都显示圣巢之盾需要克苏鲁护盾、暗影披风、水晶之心三件一起合成。
  - F8 的现场报告写出人物周围平台的碰撞状态，方便定位平台踩不住的问题。

---

**The mod's Chinese name is now 空洞泰拉** (the English name TerraKnight stays). Download `TerraKnight-v3.2.0.zip`, unzip it into the Hollow Knight game folder and double-click `空洞泰拉.bat`; see [docs/INSTALL.en.md](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.en.md).

## Changes

- **Renamed 空洞泰拉**: the Chinese name is 空洞泰拉 on the main-menu title (the same in Traditional), in the in-game version label and in the launcher `空洞泰拉.bat` in the game folder. The English name TerraKnight, saves and settings stay; an old `泰拉圣巢.bat` still works.

- **Multiplayer**
  - A boss fight runs in the game of the player in charge of the boss until it ends: it is not handed over while they are still in the boss room with the fight on. Everyone else's copy of the boss follows their position and animation, its own scripts still. The False Knight and other bosses can be fought to the end together, with one head at a time.
  - When a boss is beaten (including those like the False Knight whose own death sequence ends the fight), teammates in the room get the bestiary entry and the treasure bag and have it recorded as beaten in their own save; after a seal rematch their battle gates open too.
  - Enemy loot is shared as in Terraria. The game that runs the enemy drops it once, everyone sees it, and whoever picks it up keeps it. A boss's treasure bag and the Geo are each player's own. Items on the ground, in chests and picked up keep their prefix and forge level.
  - Day, night and the day count follow the host, so the moon phase, the Angler's quest and the Traveling Merchant go by the host's days.

- **Bosses**
  - Boss seals take you straight into the boss's arena and start the fight at once; one is used on arrival. The Radiance skips its intro and appears after about a second. If the start leaves you held, control is handed back. Waking from a dream boss (e.g. the Failed Champion) returns you to where the seal was used.
  - After a seal rematch the walls the fight put up come down with the battle gates (beside both gates of Hornet Protector's and Hornet Sentinel's arenas); the gate that closes again after Nosk opens again.
  - The Hall of Gods' challenge rooms keep the game's own ground, so the bosses dash and land on the floors and walls they were made for.
  - Boss loot shows in every boss room, including those that keep the game's own ground such as the Mantis Lords'. Seal fights set you on the arena floor, never above the view (Hive Knight, Collector).
  - Hits on the False Knight during his rage deal damage; his armour keeps its last point and his next stun comes as usual. The Radiance's last blow works with the attack key or the use key.
  - Protector's Silken Knot names Greenpath as its area.

- **Combat**
  - Shielded enemies block melee, projectiles, whips and minions from the side their shield faces; Terraria's magic counts as the Knight's spells. A curled-up Baldur can be hit only with its mouth open. Of the blocked projectiles, the ones Terraria can reflect come back at half speed as enemy shots.
  - An enemy knocked back or launched 5 times within 3 seconds is immune to knockback for 3 seconds.
  - Minions attack every enemy, including those that lie still such as the Elder Baldur.
  - Enemies drop stars at Terraria's chances, restoring 100 mana when picked up (mana magnets widen the pickup range); hearts, potions and stars drop from the enemy itself.
  - The Charged Blaster Cannon's full-charge orb leaves the enemy's immunity as in Terraria: it hits one enemy at most once every 10 ticks. The Foxsparks' breath has Terraria's 15-tick per-kind cooldown.
  - Weapons are rebalanced across the six stages from Terraria's per-hit damage, attack cycle and projectile count; armour, set bonuses and accessories have their Terraria stats (including the Necro, Molten and Shadow set bonuses and the Star Cloak's and Honeycomb's damage); the materials for the Imp Staff, the Spider set and others come at their own stage.
  - Forging adds +5% damage a level.
  - Falling stalactite traps deal Terraria's Boulder damage.

- **World and interface**
  - With the camera lock on, the camera moves with the character as drawn each frame, smoothly, and the foreground stays steady.
  - The meteorite falls once per save. It shows on the map as soon as it lands, the foreground scenery over its crater is blown away with it, and the Meteorite in the pit is fully visible.
  - The character lights the map 5 more cells up and down; the map starts dark, and Dirtmouth shows once its map is bought.
  - Terraria Settings have Terraria's Autopause switch: with it on, opening the inventory pauses the game (not in multiplayer).
  - Terraria's clock runs throughout play.
  - One click on the Water Candle toggles it once; its tooltip says its use switches the spawn multiplier between 1 and 3.
  - Cutscene moments that wait for an attack (caught in Deepnest's web, the Radiance's last blow) take the attack key or the use key.
  - Boomerangs and other weapons swung while clinging to a wall swing away from the wall, as Terraria aims at the cursor.
  - Masks and Life Crystals count apart: each mask shard adds half a cyan heart (10 life) after your life; Life Crystals work as usual, up to 15 counting bosses; Life Fruit hearts are golden. An old save's Life Crystals from masks are taken back once.
  - Lifeblood gives a two-silver-heart shield that lasts until broken, plus two temporary mana stars that last until death.
  - Crystal Heart: shows its own icon; the Super Dash charges in mid-air too, holding you in place, and a fresh Dash press stops it in flight.
  - The Guide shows the Hallownest Shield needing the Shield of Cthulhu, Shade Cloak and Crystal Heart together, in every mode.
  - F8's spot report lists the collision state of the platforms around the character, to find a platform that can't be stood on.

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 3.1.1
body:
泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 3.1.1

- **饰品掉率保底**：普通敌人和精英的饰品池里，每件候选饰品至少 1.5%（普通难度，困难、专家、大师按难度提高），候选平分；池子总率不低于普通怪 2%、精英 5%，候选多时随之提高（普通难度实测：爬虫约 18%、游荡躯壳约 10%、躯壳守卫约 21%），一次仍最多掉一件。首领掉落表里的每件饰品也至少 1.5%。

- **篝火**：放在背包里时，除了生命再生 +1，自然回血也快 10%（照原版）；物品说明写明带在身上的效果。

3.1.0 的全部内容（原版合成条件、掉落重做、暗影披风/水晶之心/圣巢之盾、水蜡烛、随身增益家具、墓碑和墓地、镜头锁等）见 [3.1.0 发布说明](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/releases/tag/v3.1.0)。

### 安装

下载下方 `TerraKnight-v3.1.1.zip`，解压覆盖到已安装 BepInEx 5.4.23（Windows x64）的空洞骑士游戏目录（Steam 正式版 1.5.12620）。本机需安装 Steam 版泰拉瑞亚；游戏资源从本机读取，不随 Mod 打包。双击游戏目录中的“泰拉圣巢.bat”启动。

---

- **Accessory drop floor**: in the accessory pool of common enemies and elites every candidate has at least 1.5% (Normal; higher on Hard, Expert and Master), the candidates sharing equally; the pool is never below 2% for a common enemy or 5% for an elite and grows with more candidates (measured on Normal: about 18% from a Crawlid, 10% from a Wandering Husk, 21% from a Husk Guard), still at most one a kill. Every accessory in a boss's drop table has at least 1.5% too.

- **Campfire**: carried in the bag it gives +1 life regeneration and 10% faster natural regeneration (as in Terraria); its tooltip says so.

Everything in 3.1.0 (vanilla crafting conditions, the drop rework, Shade Cloak / Crystal Heart / Hallownest Shield, the Water Candle, carried buff furniture, tombstones and graveyards, the camera lock and more) is in the [3.1.0 release notes](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/releases/tag/v3.1.0).

### Install

Download `TerraKnight-v3.1.1.zip` below and extract it over a Hollow Knight folder (Steam stable 1.5.12620) with BepInEx 5.4.23 (Windows x64). Steam Terraria must be installed; its assets are read locally and not shipped with the mod. Start with "泰拉圣巢.bat" in the game folder.

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 3.1.0
body:
泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 3.1.0

- **合成照原版**：泰拉瑞亚物品的 910 条配方，材料、数量、产出、制作站和环境（水、酸水、蜂蜜、墓地）都和原版 1.4.5.8 一致，阶段只决定配方什么时候开放。徒手配方随时能做，其余的要站在所需的制作站旁边；花吉欧做的基础东西在长椅旁或德特茅斯做。恶魔祭坛和猩红祭坛立在德特茅斯长椅的两侧；篝火能做能摆（木材 10、火把 5）；每种制作站都有来源，天磨（复仇蝇一类）、冰雪机（水晶山峰的怪）、远古操纵机（空洞骑士必掉）等由对应的怪物和首领掉落。

- **掉落**（怪物图鉴按当前难度显示每件的掉率）
  - 普通敌人和精英的饰品合成一个池，一次最多掉一件：普通难度普通怪 2%、精英 5%（困难、专家、大师依次为 2.2%/5.5%、2.4%/6%、2.6%/6.5%），具体哪件按原有权重抽。
  - 光明之魂、暗影之魂、飞翔之魂单独判定，从阶段 4 开始掉：对应的普通怪 60% 掉 1～3 个，精英必掉 2～4 个；通用材料的产量提高 50%。
  - 后期首领每次保底神圣锭 15～25 个和对应的魂 20～30 个，终期首领另给对应碎片 18～26 个、甲虫外壳 4～8 个；梦境等区域的普通敌人掉灵气和阴森木。
  - 原版配方仍要用到的旧武器、旧盔甲和旧饰品保留原来的怪物来源，死亡草、闪耀根、丛林泥块等早期材料都有来源；首领奖励不超出这场战斗的阶段。
  - 饰品照原版数值：没有阶段上限，骨手套、魔力斗篷等是原版的伤害。

- **敌人生命按阶段缩小**：普通敌人和精英在阶段 0～3 是 3.0.0 的 50%，阶段 4 是 31.25%，阶段 5 是 20%；首领在阶段 0～1 是 65%，阶段 2 是 60%，阶段 3 是 55%，阶段 4 是 50%，阶段 5 和神居重战是 40%。

- **首领召唤物**：40 个召唤物在砧上用首领周边两种小怪掉的材料制作（比如假骑士的空甲战令是铁矿石 12、凝胶 6）；蜂蜡从蜂巢骑士所在的阶段 3 开始掉。

- **暗影披风、水晶之心和圣巢之盾**：拿到原版的暗影披风、水晶之心能力时，同名饰品放进背包，可以重铸。
  - 暗影披风：按暗影冲刺键（默认 X），或按住冲刺键时双击方向键，冲出暗影冲刺，冷却 10 秒；冲刺中穿过敌人和它们的攻击、穿过暗影之门，全身裹着黑雾。
  - 水晶之心：在地上或贴墙时按住冲刺键（默认 F）蓄力，放出原版的超级冲刺，撞墙停下，冷却 20 秒；蓄力和冲刺时全身发白光。
  - 圣巢之盾（克苏鲁之盾 + 暗影披风 + 水晶之心，工匠作坊制作，防御 4）：点按冲刺键是克苏鲁之盾的冲刺，按住是水晶之心的蓄力，按住时双击方向键是暗影冲刺。
  - 冲刺键默认 F，暗影冲刺键默认 X，都能在“泰拉瑞亚设置”里改。

- **水蜡烛**：商人卖，3000 吉欧。放在快捷栏里时，每次进入房间，除首领外的敌人（包括精英和只出现一次的敌人）都立刻重新出现；使用它在 ×1、×2、×3 之间切换刷怪倍率（在原有的翻倍上再乘，只出现一次的敌人仍只出一只）。

- **增益家具带在身上就生效**：篝火、红心灯笼、星星瓶、巴斯特雕像、向日葵、花园侏儒放在背包里就有原版摆在身边时的增益（生命再生、魔力再生、防御 +5、移动速度、运气）；星星瓶（玻璃瓶 + 坠落之星）和红心灯笼（生命水晶 + 链条 4）徒手就能做。

- **墓碑和墓地**：死亡时（被尖刺扎死也算）照原版抛出一块墓碑，滚到能立住的地方立起来，10 秒内找不到地方就变成掉落物；身上吉欧超过 1000 时是金墓碑（共 11 种）。附近立着 7 块墓碑就是墓地环境（安息之地也是）：画面变暗，能做墓地配方，墓碑旁随机长出阿比盖尔的花（右键采下）。

- **镜头锁**：“泰拉瑞亚设置”里的开关，开着时人物始终在画面正中（泰拉瑞亚的视角），关着时是空洞骑士原版的镜头。

- **背包和战斗**：开着背包走动时帧率和关着一样；近战武器和骨钉每挥一下对每个敌人只造成一次伤害（身上有几个受击框的敌人也一样）；同一件饰品反复装上卸下，词缀和锻造等级都保留；回到主菜单时，留在场景里的尖球、弹幕、召唤物和鞭子全部清除；钱币槽和背包里的吉欧用快速堆叠、存钱罐面板的“快速堆叠”“全部存入”或 Shift 点击存进存钱罐，并到存钱罐里已有的那堆吉欧上（收藏的不动）。

- **圣巢物品**：国王印记、提灯、各种钥匙拿在手里时，原版的门、机关和对话都认得；拿到手里的那一刻，正在等它的门和机关立刻重新判断，提灯立刻照亮房间。主背包满时得到的梦之钉放进圣巢背包的第 21 格（只放梦之钉）；已经得到但不在身上的梦之钉自动补回，词缀和锻造等级保留。

- **大师圣物**：统一 3 格宽的底座，雕像等比缩放，照原版上下浮动，带金色光晕和闪光。

### 安装

下载下方 `TerraKnight-v3.1.0.zip`，解压覆盖到已安装 BepInEx 5.4.23（Windows x64）的空洞骑士游戏目录（Steam 正式版 1.5.12620）。本机需安装 Steam 版泰拉瑞亚；游戏资源从本机读取，不随 Mod 打包。双击游戏目录中的“泰拉圣巢.bat”启动。

---

- **Crafting as in Terraria**: the 910 recipes of Terraria items match vanilla 1.4.5.8 in materials, amounts, results, stations and environment (water, acid, honey, graveyard); a stage only decides when a recipe opens. Hand-made recipes work anywhere, the rest need their station nearby; the basics bought with Geo are made by a bench or in Dirtmouth. The Demon and Crimson Altars stand either side of Dirtmouth's bench; the Campfire is craftable and placeable (10 wood, 5 torches); every crafting station has a source, the Sky Mill (Vengeflies and their kin), the Ice Machine (Crystal Peak's enemies) and the Ancient Manipulator (always from the Hollow Knight) among them.

- **Drops** (the Bestiary shows each item's rate at the current difficulty)
  - Accessories from common enemies and elites share one pool, at most one a kill: 2% from a common enemy and 5% from an elite on Normal (2.2%/5.5%, 2.4%/6% and 2.6%/6.5% on Hard, Expert and Master), the item picked by its usual weight.
  - Souls of Light, Night and Flight are rolled on their own from Stage 4: 60% for 1 to 3 from their common enemies, always 2 to 4 from elites; common materials drop 50% more.
  - Late bosses always give 15 to 25 Hallowed Bars and 20 to 30 of their soul, final bosses also 18 to 26 of their fragment and 4 to 8 Beetle Husks; common enemies in the dreams and similar areas drop Ectoplasm and Spooky Wood.
  - Old weapons, armor and accessories that vanilla recipes still use keep their enemy sources, and early materials such as Deathweed, Blinkroot and Mud have sources; a boss reward never exceeds the stage of its fight.
  - Accessories have their vanilla values: no stage caps, and the Bone Glove, the Mana Cloak and the like deal their vanilla damage.

- **Enemy life by stage**: common enemies and elites have 50% of their 3.0.0 life in Stages 0 to 3, 31.25% in Stage 4 and 20% in Stage 5; bosses have 65% in Stages 0 and 1, 60% in Stage 2, 55% in Stage 3, 50% in Stage 4 and 40% in Stage 5 and Godhome rematches.

- **Boss summons**: the 40 summons are made at an anvil from what two kinds of enemy around their boss drop (the False Knight's is 12 Iron Ore and 6 Gel, say); Bee Wax drops from Stage 3, the Hive Knight's.

- **Shade Cloak, Crystal Heart and Hallownest Shield**: getting the Shade Cloak or Crystal Heart ability puts the accessory of that name in the bag, reforgeable.
  - Shade Cloak: the Shadow Dash key (X by default), or a double tap of a direction while Dash is held, makes a shadow dash with a 10 s cooldown; it passes through enemies, their attacks and shade gates, the body wrapped in black smoke.
  - Crystal Heart: holding Dash (F by default) on the ground or a wall charges the vanilla super dash, which stops at a wall; 20 s cooldown; the body glows white while charging and flying.
  - Hallownest Shield (Shield of Cthulhu + Shade Cloak + Crystal Heart at the Tinkerer's Workshop, 4 defense): tap Dash for the Shield of Cthulhu's dash, hold it for the Crystal Heart's charge, double-tap a direction while holding it for the shadow dash.
  - Dash defaults to F and Shadow Dash to X, both rebindable in "Terraria Settings".

- **Water Candle**: sold by the Merchant for 3000 Geo. In the hotbar it brings every enemy but bosses (elites and one-off enemies too) back at once whenever a room is entered; using it cycles the spawn multiplier through ×1, ×2 and ×3 (on top of the usual doubling; one-off enemies still come back alone).

- **Buff furniture works carried**: a Campfire, Heart Lantern, Star in a Bottle, Bast Statue, Sunflower or Garden Gnome in the bag gives the buff it gives placed nearby (life regeneration, mana regeneration, +5 defense, movement speed, luck); the Star in a Bottle (Bottle + Fallen Star) and the Heart Lantern (Life Crystal + 4 Chains) are made by hand.

- **Tombstones and graveyards**: dying (to spikes too) throws a tombstone as in Terraria; it rolls until it can stand and becomes a dropped item if it finds nowhere within 10 seconds; with over 1000 Geo on you it is a gold one (11 kinds). Seven tombstones nearby make a graveyard (the Resting Grounds are one too): the scene darkens, graveyard recipes open, and Abigail's Flower grows at random by the graves (right-click to pick it).

- **Camera lock**: a switch in "Terraria Settings"; on, the character stays in the middle of the screen (Terraria's view), off, Hollow Knight's own camera.

- **Inventory and combat**: walking with the inventory open runs at the same frame rate as with it closed; a melee weapon or the Nail deals one hit to each enemy per swing (enemies with several hitboxes too); re-equipping the same accessory keeps its prefix and forge level; returning to the main menu clears the Spiky Balls, projectiles, minions and whips left in the scene; Geo in the coin slot and the bag goes into the Piggy Bank by Quick Stack, the bank's "Quick Stack" and "Deposit All", or Shift+click, onto the Geo already there (favourites stay).

- **Hallownest items**: the King's Brand, the lantern and the keys are recognised by vanilla doors, devices and dialogue while held; the moment one is taken in hand, a door or device waiting for it decides again, and the lantern lights the room at once. A Dream Nail received with the main bag full goes in the Hallownest Bag's 21st slot (Dream Nail only); a Dream Nail the save has but the player doesn't carry comes back by itself, prefix and forge level kept.

- **Master relics**: one 3-tile-wide pedestal, the statue scaled evenly, floating up and down as in Terraria with a golden glow and sparkles.

### Install

Download `TerraKnight-v3.1.0.zip` below and extract it over a Hollow Knight folder (Steam stable 1.5.12620) with BepInEx 5.4.23 (Windows x64). Steam Terraria must be installed; its assets are read locally and not shipped with the mod. Start with "泰拉圣巢.bat" in the game folder.

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 3.0.0
body:
下载下方 **TerraKnight-v3.0.0.zip**，按压缩包内的安装说明安装。需要 Steam 正式版空洞骑士 **1.5.12620（Unity 6）**、BepInEx **5.4.23.x x64**，以及本机已安装的 Steam 版泰拉瑞亚。

## 钓鱼

- 拿钓竿对着水面抛竿，浮标沉下去时再用一次收竿。渔力照原版公式：钓竿 + 鱼饵 + 饰品，按昼夜、月相和天气加减，任何一片水不论大小都能钓（酸水池也算）。
- 每个区域对应泰拉瑞亚的群系，出原版的鱼、任务鱼、宝匣和杂物；木/铁/金匣和各区域的匣子右键打开。
- 酸水按原版的熔岩钓鱼处理，要装酸水钩（原版的熔岩钩）或它的渔具袋。
- 渔夫睡在遗忘十字路的湖边，叫醒后搬进德特茅斯，每天要一条任务鱼（原版的全部 41 种），交上来给原版的奖励。怪物会掉鱼饵。

## 掉落和进度

- 按四个职业重做：普通怪掉成品的几率是武器 2%、盔甲 1%、稀有饰品 1%（精英 6%、3%、3%），材料掉得稳定。
- 每个阶段四个职业各有探索和制作武器、首领武器、能制作的主力套装和关键饰品；关键饰品至少三种普通怪会掉，也能直接制作。
- 正式首领第一次被打倒必掉一件当前阶段的武器或套装部位（四个职业各 25%）和一件功能奖励；再打一次再随机一件主力装备，功能奖励 20%。
- 矿石和地区材料按区域生态和阶段排好；配方、附近的工作站、商店和钓鱼匣按阶段开放；第一次到达制作点和开荒初期自动送一把基础武器。每件物品谁掉、几率多少见掉落记录.md。

## 锻造、宝藏袋、陨石

- **锻造**：哥布林工匠开局就住在德特茅斯，点“锻造”花吉欧给武器升级，每级伤害 +10%，每解锁一个阶段多 5 级（最高 +30）；价格按武器种类、初始伤害、出手速度和等级计算，越强越贵；成功率 50%，失败扣钱、等级不变。
- **宝藏袋**：专家和大师难度下首领的掉落装进它自己的宝藏袋（48 种），右键打开时抽取，首次击败的袋子必得首领武器；圣物、心和药水照常掉在外面。圣物只在大师模式掉，每次必掉。
- **陨石**：打倒首领后当晚午夜有陨石落在去过的地方，砸出陨石坑；陨石块要 50% 镐力，没有防火装备碰到会燃烧，地图上橙红色显示。

## 食物

- “吃得好”“很满意”“酒足饭饱”三档增益照原版（防御、暴击、伤害、近战速度、召唤物击退、移动和挖矿速度），吃下新的就换掉身上那一档。
- 烹饪锅做熟鱼、熟虾、海鲜大餐、龙虾尾、焦黑鱼、金美味、蛆虫汤、食用蜗牛、怪物千层面，工作台做生鱼片，熔炉烤南瓜派；去壳牡蛎和 Joja 可乐能吃，麦芽酒让人醉醺醺。

## 城镇居民

- 泰拉瑞亚的城镇居民全部能住进德特茅斯（37 位，按阶段入住）：护士治疗、税收官收税、旅商白天隔几天来一次、圣诞老人只在十二月，还有城镇宠物。有人入住或离开时左下角提示。
- **哥布林工匠的重铸**：原版 1.4.5 的全部词缀（武器的伤害、速度、暴击、大小、射速、魔力、击退，召唤武器的盔甲穿透和召唤标记伤害，饰品的防御、魔力、暴击、伤害、移速和近战速度），价格和稀有度照原版公式，词缀保存在存档里。骨钉（大小作用到刀光，速度作用到出刀间隔）和梦之钉也能重铸。

## 圣巢物品

- 提灯、城市纹章、简单钥匙、优雅钥匙、爱情钥匙、商店钥匙、电车票、国王印记、美味花朵、腐臭蛋、苍白矿石、四种遗物、国王之魂、虚空之心都是泰拉瑞亚物品，**拿在手里才算有**，只能放在快捷栏或图鉴旁边的“圣巢背包”里。
- 存档里已经拿到的，进游戏就自动放进圣巢背包。

## 背包

- **快捷出售**：“圣巢背包”旁的按钮打开出售模式，点背包里的物品直接卖出，背包下方的出售栏里能按原价买回。
- 背包开着时骨钉照常挥砍。
- **钱币槽**：背包右侧、弹药栏左边一格，捡到的吉欧先放进这里，付钱从这里扣，换配装时钱留在原处。
- **箱子能重命名**（最多 20 个字），鼠标指着箱子显示它的名字。

## 按键

- 泰拉瑞亚 1.4.5 的冲刺键（和原版一样默认不绑定，在“泰拉瑞亚设置”里绑定；按住只冲一次，冷却中按住冷却一过就冲）和“双击冲刺”开关。
- 快速增益（B）、地图放大/缩小/透明度（小键盘 +/-、PageUp/PageDown）、上一/下一配装、盔甲套装能力；改键列表按原版分组排列，对着原来的键再按一次就解除绑定。
- 使用物品、交互和收藏也能改键（默认鼠标左键、右键和左 Alt）。

## 建造和制作

- 锤子给放下的方块和平台塑形（半砖、四向斜坡），按住拆背景墙；292 种背景墙（35 种可合成）；楼梯接平台，低顶的平台成为单向墙。
- 原版可制作的装备全部能做（631 件），补上材料和来源；放置物品时显示虚影。

## 大师模式圣物

- 大师模式下首领每次被打倒必掉它的圣物，统一 2×3 格的新图，可以摆在地上当摆设；神居里的无上辐光、暴怒守卫、战斗姐妹和有翼诺斯克各有自己的圣物。

## 图鉴、存档界面与回城

- 图鉴左侧可切换按地区或阶段 0～5 分类。
- 新建创造模式存档的弹窗支持翻页箭头、滚轮和 PageUp/PageDown，访问全部 50 个存档位。
- 回忆药水回城后站立恢复操作，同时保留原本的复活点。

## 其他

- 首领召唤物传送到竞技场正门外，走开召唤物保留。
- 打开地图时右键切换深浅层。
- 四职业的关键饰品至少有三种同期可达普通怪来源，并提供直接制作配方。
- 阴影的名字显示为“阴影”。
- **首领召唤出来的东西四个职业的武器都能打**，和机关一样：大黄蜂哨兵的尖刺、假骑士震落的木桶、粪堆骑士和白色守卫的粪球、蜂巢骑士的刺球。
- **增益站的增益持续到死亡**（灵视、弹药箱、着魔、锋利、战略家；被尖刺扎死也算死亡）。
- **多阶段首领每个阶段是同期首领生命的一半**，后一阶段多 20%；解锁新阶段后，之前各阶段的怪物属性提到当前阶段的九成。
- 怪物死后留下尸体（同时最多 24 具，多出来的从最早那具开始淡出）；怪物掉的武器和饰品有时自带词缀（照原版掉落时的随机词缀）。
- 所有尖刺都能挖，挖掉后贴图一起消失；骨钉上劈有击退。
- 水晶守卫在战斗区域里被远程打中就醒，醒后的激光咆哮照常掉血；再打一次首领时，打赢后战斗门自动打开。
- 首领死在墙里、地下或远处时，掉落物落在主角身边；怪物钻地或飞走时血条留在原处。
- 火把离远了、出入房间后照常照亮；二段跳时切换房间，进新房间后跳跃状态重置；“泰拉瑞亚设置”照常打开，改键列表分三列。

---

**English**: fishing (Terraria's fishing power, biome catches, crates, the Angler's quests, acid fishing with the Acid Hook); every Terraria townsperson in Dirtmouth (the Nurse, the Tax Collector, the Traveling Merchant, Santa in December, town pets); the Goblin Tinkerer's reforging with all of Terraria 1.4.5's prefixes (the Nail and the Dream Nail too); Hallownest's keys and keepsakes as Terraria items that count only while held, kept in the hotbar or the new Hallownest Bag (given on loading to saves that have them); Quick Sell with buy-back; a Dash key and Double Tap Dashing, Quick Buff, map zoom and transparency keys, loadout cycling, the armor set ability; hammers shaping blocks, 292 walls, all craftable equipment; Master Mode boss relics in new 2×3 pictures; boss seals to the arena's front door; right click switches the map's layers; the Nail swings with the inventory open; Terraria's food and its three fed states; any water fishable, all 41 quest fish; a coin slot; chest renaming; rebindable Use Item, Interact and Favorite; buff stations' buffs until death; boss-sent barbs, barrels, dung balls and droppers hit by every class; multi-phase bosses at half a stage boss per phase; earlier stages' enemies brought up to the unlocked one; corpses; prefixed loot; every spike diggable; and fixes (the up-slash's knockback, the Crystal Guardian's waking, rematch gates, boss loot in walls, health bars of burrowing enemies, torches far away, double jumps across rooms, the Terraria Settings button). Also the drop and progression rework around the four classes (finished gear at a few percent, steady materials, first-defeat boss rewards, stage-gated recipes and shops), the Goblin Tinkerer's forging (in Dirtmouth from the start), treasure bags in Expert and Master, and meteorites after boss defeats. Full notes: docs/CHANGELOG.en.md.


## 验证范围

本次发布核对构建、安装包与下载文件的一致性，并保留已有隔离回归证据。固定目标出手与数据抽样不代表全 Boss、多人和长时间资源续航都已逐项验证。图鉴及创造模式弹窗的视觉截图验收尚未完成。

已有后台键位自动化中，双击冲刺和小地图放大两项未通过；本轮未将其认定为已验证。

本轮最终发布候选：传送与回城 10/10、当前合成配方 153/153、重铸 21/21，合计 184/184；隔离测试后玩家存档未变、设置已恢复。

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 2.7.0
body:
这是此前的 **2.7.0** 版本，包含新的魔力机制：**魔力不足或为 0 时仍可施法，该次施法耗时变为 2.5 倍；补充魔力后恢复正常速度**。

下载下方 **TerraKnight-v2.7.0.zip**，按压缩包内安装说明安装。需要 Steam 正式版空洞骑士 **1.5.12620（Unity 6）**、BepInEx **5.4.23.x x64**，以及本机已安装的 Steam 版泰拉瑞亚。

本包固定于此前的 2.7.0 提交 `3cd5bc6`，不包含后续正在开发的建造、钓鱼及装备配方补全。

已知问题：测试中曾出现一次神居奥波路波战斗提前返回德特茅斯，原因尚未定位；之后的独立存档复测通过，仍保留这一问题说明。

---

## 首领

- 分阶段的首领每个阶段都有一整份同期首领的生命，后一阶段比前一阶段多 20%，同时上场的几只平分这一份：假骑士每轮破甲加打头（盔甲占大头，头约为盔甲的三成），灵魂大师和灵魂暴君两个阶段，螳螂领主大姐单挑、两位妹妹一起（战斗姐妹三位一起），守望者骑士先一只、之后两只一波，奥罗单挑、再和马托一起。
- 首领掉治疗药水和心（照泰拉瑞亚）：对应等级的治疗药水 5～15 瓶、心 5～9 个，每个阶段结束时另掉一小份；心碰到就恢复 20 点生命，拾心药水让心从更远处飞过来。都写在怪物图鉴和掉落记录里。
- 40 个首领召唤物：首次击败首领后在任意地点使用，传送门把人送进它的原版竞技场，跳过剧情直接开战；联机时所有玩家一起传送过去，只消耗使用者的一个。
- 首领的防御是对应泰拉瑞亚首领的一半；首领房间只锁定首领的战斗范围，其余部分照常挖掘建造。
- 命中没有无敌帧：霰弹的每颗弹丸、每个召唤物的每次攻击都造成伤害。
- 怪物图鉴补全：灵魂暴君、深渊的兄弟、多刺躯壳、神居的水晶守卫和狂暴守卫、无上辉光都记入图鉴并掉落；螳螂领主、守望者骑士这类几个身体的首领一场记一次；梦境和召唤物复战照常记入。

## 联机

- 大家在主机的世界里：箱子、工作台和家具、地上的物品、生命水晶和挖改的地形以主机为准，箱子同一时间只能一个人打开；首领只对进了竞技场的玩家出手，竞技场外的队友留在原地。
- 专家和大师难度下首领的生命按人数增加（两人 ×1.35、三人 ×1.92、四人 ×2.63）。

## 地图

- 地图分深层和浅层：门后的房间（商店和住处、斗兽场、格林剧团的帐篷、档案馆、白色宫殿、梦境、电车）在深层，小地图只画玩家所在的一层，大地图左下角切换当前层、浅层和深层。
- 玩家的头像画在身体正中。
- 信息饰品（表、深度计、罗盘、GPS、DPS 计、杀怪计数器等）显示在小地图下方。

## 物品和世界

- 补全泰拉瑞亚的盔甲（流星、忍者、挖矿、猩红、仙人掌、南瓜、角斗士、化石、渔夫、远古系列、各种木头套、旧日军团 T2/T3、巫师帽和七种宝石长袍等），套装奖励照 1.4.5。
- 补上其余制作站（地狱熔炉、精金/钛金熔炉、水晶球、灌注站、远古操纵机等），恶魔祭坛和猩红祭坛立在黑卵神殿里。
- 魔镜、冰镜和手机带人回家，混沌传送杖和和谐传送杖传送到光标处。
- 酸水里能用泰拉瑞亚的液体装备：鳍状肢、海神贝壳、潜水装备和鳍状肢药水让人在酸水里游泳、不受伤；水上漂靴类和水上漂药水让人站在酸水面上，按住下键沉下去。
- 原版骨钉打不退的敌人也不吃泰拉瑞亚的击退（炮台、愚人食者、卵囊、古尔卡、重型敌人和爬墙的敌人）。
- 开着箱子也能合成，箱子里的材料算进去。
- 普通敌人和精英掉的矿石翻倍。
- 魔力照 1.4.5：魔力不够也能施法，这次施法慢 2.5 倍；魔力花照常给持续施法的武器自动喝药。
- 对话中用晶塔、魔镜或召唤物传送，对话框跟着收起。
- 打完梦境和神居首领时背包满了，放不下的掉落物回到神居大厅或现世时掉在脚下。

---

## Bosses

- A boss fought in phases has a whole boss of its time's life in every phase, each phase 20% more than the one before, the bodies up together sharing it: the False Knight's rounds of a broken armour and a beaten head (the armour the bulk, the head about three tenths of it), the Soul Master's and the Soul Tyrant's two phases, the Mantis Lords' eldest alone and then her two sisters together (three for the Sisters of Battle), the Watcher Knights one first and then two at a time, Oro alone and then with Mato.
- Bosses drop healing potions and hearts, as in Terraria: 5 to 15 potions of their tier and 5 to 9 hearts, and a smaller share at the end of each phase; a heart heals 20 life when touched, and the Heartreach potion pulls hearts from further away. Both are listed in the Bestiary and the drop record.
- 40 boss summons: usable anywhere once the boss is beaten, a portal takes the player into its native arena, straight into the fight with the story skipped; in a LAN game every player goes too, and only the user's seal is spent.
- Boss defense is half its Terraria counterpart's; a boss room locks only where its boss fights, the rest digs and builds as usual.
- No hit invincibility frames: every shotgun pellet and every minion's every attack deals damage.
- The Bestiary is complete: the Soul Tyrant, the Abyss's Siblings, the Spiny Husks, Godhome's Crystal and Enraged Guardians and the Absolute Radiance are recorded and drop loot; a boss in several bodies (the Mantis Lords, the Watcher Knights) counts once per fight; dream and summoned rematches count.

## Multiplayer

- Everyone plays in the host's world: chests, crafting stations and furniture, items on the ground, Life Crystals and dug or built terrain follow the host, and a chest opens for one player at a time; a boss acts only on the players inside its arena, and teammates outside stay where they are.
- On Expert and Master a boss has more life by the number of players (×1.35 for two, ×1.92 for three, ×2.63 for four).

## Map

- The map has a deep and a shallow layer: the rooms behind doors (shops and homes, the Colosseum, the Grimm Troupe's tents, the Archives, the White Palace, the dreams, the trams) are the deep layer; the minimap draws the player's own layer, and the full map's tabs at the bottom left show the current, the shallow or the deep layer.
- The player's head is drawn on the middle of the body.
- Information accessories (watches, Depth Meter, Compass, GPS, DPS Meter, Tally Counter and more) show under the minimap.

## Items and world

- The rest of Terraria's armor (Meteor, Ninja, Mining, Crimson, Cactus, Pumpkin, Gladiator, Fossil, Angler, Ancient, the wood sets, the Old One's Army's tier 2 and 3, the Wizard Hat and the seven gem robes and more), with 1.4.5's set bonuses.
- The rest of the crafting stations (Hellforge, Adamantite and Titanium Forges, Crystal Ball, Imbuing Station, Ancient Manipulator and more); the Demon and Crimson Altars stand in the Temple of the Black Egg.
- The Magic Mirror, the Ice Mirror and the Cell Phone take the player home; the Rods of Discord and Harmony teleport to the cursor.
- Terraria's liquid gear works in acid: the Flipper, Neptune's Shell, the diving gear and the Flipper potion swim in acid unharmed; water walking boots and the Water Walking potion stand on it, and holding down sinks in.
- Enemies the base game's Nail never pushes take no Terraria knockback either (turrets, Fool Eaters, egg sacs, Gulkas, heavy enemies and wall crawlers).
- Crafting works with a chest open, its items counted.
- Common enemies and elites drop twice the ore.
- Mana as in 1.4.5: magic works without enough mana, that use 2.5 times slower; the Mana Flower drinks for channelled weapons.
- Teleporting mid-conversation by a pylon, a mirror or a boss seal closes the dialogue box.
- Boss drops that don't fit a full inventory after a dream or Godhome fight drop at the player's feet back in the Hall of Gods or the world.


## 发布前回归修正 / Final regression fixes

- 修复奥波路波的单体死亡被误判为整场胜利而重复计数、重复掉落；整场结算后其余部件也不再重复结算。
- 修复后台自动测试输入暂停、阶段回血后重复探测开战触发器，以及灵魂大师漏领下砸能力造成的开门误报。
- Fix duplicate multi-body boss credit and loot; correct background test input, phase-transition detection and the Soul Master reward-pickup test.

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight v2.6.1
body:
## 制作栏

- 每套配装的制作栏都列出全部配方：任何职业的武器、盔甲和饰品在哪套配装下都能做（比如小雪怪法杖和小雪怪皮毛外套在近战配装下也能做）。
- 创造模式的制作栏在每套配装下都是全部物品。

---

## Crafting menu

- Every loadout's crafting menu lists every recipe: weapons, armor and accessories of any class can be crafted in any loadout (the Flinx Staff and Flinx Fur Coat in the melee loadout too, for example).
- A Creative mode save's crafting menu holds every item in every loadout.

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight v2.6.0
body:
## 掉落

- 每种怪物的掉落表是它自己的掉落，加上它所在区域对应的泰拉瑞亚群系里的敌人会掉的东西（原版几率，普通怪的装备最高 1/25）和那里宝箱里的两样（各 1/40），各个阶段的都在里面。
- 阶段高于已解锁阶段的物品不掉；怪物图鉴里显示成问号和“阶段 N 解锁后掉落”，不透露是什么，鼠标放上去提示还要再拿几种能力、通常是哪一种。
- 赫尔墨斯靴、飞毯、沙丘行者靴、云朵瓶、暴雪瓶、沙暴瓶、疾风脚镯、幸运马掌、闪亮红气球这些加机动性的前期饰品在阶段 0 就能刷到，几率都不超过 10%。
- 精英的几率是普通怪的三倍（装备最高 1/10），每次被打死必掉一件本区域宝箱和装备里的东西；首领除了标志性物品，还必掉一件它顶替的泰拉瑞亚首领的武器或饰品和一件本区域宝箱里的东西。图鉴里写“N 选 1 必掉”，只在已解锁的物品里挑。
- 吉欧照每种怪对应的泰拉瑞亚敌人的原版钱币定比例，再按区域缩放到和空洞骑士原版的总量相当；首领按阶段封顶（150 / 250 / 400 / 600 / 900 / 1500）。
- 每件物品谁掉、几率多少、每种怪掉多少吉欧，全列在 `掉落记录.md` 里。

## 合成

- 原版只能合成得到的东西由怪物掉的材料按原版配方一级级合成：迷你鲨合成巨兽鲨，魔法书做成水晶风暴、诅咒焰、黄金雨，猩红矿锭做成血腥屠刀、血肉锤、死亡使者镐，烈焰靴加幽灵靴做成狱炎战靴，等等，共补上 38 条原版配方。
- 原版这些配方要用的材料都有：猩红矿和猩红矿锭、组织样本、魔法书、竖琴、沙漠幽魂灯、潜水头盔、烈焰靴、夜明矿（在远古操纵机炼成夜明锭）。
- 能做进别的配方的物品，说明里和原版一样写着“材料”。

## 吉欧和存钱罐

- “快速堆叠至附近的箱子”把背包里的吉欧也收起来：范围内有存钱罐就存进存钱罐，否则放进已经有吉欧的箱子，都没有就放进最近的箱子。范围内的存钱罐也和箱子一样接收它里面已经有的东西。

## 坠星

- 夜里德特茅斯、国王山道、呼啸悬崖和王国边缘这些露天的房间会时不时从天上掉下坠星，照原版的几率和每夜的流星雨加成；十五颗里有一颗落在人物附近。坠星拖着蓝色彗尾、一闪一闪地响，落地变成坠落之星；天亮时地上没捡的化成星光消失。房间顶上至少 24 格宽的开口下面才算天空。

## 敌人

- 深巢的刻尘者（白色的虫子）按原版的数量出现，由游戏自己管：它们会钻进地下、换个地方满血钻出来，游戏还会从对象池里放出新的。

---

## Drops

- Every enemy's drop table holds its own drops, plus what the enemies of its area's Terraria biome drop (at vanilla's rates, an ordinary enemy's equipment at most 1 in 25) and two things from that biome's chests (1 in 40 each), of every stage.
- Items of a stage above the one unlocked don't drop; the Bestiary shows them as a question mark and "Drops once Stage N is unlocked", without telling what they are, and hovering one tells how many more abilities it takes, and usually which.
- The early movement accessories (Hermes Boots, Flying Carpet, Dunerider Boots, Cloud / Blizzard / Sandstorm in a Bottle, Anklet of the Wind, Lucky Horseshoe, Shiny Red Balloon) drop from Stage 0, never above 10%.
- Elites have three times an ordinary enemy's chances (equipment at most 1 in 10) and on every kill give one piece of their area's chest items and equipment for certain; besides its signature items, a boss gives one weapon or accessory of the Terraria boss it stands in for and one of its area's chest items for certain. The Bestiary says "Sure: 1 of N"; the piece is picked among the unlocked ones.
- Geo follows the vanilla coins of each enemy's Terraria counterpart in proportion, scaled per area so the totals match vanilla Hollow Knight's; bosses are capped by stage (150 / 250 / 400 / 600 / 900 / 1500).
- Every item's droppers and chances, and every enemy's Geo, are listed in `掉落记录.md`.

## Crafting

- What Terraria makes only by crafting is crafted from the materials enemies drop, step by step up vanilla's recipes: a Minishark into a Megashark, a Spell Tome into a Crystal Storm, Cursed Flames or Golden Shower, crimtane bars into a Blood Butcherer, Flesh Grinder or Deathbringer Pickaxe, Flame Waker Boots and Spectre Boots into Hellfire Treads, and so on: 38 of vanilla's recipes are added.
- The materials those recipes need are all there: crimtane ore and bars, Tissue Samples, Spell Tomes, the Harp, the Djinn Lamp, the Diving Helmet, the Flame Waker Boots, and luminite ore (smelted into Luminite Bars at the Ancient Manipulator).
- Items that go into another recipe read "Material" in their tooltip, as in Terraria.

## Geo and the Piggy Bank

- "Quick Stack to Nearby Chests" takes the Geo in your inventory too: into a Piggy Bank in range, else into a chest that already holds Geo, else into the nearest chest. A Piggy Bank in range also takes, like a chest, the things it already holds.

## Falling stars

- At night, stars fall from the sky now and then in the rooms under the open sky (Dirtmouth, King's Pass, the Howling Cliffs, Kingdom's Edge), at vanilla's rate with the night's starfall boost; one star in fifteen lands near you. A star trails a blue comet tail and twinkles as it falls, and lands as a Fallen Star; at daybreak the ones left lying vanish in a sparkle. Only under an opening in the room's top at least 24 tiles wide is it sky.

## Enemies

- Deepnest's Dirtcarvers (the white bugs) come in vanilla's numbers and are left to the game: they dig away and come up whole somewhere else by themselves, and the game sends more out of its pool.

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight v2.5.2
body:
## 假骑士

- 假骑士露出的头留在他身边。头是挂在他身上的部件，和他一样不吃泰拉武器的击退；每次被打晕，头都从他身上露出来，场上只有一个头。
- 第二阶段砸穿地板之后的露头也一样。

---

## False Knight

- The False Knight's head stays by him. The head is a part of him and, like him, takes no knockback from Terraria weapons; every time he is stunned it comes out of his body, and there is only one head.
- The same holds after his second phase breaks through the floor.

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight v2.5.1
body:
## 守梦人

- 守梦人的梦里，用泰拉武器或骨钉把守梦人打伤后，拿着梦之钉按住左键或右键就是原版的聚集，吸收守梦人；屏幕中间会提示该按什么。
- 莫诺蒙、卢瑞恩、赫拉三场梦都能从进梦一直走到面具碎裂、回到现实。
- 莫诺蒙和原版一样，要先查看她的水缸、和奎若对话，她才会浮现、能进她的梦。

## 深巢电车票房间

- 电车票房间和失败的电车道帧数稳定。原版把刻尘孵化者的喷射器放在地图外的笼子里待命，笼子的地面保持原样，喷射器安稳地待在里面。

## 敌人

- 复制出来的躯壳哨兵照常巡逻、追击、闪避，音效正常。复制体的每个状态机都照原版的开关来。

## 工作站和箱子

- 工作台、铁砧/铅砧、秘银砧/山铜砧、工匠作坊顶上能站人，按住下能穿下去。
- 它们上面能放别的家具，比如把铁砧或玻璃瓶放在工作台上。
- 工作站脚下的地面被挖掉时，它和放在它上面的家具一起掉回物品。
- 箱子脚下的那格挖不掉；方块和箱子放不进工作站占着的格子。

---

## Dreamers

- In a Dreamer's dream, once a Terraria weapon or the nail has struck the Dreamer down, holding the left or right button with the Dream Nail in hand is vanilla's focus that drains the Dreamer; a note in the middle of the screen says what to press.
- The dreams of Monomon, Lurien and Herrah all play through from entering to the mask breaking and waking up.
- As in vanilla, Monomon rises, and her dream opens, only after you inspect her tank and talk to Quirrel.

## Deepnest's tram pass rooms

- A steady frame rate in the tram pass room and the Failed Tramway. The game keeps the Carver Hatchers' spawners in a cage outside the map; the cage's ground stays as the game made it, and the spawners wait there.

## Enemies

- Copied Husk Sentries patrol, chase and evade as usual, with their usual sounds. Every FSM of a copy is on or off as the original's is.

## Workstations and chests

- The Work Bench, Iron/Lead Anvil, Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil and Tinkerer's Workshop can be stood on, and dropped through with down held.
- Other furniture goes on top of them, such as an anvil or a Bottle on a Work Bench.
- When the ground under a workstation is dug out, it falls back into its item together with what stands on it.
- The cell under a chest can't be dug; blocks and chests can't be placed inside a workstation.

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 2.5.0
body:
泰拉圣巢 2.5.0　｜　English below

## 下载

- **TerraKnight-v2.5.0.zip**：mod 本体和启动器，解压到空洞骑士的游戏目录即可（覆盖旧版，存档保留）
- 安装步骤见 README 的“下载和安装”（[中文](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.md) / [English](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.en.md)）；需要空洞骑士 1.5.12620（Steam 当前正式版）
- 联机的双方都需要 2.5.0

## 首领平衡

- **每个首领按体型和打法单独调整生命、防御和伤害**，在它顶替的泰拉瑞亚首领的数值上再乘自己的倍数：体型大、动作慢、盔甲厚的生命和防御更高（假骑士生命 ×1.15、防御 ×1.5），灵活的生命和防御更低、攻击更高（大黄蜂生命 ×0.8、防御 ×0.6、伤害 ×1.2；格林生命 ×0.85、伤害 ×1.25），靠召唤物或机关攻击的自身伤害更低（吸虫之母伤害 ×0.7）。难度和阶段的倍率照旧作用在这些数值上。每个首领的数值和击杀耗时见 [平衡性测试报告](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/平衡性测试报告.md)。
- **硬直**：原版能被打出硬直的首领（大黄蜂、灵魂大师和灵魂暴君、叛徒领主、蜂巢骑士、残破容器和失落近亲、格林和梦魇之王、空洞骑士、骨钉贤者斯莱、纯粹容器）每受到相当于自身生命 2.2% 的伤害，原版的眩晕计数加一次，节奏和原版用骨钉打时相近；其余首领全程霸体。
- **多阶段首领的生命按阶段分摊**：假骑士的盔甲三轮共占 65%、头三次共占 35%；灵魂大师和灵魂暴君的两个阶段分别占 60% 和 40%。
- 怪物图鉴显示首领整场战斗的总生命；再次遇到已记录的敌人时，图鉴更新它当前的生命、防御和伤害。

## 下砸地板和重锤符文

- **重锤符文的猛击能砸开原版要用荒芜俯冲砸开的地板**：在空中按住下并跳跃向下猛击，落在下砸地板上时把它砸开，人接着往下掉。
- 在原版里拿到荒芜俯冲时得到重锤符文（和螳螂爪得到攀爬爪一样）；已经拿到荒芜俯冲的存档，读档后得到一个。
- 镐子也能挖开下砸地板（按镐力累计，铜镐挖 6 下），炸弹和雷管照旧能炸开。
- 水晶山峰入口和黑暗降临所在房间那种由几块松动地板组成的下砸地板，猛击、炸弹和镐子都能打开。

## 地图

- 在科尼法（制图师）或伊瑟达那里买到某片区域的地图后，这片区域的所有房间都直接画在全屏地图和小地图上，没去过的也画出来，和原版买地图一样。这些房间里的生命水晶要亲自走到看见才显示。

## 召唤物和敌人

- 召唤物和哨兵不击退敌人，它们射出的弹幕和爆炸也一样。
- 阿斯匹德之母孵出的幼体由对象池反复放出，每一只被打死都记入怪物图鉴、照常掉落，掉落物落在它被打死的地方。

## 商店

- 商店开着时，Shift+左键背包里的东西直接卖掉（和 Ctrl+左键一样）。

## 制作

- 制作栏把人物 8 格内箱子里的材料也算进去：合成时先用背包里的，不够再从附近的箱子里取。鼠标放在材料上显示背包和附近箱子里各有多少。

## 地上的物品

- 掉在地上的物品画在场景的植物、墙面和地面前面，在近景前面也看得见。

## 梦之精华

- 低语之根结出的精华球在用梦之钉打根之前不显示，打了以后散开、碰到就收集，和原版一样。

## 生命水晶

- 生命水晶只放在阶段 0 和 1 的区域：国王山道、德特茅斯、遗忘十字路、苍绿之径、真菌荒地、雾之峡谷、呼啸悬崖（首领房间除外），每个存档 24 个。
- 2.4.1 的存档里放在后面区域、还没挖的生命水晶，读档时移到这些区域里的房间；已经挖到的不受影响。

遇到问题欢迎提 Issue，并附上 `BepInEx/LogOutput.log` 和 `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Team Cherry\Hollow Knight\Player.log`。

---

# TerraKnight 2.5.0 (English)

## Download

- **TerraKnight-v2.5.0.zip**: the mod and its launcher. Unzip it into Hollow Knight's game folder (over an older version; saves are kept).
- Installation steps: "Download and installation" in the README ([English](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.en.md) / [中文](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.md)). Requires Hollow Knight 1.5.12620 (the current Steam release).
- For multiplayer, both players need 2.5.0.

## Boss balance

- **Each boss has its own life, defense and damage by its size and fighting style**, as multipliers on top of the Terraria boss it stands in for: big, slow and heavily armoured bosses have more life and defense (the False Knight ×1.15 life, ×1.5 defense), agile ones less life and defense and harder hits (Hornet ×0.8 life, ×0.6 defense, ×1.2 damage; Grimm ×0.85 life, ×1.25 damage), and those that fight through summons or traps deal less damage themselves (Flukemarm ×0.7 damage). The difficulty and stage multipliers apply to these values as before. Every boss's numbers and kill times are in the [balance report](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/平衡性测试报告.en.md).
- **Staggers**: the bosses vanilla can stagger (Hornet, the Soul Master and Soul Tyrant, the Traitor Lord, the Hive Knight, the Broken Vessel and Lost Kin, Grimm and Nightmare King Grimm, the Hollow Knight, the Nailsage Sly, the Pure Vessel) add one to vanilla's stun counter for every 2.2% of their life they take, at about the pace of the vanilla nail; the other bosses have super armour the whole time.
- **Multi-phase bosses share their life out over their phases**: the False Knight's armour takes 65% over its three rounds and his head 35% over his three times out; the Soul Master's and the Soul Tyrant's two phases take 60% and 40%.
- The Bestiary shows a boss's life for the whole fight, and updates an enemy's current life, defense and damage each time you meet it again.

## Dive floors and the Ram Rune

- **The Ram Rune's slam breaks the floors vanilla breaks with Desolate Dive**: in the air, hold Down and jump to slam downward; landing on a dive floor smashes it open, and you fall on through.
- Getting Desolate Dive in vanilla gives the Ram Rune (as the Mantis Claw gives the Climbing Claws); a save that already has Desolate Dive gets one when it is loaded.
- A pickaxe digs dive floors open too (pick power adds up; 6 swings of a Copper Pickaxe), and bombs and dynamite still blow them open.
- The dive floors made of several loose boards, at the entrance of Crystal Peak and in the room of Descending Dark, open to the slam, bombs and pickaxes as well.

## Map

- Once you buy an area's map from Cornifer or Iselda, every room of that area is drawn on the full map and the minimap, the ones you have not visited included, as in vanilla. The Life Crystals in those rooms show only once you have seen them yourself.

## Minions and enemies

- Minions and sentries do not knock enemies back, nor do the projectiles and explosions they fire.
- The Aspid Mother's hatchlings come again and again from their pool; each one killed counts in the Bestiary and drops loot as usual, where it died.

## Shops

- While a shop is open, Shift+left-click sells an item in your inventory (as Ctrl+left-click does).

## Crafting

- The crafting menu also counts the materials in chests within 8 tiles of you: crafting uses the inventory's first, then the nearby chests'. Hovering a material shows how many are in your inventory and in chests nearby.

## Items on the ground

- Dropped items are drawn in front of the scene's plants, walls and ground, so they show in front of the near scenery.

## Dream Essence

- The essence orbs of a Whispering Root stay hidden until the Dream Nail strikes the root; then they spread out and are collected on touch, as in vanilla.

## Life Crystals

- Life Crystals lie only in the Stage 0 and 1 areas: King's Pass, Dirtmouth, the Forgotten Crossroads, Greenpath, the Fungal Wastes, Fog Canyon and the Howling Cliffs (boss rooms excepted), 24 per save.
- Unmined crystals that a 2.4.1 save placed in later areas move to rooms in these areas when the save is loaded; crystals already mined are not affected.

If you run into a problem, please open an Issue and attach `BepInEx/LogOutput.log` and `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Team Cherry\Hollow Knight\Player.log`.

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 2.4.1
body:
泰拉圣巢 2.4.1　｜　English below

## 下载

- **TerraKnight-v2.4.1.zip**：mod 本体和启动器，解压到空洞骑士的游戏目录即可（覆盖旧版，存档保留）
- 安装步骤见 README 的“下载和安装”（[中文](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.md) / [English](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.en.md)）；需要空洞骑士 1.5.12620（Steam 当前正式版）
- 联机的双方都需要 2.4.1

## 骨钉和梦之钉

- **骨钉按阶段造成泰拉瑞亚伤害**：阶段 0 到 5 分别是 14、26、42、60、85、125。打中敌人时和泰拉瑞亚的武器一样显示伤害数字、能暴击；原版的格挡、下劈弹跳、攒灵魂照常。
- **骨钉匠的升级**：骨钉匠提供原版的四次升级（苍白矿石加吉欧，吉欧按背包加存钱罐的总数付）。每次升级让骨钉的伤害再提高 25%，纯粹骨钉是两倍。
- **骨钉的后退**：骨钉打中东西后的后退距离和原版一致，泰拉瑞亚的移动手感下人物站得住。
- **觉醒梦之钉**：在先知那里觉醒梦之钉后，梦之钉的伤害再提高 50%。
- 骨钉和梦之钉是永久保留的物品，不出现在制作栏里。

## 生命水晶

- 每个存档在地上放 24 个生命水晶，分布在国王山道、遗忘十字路、苍绿之径、呼啸悬崖、真菌荒地、雾之峡谷、王后花园、泪水之城、皇家水道、水晶山峰和深巢（首领房间除外）。较早版本的存档读档时补足 24 个，已有的位置保持不变。
- 能吃的生命水晶数量是 6 个，加上额外面具的个数和击败过的不同首领数，最多 15 个。超出的生命水晶留在背包里，等上限提高再吃，屏幕中间会说明原因。集齐面具送的生命水晶和首领掉落的生命水晶照常获得。

## 界面

- 怪物图鉴里掉落物多时，把鼠标放在掉落物上用滚轮翻看，右边有滚动条。
- 骨钉、梦之钉的名字和说明有全部 10 种语言。

## 启动器

- 游戏目录的 `hollow_knight_Data\Managed` 里有空洞骑士 Modding API（Scarab、Lumafly 等模组管理器安装的）放进去的 MonoMod、Mono.Cecil 时，BepInEx 会启动失败（日志里是 `MissingMethodException: ... DynamicMethodDefinition.get_Definition()`）。启动器检测到这些文件时弹出中英双语的说明，列出冲突的文件和处理办法，不带着冲突启动。处理办法：在模组管理器里关闭 Modding API；或者在 Steam 里验证游戏文件的完整性，再删掉 `Managed` 里的 `MonoMod*.dll`、`Mono.Cecil*.dll`、`MMHOOK_*.dll`。

遇到问题欢迎提 Issue，并附上 `BepInEx/LogOutput.log` 和 `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Team Cherry\Hollow Knight\Player.log`。

---

# TerraKnight 2.4.1 (English)

## Download

- **TerraKnight-v2.4.1.zip**: the mod and its launcher. Unzip it into Hollow Knight's game folder (over an older version; saves are kept).
- Installation steps: "Download and installation" in the README ([English](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.en.md) / [中文](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.md)). Requires Hollow Knight 1.5.12620 (the current Steam release).
- For multiplayer, both players need 2.4.1.

## The Nail and the Dream Nail

- **The Nail deals Terraria damage by stage**: 14, 26, 42, 60, 85 and 125 for Stages 0 to 5. Its hits show damage numbers and can land critical strikes like a Terraria weapon's; the vanilla parry, down-slash bounce and Soul gain stay as they are.
- **The Nailsmith's upgrades**: the Nailsmith offers the four vanilla upgrades (Pale Ore plus Geo, paid from the inventory and the Piggy Bank together). Each upgrade adds 25% to the Nail's damage, so the Pure Nail deals double.
- **Nail recoil**: the recoil after the Nail strikes something matches the vanilla nail's, and the player stays put under Terraria's movement.
- **The Awoken Dream Nail**: once the Seer has awoken the Dream Nail, it deals 50% more damage.
- The Nail and the Dream Nail are permanent items and do not appear in the crafting menu.

## Life Crystals

- Each save places 24 Life Crystals in the world, across King's Pass, the Forgotten Crossroads, Greenpath, the Howling Cliffs, the Fungal Wastes, Fog Canyon, Queen's Gardens, the City of Tears, the Royal Waterways, Crystal Peak and Deepnest (boss rooms excepted). A save from an earlier version is topped up to 24 when loaded, and the crystals it already has stay where they are.
- You can eat 6 Life Crystals, plus one for each extra mask and one for each different boss you have beaten, up to 15. Crystals beyond that stay in your inventory until the limit rises, and a notice in the middle of the screen says why. The crystals given for completed masks and dropped by bosses come as before.

## Interface

- A long list of drops in the Bestiary scrolls with the mouse wheel over it, with a scroll bar at the side.
- The Nail's and the Dream Nail's names and descriptions are in all 10 languages.

## Launcher

- When `hollow_knight_Data\Managed` in the game folder holds the MonoMod and Mono.Cecil that the Hollow Knight Modding API puts there (installed by a mod manager such as Scarab or Lumafly), BepInEx fails to start (the log shows `MissingMethodException: ... DynamicMethodDefinition.get_Definition()`). The launcher detects these files and shows a bilingual explanation listing the conflicting files and what to do, instead of starting with the conflict. What to do: turn the Modding API off in the mod manager, or verify the game files in Steam and then delete `MonoMod*.dll`, `Mono.Cecil*.dll` and `MMHOOK_*.dll` from `Managed`.

Please report problems as Issues, with `BepInEx/LogOutput.log` and `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Team Cherry\Hollow Knight\Player.log` attached.

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 2.4.0
body:
泰拉圣巢 2.4.0　｜　English below

## 下载

- **TerraKnight-v2.4.0.zip**：mod 本体和启动器，解压到空洞骑士的游戏目录即可（覆盖旧版，存档保留）
- 安装步骤见 README 的“下载和安装”（[中文](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.md) / [English](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.en.md)）；需要空洞骑士 1.5.12620（Steam 当前正式版）
- 联机的双方都需要 2.4.0

## 主要内容

- **泰拉瑞亚式光照**：光按格子一格一格向外传播，空气里每过一格保留 91%，穿过方块每格保留 56%。火把、手持火把、挖矿头盔、子弹和法术、爆炸、晶塔的光柔和地照亮周围的场景，离光源越远越暗。挖开的隧道和放下的方块只在光传到的地方亮，洞口透进来的光沿隧道逐渐变暗；原版房间的空地和地形保持原版的样子。黑暗区域（深巢、水晶山峰的矿道等）按泰拉瑞亚的方式是暗的：主角身边看得见一小圈，光蝇灯笼、挖矿头盔、火把可以照亮。配置 `Gameplay.TerrariaLighting` 可以关闭泰拉瑞亚光照，改用简单的光晕。
- **原版的场景切换**：地图使用空洞骑士原版的过门读取，一个房间一个房间地走，镜头也是原版的（房间锁定、前瞻）。挖掘、建造和其他 mod 内容照常，去过的地方在地图上点亮。无缝地图作为实验功能保留，默认关闭（配置 `Gameplay.SeamlessWorldExperimental`、`Gameplay.CenteredCameraExperimental`）。
- **首领房间保留原版地形**：首领房间不能挖、不能建，碰撞和贴图都是原版的，首领在平台边缘、墙边的行为和原版一致。

## 首领战

- **进入战斗区域才能开打**：主角和首领之间隔着房间的战斗铁门时，泰拉武器、召唤物、哨兵和弹幕都打不中首领，也不会把它吵醒，屏幕正中间提示“先进入首领的战斗区域”。
- **叫醒睡着的首领**：进入首领房间后，近战、远程、法术、召唤物都能打中并叫醒睡着的首领（比如格鲁兹之母）。叫醒的那一下只扣 1 点血；唤醒动画、吼叫和过场期间不扣血，结束后正常开打。
- **格鲁兹之母的战斗铁门**：她的一窝小格鲁兹在开战前藏在地面以下，开战后放出。地图以外的敌人不受攻击，追踪弹和召唤物也不会去追，战斗打完后两侧铁门正常打开。
- **假骑士**：头钻出来时，打在倒地的盔甲上的攻击不算打头，头露出 5 秒后照常缩回、继续战斗；大血条显示头的血量。
- **三螳螂**：大血条显示正在挨打的那一只。
- **梦境首领**：失败冠军、灵魂暴君、失落近亲分别按骷髅王（阶段 2）、血肉墙（阶段 3）、毁灭者（阶段 4）的强度，掉落对应首领的物品；火星飞碟、双足翼龙、光之女皇的装备由神居的骨钉大师兄弟、绘画大师席奥、纯粹容器掉落。梦境首领打完记入图鉴并掉落物品。
- **追踪类武器**：天顶剑、追踪弹、剑的追踪特效和泰拉瑞亚一样只追当下能受伤的目标，遇到无敌的部位（比如倒地的假骑士盔甲）就去打旁边能受伤的部位。
- 子弹、爆炸、召唤物打中敌人时，像原版法术一样先通知敌人受伤，靠这个醒来的敌人能被泰拉武器叫醒。

## 移动和操作

- **抓钩上起跳**：被抓钩拉着时（比如跳起来再勾）按跳跃会起跳，和挂在钩上不动时一样；按住下再按跳只松开抓钩。
- **泰拉瑞亚武器打中东西不后退**：泰拉瑞亚的武器打到尖刺、盔甲、硬壳、可破坏的墙这类原版会“叮”一声的东西时，人物站在原地，和泰拉瑞亚一样；“骨钉”物品保持原版骨钉的手感。
- **传送带**（水晶山峰）：不能操作的时候（捡东西、过场、对话等），传送带按原版的速度带着人走。
- **改键支持鼠标**：可以绑鼠标中键和两个侧键（和泰拉瑞亚一样记作 Mouse3 / Mouse4 / Mouse5），移动和跳跃也能绑到侧键上。
- 智能光标开着时，放方块吸附到离光标最近的可放位置（泰拉瑞亚的智能放块）。
- 地图（M）可以用 WASD 移动。
- 泰拉武器的特效（弹幕、挥砍特效、鞭子、天顶剑的飞剑、粒子）画在最上层，和泰拉瑞亚一样始终在场景前面。

## 世界和敌人

- **复活点**：还没在任何长椅上休息过时，死后回到开局出现的地方（国王山道里传送门所在的地面），和泰拉瑞亚没有床时回到世界出生点一样。长椅坐过一次才成为复活点，德特茅斯的长椅也是如此。
- **刷新**：怪物刷新前 3 秒，出生点上出现半透明的虚影，虚影只用来看，没有碰撞。出生点被自己放的方块或平台占住时，怪在附近最近的空位刷出，虚影也显示在那里。掉出地图且没有被原版死亡区接住的怪，3 秒后收回，到时间在出生点重新刷出。
- 大型敌人和精英在同一个房间里刷新得慢一些（大怪 3 分钟、精英 5 分钟）。
- 挖掘次数和泰拉瑞亚一致：木块用铜镐 3 下、金镐 2 下；木平台是普通方块。
- 击退：臭蛋口袋（Bluggsac）、真菌球（Fungoon）不受击退；华丽躯壳可以被击退（和原版一样能推动）。
- **进房间时的落差**：原版很多房间的门开在半空。从侧门、底门进房间、还没落地的那一段不算摔落伤害；首领房间里也不算。站稳后自己跳下去、从顶门掉进来照常计算。
- 往上穿过房间顶部的门（遗忘十字路柯尼法那里、苍绿之径无眼门口长椅上方等）能正常到达上面的房间。
- 地形按它所在的房间识别，首领房间、德特茅斯的城镇居民都认得出自己的房间。
- 梦境跑酷中掉出场景底部按掉进深坑处理，回到上一个安全落脚点。

## 物品和经济

- **骨钉物品**：开局就有、永久保留的“骨钉”，拿在手上左键就是原版骨钉，能格挡、能下劈弹跳。安息之地的瑞维克可以用它格挡；任何攻击在瑞维克出刀前后打中他都算格挡，把他打散一会儿。
- **存钱罐的钱能付原版费用**：长椅、鹿角站、斯莱的商店按背包加存钱罐的总数计算，先扣背包再扣存钱罐；左上角显示总数。死后亡魂只带走背包里的钱。
- 合成栏里能用材料做的火把和绳子只显示合成的那一条；花钱的那一条标明“购买（不用材料）”。合成不花钱。
- 弱效治疗药水、治疗药水和泰拉瑞亚一样有 60 秒药水病。
- 酸泪本身就能让人在酸水里游泳。
- 卖出物品后按住鼠标不会把它买回来；召唤物（史莱姆宝宝等）不去拉拉杆。

## 稳定性

- 从主菜单再开一个存档、或者改过按键之后，mod 的按键（WASD 等）照常工作，原版暂停键和背包各自独立。
- 创造模式开新档时，开局准备的每一步都单独保护，任何一步出问题都不影响进入游戏。
- 读档后坐在长椅上时，长椅没收到起身键的话，mod 在 0.3 秒后替它起身（暂停、背包开着时不起身）。

遇到问题欢迎提 Issue，并附上 `BepInEx/LogOutput.log` 和 `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Team Cherry\Hollow Knight\Player.log`。

---

# TerraKnight 2.4.0 (English)

## Download

- **TerraKnight-v2.4.0.zip**: the mod and its launcher. Unzip it into Hollow Knight's game folder (over an older version; saves are kept).
- Installation steps: "Download and install" in the README ([English](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.en.md) / [中文](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/blob/main/README.md)). Requires Hollow Knight 1.5.12620 (the current Steam release).
- For multiplayer, both players need 2.4.0.

## Highlights

- **Terraria lighting**: light spreads tile by tile, keeping 91% per tile through the air and 56% per tile through blocks. Torches, a held torch, the Mining Helmet, bullets and spells, explosions and pylons light the scene around them softly, dimmer the farther from the source. Dug tunnels and placed blocks are lit only where light reaches them, and light coming in through a cave mouth fades along the tunnel; the open air and terrain of vanilla rooms look as the game paints them. Dark areas (Deepnest, Crystal Peak's mines and so on) are dark the Terraria way: the Knight sees a small circle around itself, and the Lumafly Lantern, the Mining Helmet and torches light them up. The config `Gameplay.TerrariaLighting` turns Terraria lighting off in favour of a simple glow.
- **Vanilla room transitions**: the map uses Hollow Knight's own transitions, loading at each door, room by room, with the vanilla camera (room locks, look-ahead). Digging, building and all other mod content work as usual, and visited places light up on the map. The seamless world remains as an experimental option, off by default (`Gameplay.SeamlessWorldExperimental`, `Gameplay.CenteredCameraExperimental`).
- **Vanilla terrain in boss rooms**: boss rooms cannot be dug or built in, and their collision and art are the vanilla ones, so bosses behave at platform edges and walls exactly as in the base game.

## Boss fights

- **Fights start inside the arena**: while a battle gate of the room stands between the Knight and the boss, Terraria weapons, minions, sentries and projectiles cannot hit the boss or wake it, and "Enter the boss arena first" appears in the middle of the screen.
- **Waking sleeping bosses**: inside the boss room, melee, ranged, magic and minion attacks all hit and wake a sleeping boss (Gruz Mother, for example). The waking hit deals exactly 1 damage; no damage counts during the wake-up animation, roar and cutscene, and the fight proper begins once they end.
- **Gruz Mother's battle gates**: her brood waits below the floor until the fight starts. Enemies outside the map cannot be hit, and homing shots and minions do not chase them, so both battle gates open when the fight is won.
- **False Knight**: while his head is out, hits on the fallen armour do not count as hits on the head, so the head goes back in after its 5 seconds and the fight carries on; the boss bar shows the head's health.
- **Mantis Lords**: the boss bar shows the lord being hit.
- **Dream bosses**: Failed Champion, Soul Tyrant and Lost Kin have the strength of Skeletron (Stage 2), the Wall of Flesh (Stage 3) and The Destroyer (Stage 4) and drop those bosses' items. The Martian Saucer, Betsy and Empress of Light gear drops from the Nailmaster brothers in Godhome, Paintmaster Sheo and the Pure Vessel. Dream bosses are recorded in the Bestiary and drop their loot.
- **Homing weapons**: the Zenith, homing shots and swords' homing effects chase only targets that can be hurt right now, as in Terraria; facing an invincible part (such as the False Knight's fallen armour) they strike the part next to it that can be hurt.
- Bullets, explosions and minions tell the enemy it was hurt, as vanilla spells do, so enemies that wake on that signal wake to Terraria weapons.

## Movement and controls

- **Jumping off a grappling hook**: pressing Jump while the hook pulls you (for example, hooking in mid-jump) jumps off it, just as when hanging still; Down + Jump only lets go.
- **No recoil from Terraria hits**: when a Terraria weapon strikes spikes, armour, shells, breakable walls or anything else the base game answers with a "tink", the player stays put, as in Terraria. The Nail item keeps the vanilla nail's feel.
- **Conveyor belts** (Crystal Peak): while the player has no control (picking something up, a cutscene, dialogue), a belt carries the Knight at the vanilla speed.
- **Mouse buttons in key bindings**: the middle button and both side buttons can be bound (written Mouse3 / Mouse4 / Mouse5, as in Terraria), movement and Jump included.
- With Smart Cursor on, block placement snaps to the placeable spot nearest the cursor (Terraria's smart placement).
- The map (M) pans with WASD.
- Terraria weapon effects (projectiles, swing effects, whips, the Zenith's swords, particles) are drawn on the top layer, always in front of the scenery, as in Terraria.

## World and enemies

- **Respawn point**: before the player has rested on any bench, death brings the player back where the game began (the ground in King's Pass where the portal opens), like Terraria's world spawn for a player without a bed. A bench becomes the respawn point once the player has sat on it, Dirtmouth's included.
- **Respawning enemies**: 3 seconds before an enemy respawns, a translucent ghost of it appears on its spawn point; the ghost is only a visual and has no collision. When blocks or platforms the player placed occupy the spawn point, the enemy appears in the nearest free spot nearby, and its ghost shows there. An enemy that falls out of the map without landing in a vanilla kill zone is collected after 3 seconds and respawns on its spot when its time comes.
- Large enemies and elites respawn more slowly in the same room (large enemies 3 minutes, elites 5 minutes).
- Mining takes as many hits as in Terraria: 3 with a Copper Pickaxe and 2 with a Gold Pickaxe for wood; Wood Platforms are ordinary blocks.
- Knockback: Bluggsacs and Fungoons take no knockback; Gorgeous Husks can be knocked back (they can be pushed in the base game too).
- **Drops on entering a room**: many vanilla doors open in mid-air. The fall after entering through a side or bottom door, until the Knight lands, deals no fall damage, and neither does any fall in a boss room. Jumping down after landing, or dropping in through a top door, counts as usual.
- Going up through a door at the top of a room (by Cornifer in the Forgotten Crossroads, above the bench by No Eyes' door in Greenpath and so on) arrives in the room above.
- Terrain is identified by the room it belongs to, so boss rooms and Dirtmouth's townsfolk always know their room.
- In the dream platforming sections, falling out of the bottom of the scene counts as falling into a pit and returns the Knight to the last safe ground.

## Items and economy

- **The Nail item**: a permanent Nail is in the inventory from the start. Held, the left mouse button swings the vanilla nail, with parries and pogo bounces. Revek in the Resting Grounds can be parried with it; any attack that hits him just before or after his slash also counts as a parry and scatters him for a while.
- **Piggy Bank Geo pays vanilla costs**: benches, Stag Stations and Sly's shop count the inventory plus the Piggy Bank, taking from the inventory first and then from the Piggy Bank; the top-left counter shows the total. On death, the shade takes only the Geo carried in the inventory.
- In the crafting menu, torches and rope that can be crafted from materials show only the crafting entry; the paid entry reads "Buy (no materials)". Crafting costs no Geo.
- Lesser Healing Potions and Healing Potions give 60 seconds of potion sickness, as in Terraria.
- Isma's Tear alone lets the Knight swim in acid.
- Holding the mouse button after selling an item does not buy it back; minions (Baby Slime and others) do not pull levers.

## Stability

- After starting another save from the main menu, or after changing key bindings, the mod's keys (WASD and the rest) work as usual, and the vanilla pause key and the inventory stay separate.
- Each step of a Creative mode new game's setup is guarded on its own, so no single step can keep the game from starting.
- When a loaded save starts on a bench and the bench misses the get-up key, the mod gets the Knight up after 0.3 seconds (not while paused or with the inventory open).

Please report problems as Issues, with `BepInEx/LogOutput.log` and `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Team Cherry\Hollow Knight\Player.log` attached.

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 2.3.0
body:
泰拉圣巢 2.3.0

## 下载

- **TerraKnight-v2.3.0.zip**：mod 本体和启动器，解压到空洞骑士的游戏目录（覆盖旧版即可，存档保留）
- 安装步骤见 README 的“下载和安装”；需要空洞骑士 1.5.12620（Steam 当前正式版）
- 联机的双方都要更新到 2.3.0，版本不同不能互联

## 新增

- **梦之钉**：拿到原版的梦之钉后，背包里多一件“梦之钉”，永久保留（不能卖、扔、丢进垃圾桶，丢了会自动补回来）。拿在手上时鼠标左键或右键就是原版的梦钉键：按住蓄力、挥出读心、进梦境，按住 S / W 挥出放下 / 传送梦之门，动画和流程都是原版的。挥砍还会造成随阶段提升的近战伤害（40 → 300）。
- **吉欧变成实体物品**：背包里的“吉欧”就是你的钱，一叠最多 2,147,483,647，可以扔在地上、放进箱子、存进**猪猪存钱罐**（商人卖，放下后右键打开 40 格私人仓库）。原版的拾取、鹿角站和长椅收费、亡魂都照旧，扣的是背包里的；存钱罐里的钱死了不会丢，买东西时背包不够会接着从存钱罐扣。老存档第一次读档时原来的吉欧会换成等量的吉欧物品。
- **矿石和熔炼**：怪物掉矿石不再掉锭（数量按几矿一锭折算），在熔炉、地狱熔炉、精金熔炉炼成锭。新加锡、铅、银、钨、铂金五套盔甲，套装奖励 +2 / +3 / +3 / +3 / +4 防御。
- **其他装备页**：装备栏上方的切页图标打开宠物、照明宠物、矿车、坐骑、钩爪五格；钩爪现在有自己的格子（新档开局就装在里面），按 E 先用格子里的。
- **箱子和背包按钮**：箱子加“补货”和“排序物品”；不开箱子时背包旁边有“快速堆叠至附近的箱子”和“排序物品”。
- **地图上显示生命水晶**（探索过的地方）。

## 改动

- **阶段按小骑士获得的能力划分**：蛾翼披风、螳螂爪、水晶之心、帝王之翼、暗影披风各开一个阶段（NPC 搬来、商店上新、工作站配方），区域也按这条路线重新分（比如真菌荒地和螳螂村现在是阶段 1，对应克苏鲁之眼之后）。向导会提示下一样该去找什么。
- **首领房间禁止改动地形**：首领和精英的房间里不能挖、不能建、炸不动，原汁原味地打。
- **无敌帧**：怪物挨打后有一小段无敌帧（首领 10 帧、精英 8 帧、普通怪 4 帧），召唤物海和高射速武器不再能随便打穿首领；持续伤害不受影响。
- **价格重新调整**：1 银币以内的东西照原价，更贵的按价值的 0.8 次方增长（1 金约 40 吉欧，10 金约 250，1 铂金约 1600），卖价仍是五分之一，刷贵的怪卖钱不再一夜暴富。
- **难度之间的掉落差距缩小**：困难 / 专家 / 大师的掉率是普通的 1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 倍，数量上限多 15% / 30% / 50%；吉欧多掉一些（1.25 / 1.5 / 2 倍）。
- 只用无价值材料就能做出来的东西（工作台、木头盔甲……）也卖不了钱。
- 地上没捡的掉落物不再存档，退出游戏就清掉，不会越玩越卡。

## 修正

- **假骑士“假死”**：打倒后不掉东西、图鉴不记、尸体挂着血条打不死。原因是它的死亡是自己的状态机处理的，不经过一般的死亡流程。现在这一刻就记入图鉴、掉落，尸体不再显示血条。其他靠自己状态机“死”的首领也会补记击杀。
- **假骑士打不死**：用泰拉瑞亚武器在它倒地后的暴怒里把盔甲打空，它会在暴怒中途再次倒地，第三次倒地永远等不到，地板也不会塌。现在暴怒期间盔甲是霸体（打不动），暴怒结束照常进入下一轮。
- **首领在吼叫时被打死，主角一直不能动**：首领开场吼叫会定住主角，吼叫结束才放开；召唤物、飞行中的弹幕或持续伤害在吼叫中把它打死，放开的那一步就永远不来（吸虫之母最容易碰到）。现在吼叫的首领死了几秒后主角会被放开。同样，收走控制权的剧情如果在主角离开那一刻被卸载（比如打完苍绿之径的大黄蜂、她开口时用晶塔传送走），也会把控制权还给主角，不会到了别处一直不能动。
- **王国边缘的大黄蜂**打赢后不记图鉴、不掉落（她第二次战败只是跪下离开，原版不会再记一次击杀），现在照常记入并掉落。
- 创造模式图鉴里挑战**守望者骑士**：之前进去骑士不出现（它们的竞技场只给从上面房间走下来的玩家载入），现在照常开战。
- 改了空洞骑士自己的键盘设置之后，WASD 等泰拉瑞亚按键会自动补回来，不会再变回方向键。
- 哥布林工匠卖工匠作坊（2.1.0 已修）、5 号以后存档位的修正（2.1.0）照旧。

遇到问题欢迎提 Issue（附上 `BepInEx/LogOutput.log`）。日志里以 `[怪物死亡]` 开头的行记着不是玩家打死的怪物的死因。

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 2.1.0
body:
泰拉圣巢 2.1.0

## 下载

- **TerraKnight-v2.1.0.zip**：mod 本体和启动器，解压到空洞骑士的游戏目录（覆盖旧版即可，存档保留）
- 安装步骤见 README 的“下载和安装”；需要空洞骑士 1.5.12620（Steam 当前正式版）
- 联机的双方都要更新到 2.1.0，版本不同不能互联

## 存档修正（重要）

- **5 号以后的存档位退出到主菜单就显示“损坏”**：2.0 加了 50 个存档位，但原版只认 0–4 号，读存档信息、读档、删档都会被拒绝，于是 5 号以后的存档一回主菜单就显示成损坏、点不进去。**存档文件本身并没有坏**，装上 2.1.0 就能正常显示和读档。请不要对这些“损坏”的存档点清除。
- **mod 存档写得更稳**：先完整写到旁边的临时文件再整个替换，上一份留作 `.bak`；读不出来时自动改用上一份，读不了的文件另存为 `.broken-时间`，不会被下一次保存覆盖掉。

## 新增

- **生命水晶散落在前期地图里**：每个存档在国王山道、遗忘十字路、苍绿之径、呼啸悬崖里随机挑 12 个房间，各放一个生命水晶在两格宽的平地上（从房间的门走得到，远离尖刺、酸水和水），每个存档的位置都不一样。用任何镐子挖下来；挖掉它脚下的地面也会掉。
- **每凑满一个新面具送一个生命水晶**；以前已经拿到的面具在第一次读档时补上。加上毛里克、水晶守卫、无眼必掉的 3 个，普通流程能凑满 15 个，生命果也就能吃了。
- **哥布林工匠卖工匠作坊**（以前标着商店有卖，其实谁都不卖）。
- **大师模式多一个饰品栏**（和泰拉瑞亚一样）。

## 改动

- **阶段解锁改为打败上一阶段的最终首领**：假骑士 → 阶段 1，苍绿之径的大黄蜂 → 2，灵魂大师 → 3，守望者骑士 → 4，残破容器 → 5（以前是走进哪个区域就算到了哪个阶段）。解锁后德特茅斯搬来新 NPC、商店上新、工作站开放新配方；已经搬来的 NPC 不会走。向导的对话会提示下一个该打谁。敌人的强度和掉落还是按它所在的区域。
- **怪物刷新不再是 5 秒**：按怪的强弱分档，原版血量 10 以下 30 秒、25 以下 45 秒、50 以下 70 秒、更结实的 100 秒，精英 4 分钟（配置 `EnemyRespawnScale` 是这些时间的倍数，0 为不刷新）。刷出来前 3 秒，出生点会先出现它的半透明虚影；你站在出生点旁边时，它等你走开再刷。
- **堆叠上限 9999**；原版没有价值的东西（土块、石块、木材这类）卖不了钱。

## 排查

- 有玩家反馈“怪物自己死掉”。目前在测试里还没复现，这一版会把**不是玩家打死的怪物**记进 `BepInEx/LogOutput.log`（以 `[怪物死亡]` 开头，写着是哪只怪、什么死因、谁调用的）。遇到时请把这个日志发过来。

遇到问题欢迎提 Issue（附上 `BepInEx/LogOutput.log`）。

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight 2.0.1
body:
泰拉圣巢 2.0.1

## 下载

- **TerraKnight-v2.0.1.zip**：mod 本体和启动器，解压到空洞骑士的游戏目录（覆盖旧版即可，存档保留）
- 安装步骤见 README 的“下载和安装”；需要空洞骑士 1.5.12620（Steam 当前正式版）
- 联机的双方都要更新到 2.0.1，版本不同不能互联

## 修正

- **镜头**：一直锁在人物正中间。不再停在房间原版的镜头最低高度和场景边缘，也没有跟随延迟。
- **隔壁场景的怪过不来**：门口的挡怪墙和每道门自带的挡怪板，在门接上隔壁场景时关掉，两边的怪能互相走过去、追过去；门没接上时照旧挡着，怪不会走出世界。怪跟到隔壁场景后，如果那个场景被卸载，它会停在原地，等场景再载入时接着动。
- **鹿角站把人传到别处**：从隔壁无缝走进车站后，站在鹿角虫面前按上，会被传到黑卵神殿。原因是无缝载入的场景里，原版本来关着的状态机被一起打开了（车站到站点有一扇废弃的门，目的地写的是黑卵神殿）。现在照原版保持关着，这个问题也不会再出现在别的场景里。
- **死后复活点**：还没在任何长椅上休息过就死了，会在德特茅斯的长椅上醒来（原版是德特茅斯入口的高台，那里没有长椅，也没有晶塔）。
- **机关**：铃、拉杆、罐子、藤蔓、可破坏的墙这类要用骨钉打的东西，泰拉瑞亚的所有攻击都能触发：剑、短剑、弹幕、法术、鞭子、悠悠球、召唤物、哨兵。每个机关每 0.25 秒最多算一次。
- **平台**：从高处落下不会再掉穿平台；抓钩能勾住平台；首领和精英会穿过玩家放的平台，不会被平台卡住。

## 新增

- **向导的“制作”**：和向导对话时多了“制作”按钮。把一种材料放进制作栏上方的槽里，制作栏就列出所有用到它的配方，旁边写着要用的工作站（只能查看，不能在这里制作）。

遇到问题欢迎提 Issue（附上 `BepInEx/LogOutput.log`）。

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight v2.0.0
body:
泰拉圣巢 2.0.0

## 下载

- **TerraKnight-v2.0.0.zip**：mod 本体和启动器，解压到空洞骑士的游戏目录（覆盖旧版即可）
- 宣传片见 [v0.1.0](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/releases/tag/v0.1.0)；安装步骤见 README 的“下载和安装”
- 需要空洞骑士 1.5.12620（Steam 当前正式版）。如果日志第二行是 `Running under Unity v2020...`，说明游戏是 1.5.78 旧版：Steam 里右键空洞骑士 → 属性 → 测试版，选“无”

## 新增

**局域网多人模式（IP 直连）**
- 存档界面左下角“多人模式”：开服并开始游戏（密码、端口，默认 7777，最多 16 人），或者通过IP加入。照泰拉瑞亚的联机流程，版本不同、重名、密码错误都会被拒绝，提示文字用泰拉瑞亚自己的。
- 每个人带自己的存档进来，在同一个场景里能看到彼此：动作、手里的武器和挥砍、盔甲翅膀、名字、血条，地图上也有其他人的头像。
- 聊天：Enter 打开，`/p` 队伍消息、`/me`、`/roll`、`/playing`、`/death`、`/help`；说的话在头顶冒出来。
- 别人的箭、魔法、召唤物都会画在你这边；挖掉、放下的方块对所有人生效；昼夜跟着主机走。
- 敌人：同一个场景先到的玩家负责敌人的行动，其他人那边的敌人跟着他动、碰到照样受伤；你打中的伤害交给他结算，敌人死了每个人都拿到自己的掉落。
- PvP 和队伍：背包里装备栏左边的交叉剑和六色盾牌。被玩家打死时聊天里显示“X，凶手是 Y 的 Z。”。
- 还做不到：敌人只追负责它的那个玩家，敌人的子弹只在他那边有伤害；没有 Steam 好友邀请。双方要用同一个版本。

**泰拉瑞亚设置**
- 背包右下角“设置”上面多了“泰拉瑞亚设置”：泰拉瑞亚的“自动开火”（按住鼠标所有武器一直挥、一直射）、敌人血条显示方式，以及全部泰拉瑞亚按键的改键（点动作再按新键，Esc 取消，可重置为默认）。“设置”还是空洞骑士自己的设置。

**50 个存档位**
- 存档界面标题下面翻页（也可以用 PageUp / PageDown 或滚轮），每页 4 个，编号就是存档位号，打开时自动翻到上次玩的那一页。

## 修正

- 贴墙下滑（攀爬爪、鞋钉）时每一帧都重新计算摔落起点，照泰拉瑞亚的 WallslideMovement：滑到底落地不会再按跳下前的最高点算摔伤。
- 游戏版本不对（比如 1.5.78）时，日志里直接写明原因和解决办法，不再静默失败、连配置文件都不生成。

遇到问题欢迎提 Issue（附上 `BepInEx/LogOutput.log`）。

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight v1.0.1
body:
泰拉圣巢 1.0.1

## 下载

- **TerraKnight-v1.0.1.zip**：mod 本体和启动器，解压到空洞骑士的游戏目录（覆盖旧版即可）
- 宣传片见 [v0.1.0](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/releases/tag/v0.1.0)；安装步骤见 README 的“下载和安装”

## 新增

**弹药栏**
- 背包右边有了泰拉瑞亚的 4 格弹药栏。弓、枪等找弹药照泰拉瑞亚：先从上到下找弹药栏，再从前到后找背包；混沌之筒的“弹药栏”模式在这 4 格里轮换。
- 捡起弹药先补进弹药栏里同种的堆，再放进空的弹药栏；沙块、坠落之星、凝胶、麦芽酒只补已有的堆，不自己占空格。弹药栏只放得进弹药。
- 开局的木箭直接在弹药栏里。老存档放在背包里的弹药照样能用。

**创造模式：首领“传送并召唤”**
- 图鉴里点首领的“传送并召唤”，直接送到它自己的场地从头打一遍，开场动画、对话、剧情照原版触发，打过的首领也一样。
- 离开场地后，临时改的记录全部放回原样（战士之梦的梦之钉、格林的剧团条件这些也会收回）；这次打赢了就记作打赢。
- 梦境首领和神居首领打完会回到你点按钮时站的地方。
- 普通敌人还是“生成”，放在面前 10 格外。

## 修正

- 已经在空中的敌人再挨打不会越飞越高，照泰拉瑞亚的 NPC.StrikeNPC：伤害大的一下只把速度补到这一下的击退为止，正在下落的只会被托一下；伤害小的一下直接给一个更小的速度。

遇到问题欢迎提 Issue（附上 `BepInEx/LogOutput.log`）。

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight v1.0.0
body:
泰拉圣巢 1.0：把《泰拉瑞亚》1.4.5 搬进《空洞骑士》，能从国王山道一路玩到辐光和神居。

## 下载

- **TerraKnight-v1.0.0.zip**：mod 本体和启动器，解压到空洞骑士的游戏目录
- 宣传片（中文版 / 英文版）见 [v0.1.0](https://github.com/haoawake/TerraKnight/releases/tag/v0.1.0)

## 安装（详见 README 的“下载和安装”）

1. 给空洞骑士（Steam 版 1.5.12620）装好 [BepInEx 5.4.23 win x64](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases)，从 Steam 启动一次再退出。
2. 把 `TerraKnight-v1.0.0.zip` 解压到游戏目录（覆盖旧版）。
3. 电脑上要装着泰拉瑞亚（Steam 版 1.4.x）：mod 读本机泰拉瑞亚的贴图、音效和文字，不随 mod 打包。
4. 双击游戏目录里的 `泰拉圣巢.bat` 开始玩；从 Steam 直接启动是原版空洞骑士。

## 1.0 改了什么

**首领用泰拉瑞亚的数值**
- 每个空洞骑士首领顶替一个泰拉瑞亚首领，生命和防御就用那个首领的，按泰拉瑞亚自己的普通 / 专家 / 大师算法（所有部位加起来）。大师下：假骑士 = 史莱姆王 3,570，大黄蜂 = 克苏鲁之眼 4,641，残破容器 = 世纪之花 53,550，空洞骑士 = 石巨人 76,500，梦魇之王 = 猪龙鱼公爵 99,450，神居四位神和辐光 = 月亮领主 277,312。
- 一起打的首领平分一个（三只螳螂领主分骷髅王，六个守望者骑士分血肉墙），神居里重打前面阶段的首领换算到终局强度。完整对照表在 `阶段对照.md`。

**掉落和材料按泰拉瑞亚的进度重新分配**
- 月亮领主的装备按职业分给神居的四位神：斯莱（近战）、奥罗和马托（远程）、席奥（魔法）、纯粹容器（召唤），每位神还给自己职业的夜明碎片；辐光掉月亮领主自己的夜明锭和重力球。
- 阶段 5 的首领各掉自己那段进度的东西：格林 = 南瓜月，白色防御者 = 霜月，灰色王子左特 = 日食，梦魇之王 = 猪龙鱼公爵，空洞骑士 = 石巨人，失败冠军 = 火星暴乱，灵魂暴君 = 双足翼龙，失落近亲 = 光之女皇。
- 捣蛋猫和火绒狐不再开局就掉（分别到阶段 2、3），它们的“可靠的”版本到阶段 4；生命果要到王国边缘；愚人斗兽场归到困难模式（它在王国边缘里，掉的是史莱姆皇后和宝箱怪的东西）；世纪之花之后的武器只在阶段 5 出现。一共 41 件物品换了阶段。

**地图和世界**
- 世界边缘有空气墙了：德特茅斯的天上、悬崖外侧这些没有接着别的场景的地方会被挡住，不能飞出世界；那边有门的照样能走。
- 地图上门后的房间（商店、屋子、格林剧团的帐篷）只在你进到里面时才画出来，德特茅斯天上不再有“地图上有、实际没有”的地方。
- 修好小地图卡死：白色宫殿、梦境、电车，以及十字路通往苍绿之径的那个房间以前不在地图上，进去后小地图就不动了；现在都有位置（379 个场景）。

**修正**
- 缩进壳里的巴德尔长者（原版只吃法术）现在能被弓箭、子弹、魔法打到，召唤物也会锁定它（以前只有史莱姆能撞到它）。
- 创造模式的钱固定 99,999,999。
- 王国边缘有一扇门（Deepnest_East_03）在原版数据里把目标场景名的大小写写错了，无缝地图在后台载入它后对不上名字，之后所有换场景都会一直“稍后进行”卡住；现在按游戏里真正的场景名对，后台载入超过 15 秒也会放弃，不会再把换场景挂住。

遇到问题欢迎提 Issue（附上 `BepInEx/LogOutput.log`）。

name: 泰拉圣巢 TerraKnight v0.1.0
body:
第一个公开版本（开发中）：把《泰拉瑞亚》1.4.5 搬进《空洞骑士》。

## 下载

- **TerraKnight-v0.1.0.zip**：mod 本体和启动器，解压到空洞骑士的游戏目录
- **TerraKnight_promo_zh.mp4** / **TerraKnight_promo.mp4**：宣传片（中文版 / 英文版）

## 安装（详见 README 的“下载和安装”）

1. 给空洞骑士（Steam 版 1.5.12620）装好 [BepInEx 5.4.23 win x64](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases)，从 Steam 启动一次再退出。
2. 把 `TerraKnight-v0.1.0.zip` 解压到游戏目录。
3. 电脑上要装着泰拉瑞亚（Steam 版 1.4.x）：mod 读本机泰拉瑞亚的贴图、音效和文字，不随 mod 打包。
4. 双击游戏目录里的 `泰拉圣巢.bat` 开始玩；从 Steam 直接启动是原版空洞骑士。

## 有什么

- 泰拉瑞亚人物替换小骑士，泰拉瑞亚的移动手感、生命和魔力
- 四个职业、两百多件泰拉瑞亚物品（武器、饰品、盔甲、药水、钩爪、翅膀……）
- 场景地形全部可挖可放，智能光标，背景墙
- 新建存档选难度（普通 / 困难 / 专家 / 大师），存档界面开创造模式
- 怪物掉落和图鉴，难度越高掉落越丰厚
- 德特茅斯住着泰拉瑞亚的城镇 NPC，能对话、买卖
- 工作台、熔炉、砧等工作站和合成栏，和泰拉瑞亚一样
- 四套配装、泰拉瑞亚式世界地图、晶塔传送、无缝地图
- 跟着空洞骑士的语言设置走，支持 11 种语言

仍在开发中，遇到问题欢迎提 Issue（附上 `BepInEx/LogOutput.log`）。
